Die RENK Group AG mit Hauptsitz in Augsburg ist ein weltweit führender Hersteller von einsatzkritischen Antriebslösungen in verschiedenen militärischen und zivilen Endmärkten. Rund 4.400 engagierte Mitarbeiter sorgen dafür, dass wir ein verlässlicher Partner der Zeitenwende sind. Mit unseren innovativen und ganzheitlichen Mobilitätslösungen für militärische Fahrzeuge und Seestreitkräfte leisten wir einen wichtigen Beitrag zur Sicherheit von Gesellschaften mit demokratischen Werten. Kunden und Anwender verschiedener ziviler Industrien vertrauen auf ihrem Weg zu mehr Energieeffizienz und zur Klimaneutralität auf RENK. Mit unseren 14 Produktionsstätten als Teil eines Netzwerks von 22 Standorten für die Produktion, technische Betreuung und Wartung in aller Welt sind wir immer in der Nähe unserer Kundinnen und Kunden.
 Engineer (m/w/d) Electric Drive Systems 
 Vollzeit 
 Augsburg, Deutschland 
 Mit Berufserfahrung 
 24.11.26 
 Ihre Aufgaben
 Requirementmanagement für elektrische Antriebs- und Energieerzeugungssysteme 
 Systemauslegung und Spezifikation von Transformatoren, Schaltanlagen, Frequenzumrichtern und Motoren typischerweise im MW-Bereich 
 Technische Projektleitung für den elektrischen Lieferumfang 
 Erstellen von Berechnungen, Modellen und Simulationen für Antriebssysteme im Industrie- und Marinebereich 
 Unterstützung in der Vertriebsphase und beim Kunden vor Ort 
 Ihr Profil
 Abgeschlossenes Studium der Elektrotechnik oder Mechatronik oder vergleichbare Berufserfahrung 
 Erste Erfahrung auf dem Gebiet von elektrischen Leistungs- und/oder Steuerungssystemen 
 Erfahrung im Bereich Auslegung, Abstimmung und Simulation von elektrischen Leistungssystemen 
 Erste Erfahrung mit Simulationstools z.B. PowerFactory, Mathlab Simulink 
 Kenntnisse zu Regelung/Steuerung von Antriebssystemen 
 Kenntnisse über allgemeine und branchenspezifische Normen und Richtlinien 
 Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift 
 Weltweite Reisebereitschaft (Anteil ca. 5%) 
 Ausgeprägte ziel- und prozessorientierte Vorgehensweise 
 Blick für innovative Lösungsansätze 
 Was wir bieten
 Arbeitsvertrag: Freuen Sie sich auf einen sicheren, unbefristeten Arbeitsplatz mit einer 35-Stunden-Woche und 30 Tagen Urlaub pro Jahr. Bei uns profitieren Sie von einer fairen und wettbewerbsfähigen Vergütung nach IG-Metall-Tarif inklusive Sonderzahlungen.
 Gesundheit: Ob mit dem Jobrad zur Arbeit oder beim Training mit Wellpass/ EGYM – wir unterstützen Ihre Fitness und Ihr Wohlbefinden. In unserer Betriebskantine erwartet Sie zudem eine ausgewogene Ernährung im Arbeitsalltag.
 Mobilität: Laden Sie Ihr Elektroauto bequem bei uns vor Ort oder nutzen Sie ein Jobticket – wir bezuschussen Ihre umweltfreundliche Mobilität deutschlandweit.
 Betriebliche Altersvorsorge: Planen Sie heute schon für morgen - wir unterstützen Ihre Zukunft mit einem attraktiven Arbeitgeberzuschuss.
 Weiterentwicklung: Ihre Entwicklung liegt uns am Herzen. Wir fördern Sie mit vielfältigen Möglichkeiten zur persönlichen und fachlichen Weiterentwicklung. Gestalten Sie die Zukunft aktiv mit! Wir suchen Mitarbeitende, die Spaß daran haben, Veränderungen voranzutreiben und gemeinsam mit RENK unser kontinuierliches Wachstum zu gestalten.
 Für Ihre Bewerbung genügt uns zunächst Ihr Lebenslauf. Weitere Unterlagen fordern wir bei Bedarf im Verlauf des Auswahlprozesses nach. Bitte führen Sie relevante Zertifikate oder Zusatzqualifikationen direkt im Lebenslauf auf, damit wir uns ein umfassendes Bild machen können.

Lohn - CHF105'000 - 120'000

About Electra 
 Air travel is about to become something more: more direct, more accessible, and more connected to the places where people live, work and want to be. Every day in the U.S., people make 35 million trips of 50–500 miles, stuck in traffic or routed through crowded hubs. Chances are, you've been one of them. At Electra, we're changing that with the EL9, a nine-passenger, hybrid-electric aircraft that takes off and lands in just 150 feet. Our Ultra Short technology opens up thousands of new places to fly, beyond conventional runways, congested airports and long drives. We're backed by Lockheed Martin, Honeywell and Safran. Operators worldwide have signed intent-to-purchase agreements for the first 2,200 aircraft we produce, and we're moving toward first test flights in 2027. 
 Getting a new kind of aircraft airborne takes more than ambition. It takes our kind of bold: people who think big while working in the real world. Who move ideas into action and collaborate without silos. Who put people first and make room at the table for everyone. Who challenge one another without diminishing one another. 
 Sound like you? Then look beyond what you thought were your own limits, and help us take flight beyond runways. 
 The Role 
 Electra is actively recruiting a Staff Electrical Engineer to help lead the design and development of high-voltage and low-voltage electrical systems for our 9-passenger eSTOL (electric short takeoff and landing), hybrid-electric aircraft. This position focuses on design, prototyping, integration, and testing, and is based in Olten, Switzerland. 
 What You'll Do 
 Lead the design, analysis, integration, and testing of assigned electrical systems for our hybrid-electric aircraft. This role has the potential to support a number of aircraft electric systems and equipment, including avionics, power distribution (low voltage and high voltage), power electronics, electrical energy storage, and electric machines. 
 Understand program objectives and requirements to conduct trade studies and help define architectures, requirements, and interfaces between systems. 
 Develop and manage requirements for assigned electrical systems and equipment, compatible with program-level safety, performance, certification, and business objectives. 
 Support the evaluation and selection of electrical equipment suppliers, and provide technical review and oversight throughout the development process. 
 Prepare and present design reviews to demonstrate the adequacy of the design. 
 Provide hands-on support for electrical system integration and test activities. 
 Collaborate with program management, other IPTs, and functional groups to accomplish team goals. 
 Other duties as assigned. 
 What You Bring 
 Experience in the development of aerospace electrical systems, hybrid-electric propulsion, and/or avionics systems. 
 Proficiency with general-purpose test and build equipment/tools (oscilloscope, multimeter, soldering iron). 
 A strong work ethic and the ability to work independently and take ownership of assigned areas. 
 Excellent organization and communication skills. 
 Ability to adapt well to change. 
 Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering, aerospace, or a related field; and 
 5+ years of experience in relevant discipline areas, or an equivalent combination of education, skills, and experience. 
 Bonus Points 
 Master's or PhD in a relevant engineering discipline. 
 Experience with high-power hybrid-electric and/or fully electric propulsion systems and power electronics. 
 Working knowledge of the Federal Aviation Regulations (FARs), certification procedures (especially Part 23), and relevant industry standards. 
 Experience implementing and troubleshooting digital communications architectures (e.g., RS422, CAN, Ethernet, ARINC 429). 
 Experience with grounding schemes for large and complex electrical systems. 
 US Person (Citizen or Green Card) preferred. 
 What We Offer 
 Medical, dental, and vision insurance; STD, LTD, and life insurance 
 Generous PTO, sick leave, and company holidays 
 Paid winter break 
 401(k) with immediate vesting 
 Free catered lunches, coffee, snacks, and drinks at our Manassas headquarters 
 Free on-site parking 
 Electra is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. This position may be subject to ITAR requirements.

 - HOMER Pro
 - PSCAD
 - MATLAB / Simulink
 - PSS®E

 5. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and technical report-writing skills.
 6. Experience in international energy projects, particularly off-grid or weak-grid applications, is an advantage.
 7. Willingness and ability to undertake short-term overseas business trips as required by project needs.
 8. Good communication skills and the ability to work effectively in a multidisciplinary and international project environment.

Your Mission:

We are looking for an Aerodynamics Engineer to join the Flight Physics team. You will further evolve aerodynamic characterization of the Microliner aircraft. Responsibilities include performing trade studies, expanding aerodynamic databases, and contributing to testing campaigns in both laboratory and flight environments. Your work will directly contribute to detailed design of specific aerodynamic features on the aircraft.

You will work closely with Propulsion, Structures, Systems, and Certification teams for data exchange, planning of compliance demonstration campaigns, and further requirement capturing.

 

Your Day-to-Day:

 - Conduct comprehensive simulation campaigns using in-house and commercial tools: from pre-processing and execution to post-processing, dataset management and interpretation/visualisation.

 - Conduct systematic mesh refinement and grid independence studies to ensure numerical rigor, solution convergence, and high-quality data generation.

 - Perform uncertainty quantification and validation activities against analytical and wind tunnel test data to ensure reliable and robust aerodynamic databases.

 - Perform transient CFD simulations of the propeller-airframe configuration for loads calculations, vibration analysis, and installation effects.

 - Perform flow simulations of the cabin and cockpit compartments to optimize ECS performance.

 - Set-up and further development of simulation toolchains.

 - Participate on activities related to aircraft design and analysis.

 - Closely collaborate with your colleagues specialized in flight dynamics, loads, aeroelasticity, and aerodynamics.

 - Create and maintain documentation.

 - Ensure consistent data as part of aircraft baselining.

 - Support and participate in design reviews.

 - Prepare and manage simulations.

 

Your Profile:

 - Master’s and/or PhD degree in Aerospace Engineering, or equivalent.

 - Minimum 4 years of hands-on experience aerodynamic simulation, preferably within CS 23 aircraft programs operating under a DOA environment or international equivalent.

 - Demonstrated experience in CFD simulations; ANSYS Fluent is a plus.

 - Solid understanding of propulsion aerodynamics.

 - Demonstrated experience in internal flow calculations and low Reynolds number flows.

 - Proficiency in coding (Matlab or alternatively Python).

 - Proficiency in PLM; Dassault’s 3DX platform is a plus.

 - Experience across the full product development lifecycle, from conceptual and preliminary design through detailed design, verification, validation, and certification (CS 23 or CS 25) is a plus.

 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; additional European languages are an asset.

 - Self-driven, solution-oriented professional with strong ownership mindset and the ability to operate effectively in a dynamic development environment.

 - Strong personal motivation for aviation and the advancement of electric aircraft technologies.

We recognize that women and other under-represented groups are often overlooked in our industry. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every listed qualification, we still encourage you to apply. Talent and potential can’t always be captured in a checklist.

 

Why us?

 - Be part of an ambitious team determined to shape the future of aviation.

 - We are an in-office company, but we value flexibility and trust employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work or adjusting hours to accommodate personal commitments.

 - Subsidized EGYM Wellpass membership: your (mental) health is important for us.

 - Enjoy a subsidized lunch with a 5€ company contribution per meal on office days.

 - Become a part of our success with virtual stock options.

 - Choose the option that suits your needs: either a free charging station for your electric car or a public transport job ticket as part of the Deutschlandticket.

 - Lease a high-quality bicycle or e-bike through our JobRad program and benefit from tax advantages. Whether for your daily commute or personal use, enjoy more mobility and sustainability.

 - Pension scheme to support your long-term financial security.

 - Work in one of our offices in Munich or Delft. Enjoy the modern Balan Campus in Munich or work inside the aerospace ecosystem at TU Delft.

 - Boost your professional as well as personal growth executing your own ideas and independent projects.

 - Join our internal social events and retreats (e.g. cooking, game nights, sports).

VÆRIDION was founded in 2021 to transform regional air travel with the Microliner, a 100% electric commercial aircraft. By delivering the most energy-efficient aircraft, we are building the future where clean, safe, and affordable electric aviation seamlessly connects people and businesses. We’re bringing together the brightest minds in aerospace, automotive engineering, and business to disrupt the aviation industry.

Your Mission:

We are looking for an EMI/EMC, HIRF & Lightning Engineer (all genders)  to join our Central Engineering team and support electromagnetic compatibility and electromagnetic environmental effects activities for the Microliner aircraft.

You will be responsible for the day-to-day engineering activities related to EMI/EMC, High-Intensity Radiated Fields (HIRF), and lightning protection throughout the aircraft development lifecycle, from requirements and architecture support through analysis, design integration, testing, verification, and certification. Working closely with colleagues from Systems, Propulsion, Airframe, Safety, Verification and Validation, and Certification, you will ensure that electromagnetic environmental effects are appropriately addressed at aircraft, system, equipment, and installation level.

As part of Central Engineering, you will act as an internal focal point for EMI/EMC, HIRF, and lightning engineering. Working within the established technical approach and with guidance from senior subject-matter expertise, you will independently drive engineering activities within your area, coordinate across disciplines and suppliers, resolve technical issues, and develop substantiated recommendations for higher-level technical decisions.

 

Your Day-to-Day:

 - Develop and maintain aircraft-level EMI/EMC, HIRF, and lightning requirements within the established technical framework, supporting their decomposition, allocation, and verification across aircraft systems, equipment, installations, and structures.

 - Perform and coordinate EMI/EMC, HIRF, and lightning assessments, including interference sources, coupling paths, equipment susceptibility, installation effects, and direct and indirect lightning effects.

 - Develop, assess, and support the implementation of protection and mitigation measures, including shielding, grounding and bonding, filtering, cable routing and separation, equipment installation, and structural protection provisions.

 - Support the maturation of the aircraft EMI/EMC, HIRF, and lightning protection approach, evaluating technical solutions, identifying risks and trade-offs, and developing substantiated recommendations for higher-level technical decisions.

 - Define and coordinate verification and qualification activities within the assigned scope, including analysis, inspection, equipment qualification, ground and aircraft testing, and testing performed by external laboratories.

 - Independently investigate and resolve electromagnetic interference and compatibility issues during equipment development, system integration, and testing, involving senior technical expertise where significant architectural or programme-level decisions are required.

 - Support safety, certification, and compliance activities, including preparation and review of assessments, qualification evidence, verification results, and compliance documentation in accordance with applicable standards.

 - Act as an internal technical focal point for EMI/EMC, HIRF, and lightning topics, coordinating with engineering teams, suppliers, test laboratories, and technical specialists, while contributing to the continuous improvement of related engineering methods and processes.

 

Your Profile:

 - Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Physics, or a comparable technical discipline, with a minimum of 4 years of professional experience in EMI/EMC, HIRF, lightning protection, or related electromagnetic environmental effects.

 - Practical experience in EMI/EMC engineering, including emissions and susceptibility/immunity, grounding and bonding, shielding, filtering, cable installation, and electromagnetic coupling, combined with experience in HIRF and/or lightning protection.

 - Working knowledge of relevant aerospace standards and guidance, such as RTCA DO-160 / EUROCAE ED-14 and the SAE ARP541x series, with experience supporting related analysis, testing, or equipment qualification.

 - Good understanding of aircraft electrical and electronic systems and their integration; experience with high-voltage architectures, electric propulsion, power electronics, or composite aircraft structures is a strong plus.

 - Experience with civil aircraft development and certification under EASA CS-23/CS-25, FAA Part 23/25, or comparable frameworks is desirable; experience within an EASA Part 21J Design Organisation is a plus.

 - Understanding of systems and safety engineering principles for safety-critical aircraft systems, preferably with exposure to SAE ARP4754 and ARP4761.

 - Ability to work with a high degree of autonomy within an established technical framework, while recognizing when technical issues require broader coordination, specialist input, or escalation.

 - Structured, analytical, and solution-oriented professional with strong technical ownership and the ability to investigate complex electromagnetic interactions and translate findings into practical design recommendations.

 - Strong communication and coordination skills, with the ability to work effectively across engineering disciplines, suppliers, test laboratories, and technical specialists.

 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

 - Strong motivation for aviation and the advancement of electric aircraft technologies.

We recognize that women and other under-represented groups are often overlooked in our industry. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every listed qualification, we still encourage you to apply. Talent and potential can’t always be captured in a checklist.

 

Why us?

 - Be part of an ambitious team determined to shape the future of aviation.

 - We are an in-office company, but we value flexibility and trust employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work or adjusting hours to accommodate personal commitments.

 - Subsidized EGYM Wellpass membership: your (mental) health is important for us.

 - Enjoy a subsidized lunch with a 5€ company contribution per meal on office days.

 - Become a part of our success with virtual stock options.

 - Choose the option that suits your needs: either a free charging station for your electric car or a public transport job ticket as part of the Deutschlandticket.

 - Lease a high-quality bicycle or e-bike through our JobRad program and benefit from tax advantages. Whether for your daily commute or personal use, enjoy more mobility and sustainability.

 - Pension scheme to support your long-term financial security.

 - Work in one of our offices in Munich or Delft. Enjoy the modern Balan Campus in Munich or work inside the aerospace ecosystem at TU Delft.

 - Boost your professional as well as personal growth executing your own ideas and independent projects.

 - Join our internal social events and retreats (e.g. cooking, game nights, sports).

VÆRIDION was founded in 2021 to transform regional air travel with the Microliner, a 100% electric commercial aircraft. By delivering the most energy-efficient aircraft, we are building the future where clean, safe, and affordable electric aviation seamlessly connects people and businesses. We’re bringing together the brightest minds in aerospace, automotive engineering, and business to disrupt the aviation industry.

#WeAreIn for jobs that impact everyone's life. Join the thinkers, builders, and problemsolvers behind tomorrow’s technology. As a Digital Concept Engineer in our Research & Development team, you'll have the opportunity to merge creativity with your technical expertise by shaping the future of technology, driving groundbreaking projects, and bringing new ideas to life. Are you in?
Your role
Key responsibilities in your new role
Join us in shaping the next generation of intelligent motor control solutions. You will play a key role at the intersection of product definition and semiconductor development, transforming customer and application needs into innovative System-on-Chip (SoC) architectures. From defining system concepts and requirements to driving model-based development, AI-assisted engineering, and future robotics applications, you will help turn market demands into scalable, high-performance hardware and software solutions.
 Shape the architecture definition of the next generation of motor control System-on-Chip, ensuring scalability, robustness, and innovation from concept to silicon
 Translate product-relevant application requirements into precise hardware and software specifications
 Develop modular and scalable platform/family concepts in strong collaboration with the product definition team
 Lead model-centric development approaches, owning the creation and maintenance of system-level models to validate architectural decisions early in the design cycle
 Introduce and integrate AI-assisted methods and tools into the concept engineering workflow to accelerate architectural exploration, requirement analysis, and design space evaluation
 Drive the adoption of robotics-aware system design, considering embedded motor control applications in next-generation robotic platforms as a key use case
 Define and integrate of standard communication interfaces, including Ethernet, SPI, I²C, CAN, and LIN into SoC architectures
 Partner closely with the technical marketing team, actively driving knowledge transfer to the SoC design team
 Create and maintain technical documentation to provide Hardware and Safety/Cybersecurity Architecture descriptions, guaranteeing ISO 26262 compliance
 Your profile
 Qualifications And Skills To Help You Succeed
 A strong foundation in digital and SoC design, combined with a passion for these disciplines, is essential. Experience as a Concept Engineer is a plus, but not a requirement; what matters most is your willingness and motivation to grow into the concept engineering role.
 Master's or PhD degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field
 At least 5 years of experience in Digital Design/SoC Design, specifically in digital SoC architecture, and some experience in concept engineering
 Deep knowledge in digital hardware architecture, RTL design, and system-level integration
 Experience leading cross-functional teams and driving alignment between concept, design, a application engineering
 Hands-on experience with model-centric development methodologies (e.g., MATLAB/Simulink, SystemC, or equivalent modeling environments
 Working knowledge of AI tools and their application in concept work, including automated design space exploration, requirement traceability, and architectur validation
 Knowledge in Chip Integration, packaging, and assembly, including crosstalk and interference awareness
 Knowledge in safety analysis methods: FTA, DFA, FMEDA, HAZOP
 Vehicle Cybersecurity ISO/SAE 21434. ISO 26262 certification and additional functional safety trainings is a plus
 Familiarity with robotics system architectures and motor control applications in autonomous or collaborative robotic systems
 Hands-on experience with Ethernet-based communication stacks and automotive communication interfaces (e.g., 100BASE-T1, AVB/TSN)
 Fluency in English; German is a plus
 #WeAreIn for driving decarbonization and digitalization.
As a global leader in semiconductor solutions in power systems and IoT, Infineon enables game-changing solutions for green and efficient energy, clean and safe mobility, as well as smart and secure IoT. Together, we drive innovation and customer success, while caring for our people and empowering them to reach ambitious goals. Be a part of making life easier, safer and greener.
Are you in?
We are on a journey to create the best Infineon for everyone.
We strive to create the best Infineon for everyone by embracing diversity and inclusion. We welcome applicants for who they are and offer a workplace built on trust, openness, respect and equal opportunity.
Our hiring decisions are based on skills and experience. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply.
Please let your recruiter know if you need any accommodations during the interview process.
Learn more about our various contact channels and about Diversity & Inclusion at Infineon.

Job Description Summary
 GE Vernova accélère la transition vers une énergie plus fiable, abordable et durable, tout en aidants nos clients à stimuler les économies et à fournir l'électricité essentielle à la santé, à la sécurité et à l'amélioration de la qualité de vie.
Êtes-vous enthousiasmé par l'opportunité d'électrifier et de décarboner le monde ?
En Tant Que Membre De L'équipe D'ingénierie Et Du Département D'intégration Et De Simulation Du Réseau (Grid Response), Vous Soutiendrez, Accompagnerez Nos Clients Qui Exploitent Un Parc De Milliers De Machines à Travers Le Monde, Pour Aider à Garantir La Stabilité De Leur Réseau Électrique Tout En Intégrant Les Politiques De Décarbonation
L’ingénieur(e) Simulation Grid code (réseau électrique) est un garant de la bonne représentation mathématique (simulations) des produits GE Vernova sur les aspects électriques/mécanique de la centrale.
Vous interviendrez de la phase offre jusqu'aux essais sur site pour les nouveaux projets et/ou des projets de rénovation.
A noter que vous serez accompagné dans un premier temps par des experts pour vous apporter un socle solide de connaissances de la problématique sur la modélisation des réseaux électriques.
GE Vernova is accelerating the transition towards a more reliable, affordable, and sustainable energy, while helping our customers drive economies and deliver the electricity that is vital to health, safety, security, and an improved quality of life.
Are you excited about the opportunity to electrify and decarbonize the world?
As a Member Of The Engineering Team And The Grid Response Integration & Simulation Department, You Will Support And Assist Our Customers Who Operate a Fleet Of Thousands Of Machines Worldwide, To Help Guarantee The Stability Of Their Electrical Grid While Integrating Decarbonization Policies
The Grid Code Simulation Engineer acts as a guarantor for the accurate mathematical representation (simulations) of GE Vernova products regarding the electrical and mechanical aspects of the power plant.
You will be involved from the bidding phase up to on-site testing for new projects and/or retrofit projects.
Please note that you will initially be supported by experts to provide you with a solid foundation of knowledge regarding electrical grid modeling challenges.
 Job Description
 Ce que vous ferez 
 En coordination avec les équipes d'ingénierie, évaluer la capabilité de la Turbine à Combustion ou Turbine Vapeur et leurs alternateurs à répondre aux exigences des Grid Codes et ses contraintes de fonctionnement dans les systèmes industriels.
 Maîtriser la représentation numérique des boucles de régulation principales de la turbine et sa réponse intrinsèque, à partir de modèles standardisés (IEEE) ou personnalisés et maintenir ces représentations pour toutes les catégories de turbines.

 hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium in Medizintechnik, Elektrotechnik, Informatik, Mechatronik oder eine vergleichbare technische Qualifikation

Institution
 Chair of Thermodynamics of Mobile Energy Conversion Systems
 Our Profile
 At the Chair of Thermodynamics of Mobile Energy Conversion Systems (TME) and the Center for Mobile Propulsion (CMP) under the direction of Prof. Dr.-Ing. (USA) Stefan Pischinger, research on all topics concerning the vehicle powertrain is conducted. Core focus is still the research on conventional combustion engine development like the implementation of innovative engine designs, fundamental research on more efficient combustion processes also in combination with alternative fuels or the improvement of the engine mechanics and aftertreatment systems. Additional research areas include virtual engine development, hybrid powertrains, electromobility as well as fuel cells and mechatronics for combustion engines. At any time research is closely associated with the ongoing development of intelligent methods for test procedures and engine calibration. The Chair of Thermodynamics of Mobile Energy Conversion Systems employs more than 260 scientific, technical and administrative employees as well as student assistants.
 Your Profile
 Completed college degree (Master's degree or equivalent) in Mechanical Engineering or Electrical Engineering
 Knowledge of modeling/simulation of fuel cell (systems), preferably in Matlab / Simulink or Modelica, experience in measurement data evaluation and test bench operation advantageous
 Basic knowledge of PEM fuel cells/systems and electric powertrains advantageous
 Good computer skills
 Fluent in english
 Ability to work independently and scientifically
 Creative, flexible and team-orientation
 Your Duties And Responsibilities
 Development of fuel cell systems for mobile applications
 Modeling and (3D CFD) simulation, especially of:
 Flow fields and gas distribution, Optimization of the bipolar plate
 Water transport phenomena within the fuel cell and the membrane electrode assembly
 Ice formation during cold start
 Validation of simulation at the single cell and stack test bench.
 What We Offer
 The successful candidate will be employed under a regular employment contract. The position is to be filled at the earliest possible date and offered for a fixed term of 1 year. An extension to 4 years in total is provided. The System Architect – ADAS will be responsible for defining, developing, and integrating system-level architectures for advanced driver assistance systems and autonomous driving features. This role bridges hardware, software, and algorithmic domains, ensuring the system meets performance, safety, and regulatory requirements.
 Key Responsibilities
 Define the end-to-end system architecture for ADAS functions (e.g., adaptive cruise control, lane keeping, parking assist, AEB, etc.). 
 Lead system decomposition into hardware, software, and algorithmic components. 
 Develop system-level requirements and ensure traceability through design, implementation, and validation. 
 Work closely with cross-functional teams (sensors, perception, fusion, controls, software, hardware, and test). 
 Evaluate and integrate sensor suites (camera, radar, lidar, ultrasonic, GNSS, IMU, etc.) within the vehicle architecture. 
 Define communication architectures (CAN, Ethernet, LIN, FlexRay) and ensure robust data flow between ECUs and sensors. 
 Support functional safety and SOTIF (ISO 26262 / ISO 21448) activities, ensuring compliance with ASIL targets. 
 Participate in model-based system engineering (MBSE) and architecture modeling using relevant tools such as Enterprise Architect, SysML etc. 
 Define cybersecurity requirements in line with ISO/SAE 21434. 
 Support prototype development, system integration and design reviews. 
 Collaborate with OEM and Tier-1 partners for system design alignment. 
 Qualifications
 Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical, Electronics or Computer Science Engineering. 
 3+ years of experience in ADAS / Autonomous Driving Systems or related automotive embedded systems. 
 Strong understanding of ADAS architectures, sensor fusion, and vehicle networks. 
 Hands-on experience with AUTOSAR or middleware frameworks. 
 Knowledge of Functional Safety (ISO 26262) and SOTIF (ISO 21448) processes. 
 Experience with requirements management tools (e.g., DOORS). 
 Familiarity with real-time systems, embedded software, and hardware-software co-design. 
 Excellent analytical, communication, and system-thinking skills. 
 Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

Given L&T’s capability in strategic electronics and leveraging its foray into semiconductor design and well-established capabilities in L&T Technology Services, the business is expanding its offerings to cover industrial electronic modules, products and systems in critical sectors of Power Electronics, Automotive Electronics, Industrial Robotics & Automation, Communication Platforms and Electronic Systems Design & Manufacturing (ESDM). Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.
 We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.
 Here’s what this particular role covers.
 🛠️ About our Feature Engineering Team 
 We’re seeking an exceptional Feature Engineer to join our Germany-based team within the Application Engineering org, focused on localising and advancing Wayve’s autonomous driving technology for the German market. This is a unique opportunity to play a hands-on role in shaping our AV capabilities in Germany from the ground up.
 🧩 What you’ll be working on 
 We are looking for an ADAS Feature Engineer to help build the application-layer software that connects Wayve’s AI capabilities to real vehicle behaviour. This role sits at the intersection of AI, vehicle systems, active safety, and product delivery: you will develop C++ feature logic, validation tools, and system behaviours that allow AI-native driving technology to operate robustly in real-world vehicle environments. You will work closely with machine learning, product, vehicle integration, and systems teams to turn model outputs and vehicle data into reliable, testable, and customer-relevant ADAS features.
   🧠 Your day-to-day 
 Design, implement, and maintain C++ application software for ADAS and active-safety-related vehicle features.
 Build feature-level logic on top of AI / ML outputs, including validation, feasibility checks, state machines, fallback behaviours, and safety-aware decision logic.
 Work with ML engineers to understand model outputs, limitations, failure modes, and how these translate into vehicle behaviour.
 Use logs, simulation, replay, and vehicle testing to debug, tune, and validate feature behaviour.
 Define and improve metrics, test cases, and validation strategies for ADAS feature performance, robustness, and quality.
 Collaborate with product, systems, vehicle integration, and OEM-facing teams to translate requirements and real-world constraints into engineering solutions.
 Support field testing and iterative development, including investigation of vehicle issues, edge cases, and performance gaps.
 Contribute to software architecture, code quality, tooling, and engineering practices for feature development.
   🙌 You should apply if 
 Essential 
 Strong C++ software engineering experience, ideally in production or safety-relevant systems.
 Hands-on experience in ADAS, autonomous driving, robotics, vehicle software, active safety, or closely related domains.
 Practical understanding of vehicle feature development, including real-world testing, simulation, replay, logs, or prototype vehicle debugging.
 Ability to reason about vehicle behaviour, sensor/model inputs, timing, failure modes, and feature-level decision logic.
 Experience working cross-functionally with teams such as ML, perception, planning, controls, vehicle integration, product, or systems engineering.
 Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to make pragmatic engineering trade-offs under ambiguity.
 A quality mindset, with experience writing testable, maintainable software and using data to validate behaviour.
 Desirable 
 Experience with ADAS features such as AEB, ISA, AES, ACC, lane keeping, collision avoidance, trajectory validation, or active safety systems.
 Experience at an automotive OEM, Tier 1 supplier, autonomous driving company, robotics company, or vehicle technology startup.
 Familiarity with ML or AI-based autonomy systems, including how model outputs are consumed by downstream software.
 Experience with ROS, Linux, Bazel, CMake, Docker, QNX, protobuf, MCAP, CAN, calibration, or vehicle logging systems.
 Experience with vehicle test tracks, public-road testing, HIL/SIL, scenario-based testing, or NCAP-style validation.
 Familiarity with tools used in automotive development and testing, such as CANoe, Vector tools, MicroAutoBox, or similar.
     🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.
   More about Wayve: 
 🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines.
 Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility.
   How we work 💻- Locations & Flexible Working: 
 Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives.
   🔍 The Interview Process: 
 Our process is clear and respectful of your time:
 Initial call / recruiter screen : general background, current situation, interests and Wayve company information & hiring context.
 Competency Interviews : programming and code review.
 Deep-dive technical interviews : domain knowledge & system design.
 Final interview : mission & values alignment.
 We’ll always explain the format and work around your availability.
   What’s in it for you (Location dependant): 
 💰 Salaries benchmarked against the market annually
📈 Meaningful equity, sharing in the ownership and long term success of Wayve
✈️ Relocation support and visa sponsorship where applicable
✅ Hybrid working, core hours and the chance to work hands on in vehicle workshops and labs
📚 Learning and development budgets with support for training, conferences and growth
🩺 Comprehensive benefits including health insurance, dental, enhanced maternity and paternity leave, retirement or pension where applicable, access to therapists, wellbeing partnerships, team socials and more
 A quick, honest note before you apply.
 Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one.
 If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend your time on, we’d really like to hear from you.

items.jobTitle: Staff Design Verification Engineer, AI HW
items.jobDescription:
Tenstorrent is leading the industry on cutting-edge AI technology, revolutionizing performance expectations, ease of use, and cost efficiency. With AI redefining the computing paradigm, solutions must evolve to unify innovations in software models, compilers, platforms, networking, and semiconductors. Our diverse team of technologists have developed a high performance RISC-V CPU from scratch, and share a passion for AI and a deep desire to build the best AI platform possible. We value collaboration, curiosity, and a commitment to solving hard problems. We are growing our team and looking for contributors of all seniorities.
 Our Tensix team is building custom AI compute cores, RISC-V CPUs, and chiplet-based architectures for datacenter, edge, and automotive AI. Design Verification Engineers on this team validate compute IP and subsystems and build scalable DV infrastructure to keep verification fast, automated, and production-grade.
 This role is hybrid, based out of Toronto, ON, Austin, TX or Belgrade, Serbia.
 We welcome candidates at various experience levels for this role. During the interview process, candidates will be assessed for the appropriate level, and offers will align with that level, which may differ from the one in this posting.
 Who You Are 
 Experienced in modern verification methodologies with strong SystemVerilog skills and exposure to structured testbench development.
 Comfortable working from block-level to system-level verification and reasoning about microarchitecture behavior from specs and waveforms.
 Proficient in Linux environments with Python, or Bash scripting for automate builds, parse logs, manage CI pipelines.
 Skilled in coverage-driven verification and confident debugging across RTL, testbench, and workload scenarios.
 Motivated by AI hardware and eager to learn verification strategies for new architectures and domains.
 What We Need 
 Contribute to verification of Tensix IP and subsystems from early planning through tape-out, owning coverage goals and driving them to closure.
 Build and maintain reusable verification environments, agents, scoreboards, and supporting infrastructure in SystemVerilog and Python.
 Develop constrained-random and directed tests and close functional, code, and assertion coverage using data-driven approaches.
 Debug complex issues across RTL and testbench while collaborating with design, firmware, compiler, and architecture teams.
 Help evolve DV infrastructure including regression flows, CI/CD integration, EDA compute environments, and reproducible setups.
 Nice to have: Exposure to functional safety (FuSa) verification concepts for automotive AI workloads.
 Nice to have: Familiarity with formal verification methodologies, SVA (SystemVerilog Assertions), or formal property verification for complex control logic and microarchitectural corner cases.
 What You Will Learn 
 How Tenstorrent verifies AI-native compute architectures including Tensix cores, RISC-V CPUs, matrix units, vector units, and datapath.
 How simulation, emulation, and software-driven workloads combine to validate both functional correctness and performance.
 How numerical precision formats such as BF16, FP4, and INT8 and on-chip dataflow impact verification complexity and coverage strategy.
 How to build scalable DV infrastructure across hybrid compute environments including containerized regression systems.
 How data analytics and modern AI tooling can enhance verification workflows and accelerate convergence.
 Compensation for all engineers at Tenstorrent ranges from $100k - $500k including base and variable compensation targets. Experience, skills, education, background and location all impact the actual offer made. 
 Tenstorrent offers a highly competitive compensation package and benefits, and we are an equal opportunity employer. 
 This offer of employment is contingent upon the applicant being eligible to access U.S. export-controlled technology.  Due to U.S. export laws, including those codified in the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR), the Company is required to ensure compliance with these laws when transferring technology to nationals of certain countries (such as EAR Country Groups D:1, E1, and E2).   These requirements apply to persons located in the U.S. and all countries outside the U.S.  As the position offered will have direct and/or indirect access to information, systems, or technologies subject to these laws, the offer may be contingent upon your citizenship/permanent residency status or ability to obtain prior license approval from the U.S. Commerce Department or applicable federal agency.  If employment is not possible due to U.S. export laws, any offer of employment will be rescinded.

Your Mission:

We are looking for a Mechanical Systems Engineer to help us develop and integrate the Landing Gear System of our fully battery-electric aircraft (CS-23). You will take a leading role in defining, integrating and certifying the retractable landing gear system of a clean-sheet battery-electric aircraft, including extension/retraction actuation, wheels & brakes, tires, steering, anti-skid functions and associated indication sub-systems. Your work will span the full system development lifecycle, from system-level requirements, architecture and functional analysis through preliminary and detailed design, supplier involvement, prototype assembly support, ground & flight testing and certification. You will work closely with overall aircraft design, structures, flight physics, avionics, and other engineering teams to ensure optimal system integration and will play a key role in the detailed definition of the overall aircraft.

 

Your Day-to-Day:

 - Define and derive system-level requirements for the landing gear system based on CONOPS, aircraft-level requirements and applicable regulations.

 - Perform system-level functional analysis, including functional decomposition and identification of system interfaces.

 - Contribute to the definition and development of the landing gear system to achieve the required level of maturity at each aircraft design phase.

 - Define and manage functional and physical interfaces between the landing gear system and other aircraft systems and structures.

 - Define system-level verification and validation strategies, including support for ground and flight test campaigns and qualification testing of landing gear equipment and assemblies.

 - Collaborate with partners and suppliers as a technical interface for landing gear system integration.

 - Support Functional Hazard Assessments (FHA) and system safety activities in accordance with ARP4754A, ARP4761A and applicable certification requirements.

 - Support system integration, verification, testing and certification activities.

 

Your Profile:

 - Engineering degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or equivalent.

 - 5+ years of aerospace experience, with a focus on aircraft retractable landing gear systems.

 - Experience with systems engineering, including requirements definition, functional analysis and system integration.

 - Experience across the aircraft development lifecycle, including EASA/FAA Part 23 or 25 certification.

 - Experience working in an EASA Part 21J organization, or international equivalent.

 - Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English; another European language is a plus.

 - Proactive, solution-oriented and comfortable taking ownership in a fast-paced environment.

 - Passionate about aviation and the electrification of flight.

 - Experience with electric or hybrid-electric aircraft and strong understanding of aircraft systems is a plus.

 - Experience working in an aerospace startup or new aircraft development programme would be beneficial.

 - Previous CVE or equivalent technical authority responsibility for landing gear systems on CS-23 aircraft program is a plus.

We recognize that women and other under-represented groups are often overlooked in our industry. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every listed qualification, we still encourage you to apply. Talent and potential can’t always be captured in a checklist.

 

Why us?

 - Be part of an ambitious team determined to shape the future of aviation.

 - We are an in-office company, but we value flexibility and trust employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work or adjusting hours to accommodate personal commitments.

 - Subsidized EGYM Wellpass membership: your (mental) health is important for us.

 - Enjoy a subsidized lunch with a 5€ company contribution per meal on office days.

 - Become a part of our success with virtual stock options.

 - Choose the option that suits your needs: either a free charging station for your electric car or a public transport job ticket as part of the Deutschlandticket.

 - Lease a high-quality bicycle or e-bike through our JobRad program and benefit from tax advantages. Whether for your daily commute or personal use, enjoy more mobility and sustainability.

 - Pension scheme to support your long-term financial security.

 - Work in one of our offices in Munich or Delft. Enjoy the modern Balan Campus in Munich or work inside the aerospace ecosystem at TU Delft.

 - Boost your professional as well as personal growth executing your own ideas and independent projects.

 - Join our internal social events and retreats (e.g. cooking, game nights, sports).

VÆRIDION was founded in 2021 to transform regional air travel with the Microliner, a 100% electric commercial aircraft. By delivering the most energy-efficient aircraft, we are building the future where clean, safe, and affordable electric aviation seamlessly connects people and businesses. We’re bringing together the brightest minds in aerospace, automotive engineering, and business to disrupt the aviation industry.

Job description:
 Job Description This position is part of ZF’s ADAS & HPC business unit, internally known as “Capri.” This business unit is planned to be sold to Harman International – a Samsung company and a global innovator in automotive technology – offering a unique opportunity to be part of an exciting new chapter in the ADAS sector.
 We are looking for an experienced  Embedded HW/SW Codesigner & Chip Development Engineer to join our Semiconductor & Electronic Component Strategy & Engineering team in Friedrichshafen.
 Our Systems and Hardware Development department develops advanced vehicle control units, communication systems, and High-Performance Computing (HPC) platforms for autonomous driving, such as ProAI and ProConnect. With the automotive semiconductor and chiplet market accelerating through ADAS, centralized sensor processing and V2X ecosystems, we are expanding our capabilities in cutting-edge System-on-Chip (SoC) architectures and automotive IPs, including participation in public R&D projects.
 In this role, you will bridge hardware and software domains, develop robust automotive computing solutions, define interface and chiplet integration strategies, and ensure compliance with functional safety standards.
 Responsibilities HPC & SoC Architecture: Design, prototype and evaluate next-generation HPC platforms, custom microprocessors and heterogeneous SoC architectures incorporating ARM, RISC-V cores, DSPs, GPUs and NNAs.
 HW/SW Codesign & Virtualization: Collaborate on embedded HW/SW codesign, hypervisor implementations and virtualization using Linux (Yocto) and RTOS (QNX).
 Interface & Chiplet Integration: Define architecture design rules, floorplans and high-speed interfaces such as PCIe, UCIe, Ethernet, CAN-FD and ISPs, alongside NoCs and memory subsystems (JEDEC).
 Technology Scouting: Analyze semiconductor roadmaps, IP data books and emerging technologies to support competitive autonomous mobility solutions.
 Functional Safety: Ensure SoC and ECU developments comply with automotive standards including ISO 26262 and ASIL requirements.
 Requirements & Documentation: Support system interface requirements, technical specifications and engineering documentation.
   Qualifications Master’s degree or Ph.D. in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Automotive Engineering or a related technical discipline.
 Experience in embedded HW/SW codesign, FPGA/ASIC development and modern RISC-V or advanced CPU/GPU architectures.
 Strong knowledge of high-speed serial interfaces (PCIe, UCIe), memory standards and SoC floorplanning.
 Practical experience with Linux (Yocto) and real-time operating systems such as QNX.
 Proficiency in Verilog, VHDL or SystemC.
 Software development and scripting skills in Python, C and C++ and/or MATLAB/Java.
 Experience with CI/CD, Docker and GitLab.
 Knowledge of automotive software architectures, ISO 26262 and ASIL classification.
 Knowledge of MS365 (Word, Excel, Teams, PowerPoint, SharePoint, Visio).
 Self-motivated, analytical and comfortable working in a dynamic team environment.
 Excellent communication skills in English and German.

Job Description Summary
 Tuning and Operations team is devoted to wind turbine systems modeling and operability tuning for product development and fleet support, with a strong focus on product optimization.
The vision of the Tuning and Operations team is to create customer value by delivering products with highest availability by minimizing risks from turbine operability related aspects and deliver quick return to service by timely and effective resolution of fleet issues.
The role of the Operability engineer includes enabling wind turbine optimization via appropriate control tuning of core operational and supervisory turbine control algorithms. This should result in wind turbine products capable of meeting targets on availability, high performance, levelized cost of energy (LCOE) as well as compliance with specific market segment regulations in terms of noise, grid code, etc.
 Job Description
 Roles and Responsibilities
 Progressive retirement of operability related engineering risks as part of the different phases of a new product introduction (NPI) cycle, ensuring turbine operation displays adequate levels of closed-loop stability, availability, robustness, and compliance to market-specific requirements such as grid codes, noise, cold weather, etc.
 Perform controller tuning and operability assessments, collaborate with other sub-system and cross-functional teams for delivering on new products with high quality, from conceptual design to product validation stage; Project specific assessments to support new unit sales in ITO phase or project execution in OTR phase; Fleet issue resolution and root case analysis projects.
 Enable the realization of system level tradeoffs (Energy production v/s Loads, etc.) via application of controls technologies/solutions, to minimize turbine cost while pushing envelope on turbine performance and availability.
 Adopt new controller features and algorithms developed by the Controls organization as well as the ability to tune them to meet specific wind turbine systems trade-offs.
 Required Qualifications
 Master’s degree from an accredited university in Controls Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related disciplines with specialization in Controls.
 Familiarity with aspects of controls theory such as system modelling, closed-loop design, and closed-loop analysis.
 Knowledge in wind turbine controls tuning and optimization.
 Strong oral and written communication skills in English.
 Desired Characteristics
 Knowledge of high-fidelity multibody simulation (MBS) software for aeroelastic simulations (Simpack, Flex5, Bladed, Hawc2, Adams, etc.). Some years of aeroelastic simulation experience applied to wind turbines.
 Experience in controller code development for wind turbines. Wind turbine system design experience.
 Basic proficiency in Matlab/Python programming, as well as GitHub version control.
 Excellent communication, interpersonal, and presentation skills, including ability and willingness to work across cultural boundaries in a global team.
 Additional Information
 Relocation Assistance Provided: Yes

 Munich Apply Who we are 
 Founded in 2019, Marvel Fusion is Europe’s leading fusion energy company, uniting 120 scientists, engineers, and entrepreneurs across our locations in Munich and Colorado .   
 Backed by over €385 million in public and private funding, we’re driven by a shared mission: to deliver clean, abundant energy to the world.   
 Why Marvel Fusion 
 By joining us, you will be:
 Solving one of the most complex technological challenges known to humanity, harnessing Fusion on Earth
 Part of a highly purpose-driven team working on providing the world with clean, safe and abundant energy
 Working alongside world-leading scientists and entrepreneurs in the field of Fusion
 Part of a start-up where growth on a company and individual level is the default
 The impact you will make
 As a Technical Drafting Specialist – Mechanical Engineering, you will play an essential role in translating engineering concepts and design inputs into accurate, manufacturing-ready CAD models, technical drawings, and controlled documentation for complex precision mechanical systems.
 Working closely with mechanical, optomechanical, manufacturing, and integration engineers, you will support the complete drawing and documentation workflow—from initial design layouts and detailing through drawing release, manufacturing clarifications, assembly updates, and as-built documentation.
 Your responsibilities
 Create and update detailed 2D manufacturing drawings and 3D CAD models of mechanical components, precision devices, fixtures, and assemblies based on engineering specifications and design inputs.
 Apply drawing standards, GD&T, dimensional and geometric tolerances, fits, surface finish requirements, materials, and manufacturing notes; ensure clarity and completeness for suppliers and workshops.
 Prepare assembly drawings, exploded views, parts lists, bills of materials (BOMs), and drawing packages; maintain consistent part numbering, templates, and CAD libraries.
 Manage drawing revisions, release status, and technical records in the CAD/PDM environment; support engineering change requests and ensure traceability of design modifications.
 Coordinate with engineers, manufacturing suppliers, and assembly teams to resolve drawing questions, incorporate production feedback, check manufacturability, and update as-built documentation.
 What you bring
 Technical qualification in mechanical drafting, technical product design, mechanical design technology, or a related discipline (e.g., Technischer Produktdesigner); equivalent practical experience is welcome.
 Practical experience preparing manufacturing and assembly drawings for machined components, mechanical devices, precision assemblies, or industrial equipment.
 Strong proficiency in 2D/3D CAD software, preferably Autodesk Inventor; familiarity with Autodesk Vault or another PDM system is advantageous.
 Sound knowledge of engineering drawings, ISO GPS/GD&T, tolerances, fits, surface finishes, basic materials, and common manufacturing processes.
 Excellent attention to detail, structured document management, and ability to collaborate with design engineers, workshops, suppliers, and assembly technicians.
 What sets you apart
 Experience detailing precision machinery, molds, tooling, fixtures, optomechanical components, or scientific instrumentation.
 Ability to interpret complex assemblies and convert engineering sketches or preliminary CAD concepts into clear production-ready documentation.
 Experience with tolerance stack-ups, inspection drawings, CMM-related documentation, and design-for-manufacture principles.
 Familiarity with engineering change control, drawing release workflows, part numbering conventions, and CAD/PDM data quality.
 Proactive communication, strong organizational skills, and an interest in improving drafting standards, reusable templates, and documentation processes.
 What we offer
 Our mission is motivation enough for many. But we also support our team with benefits that foster wellbeing and growth:
 Public Transport Subsidy
 Employee Incentive Program
 Phone Bill Reimbursement
 Wellpass or Complimentary Private Health Insurance
 Professional Learning & Development Budget
 Relocation Support
 Company Pension Plan
 30 Days of Vacation plus additional half day on 24. & 31.Dec.
 Modern Office in the center of Munich
 Healthy office snacks
 Regular Team Events

Willkommen in der Welt von Brunel, wo Innovation nicht nur ein Schlagwort ist, sondern eine Lebenseinstellung. Bei uns geht es nicht nur um Arbeit; es geht darum, die Welt zu verändern, Technologie neu zu denken und die Grenzen des Machbaren zu erweitern.
Wir suchen nicht einfach nur Mitarbeiter; wir suchen Visionäre, Pioniere und diejenigen, die den Mut haben, Dinge anders zu sehen.
Wenn Sie bereit sind, den Status quo in Frage zu stellen und gemeinsam mit uns die Zukunft zu gestalten, dann bewerben Sie sich noch heute als Elektroingenieur für Fahrzeugtechnik.
### Ihre Aufgaben
- Sie sind für die Konzeption und Entwicklung fortschrittlicher elektrischer Systeme und Komponenten in Fahrzeugen verantwortlich.
- Sie arbeiten an der Integration und Optimierung von Elektromobilitätstechnologien, einschließlich Batteriemanagement und Ladesystemen.
- Sie entwickeln Kommunikationssysteme und Vernetzungslösungen, um die Fahrzeugkommunikation zu verbessern und zukünftige Technologien wie autonomes Fahren zu unterstützen.
- Sie führen Qualitätskontrollen und Tests durch, um sicherzustellen, dass elektrische Komponenten den höchsten Standards entsprechen.
- Sie tragen zur Entwicklung sicherer elektrischer Systeme bei, um die Sicherheit unserer Fahrzeuge und ihrer Insassen zu gewährleisten.
### Ihre Qualifikationen
- Abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Elektrotechnik, Fahrzeugtechnik, Mechatronik oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung
- Fundierte Kenntnisse in der Entwicklung und Integration von Elektroniksystemen für Fahrzeuge
- Erfahrung im Umgang mit Fahrzeugbussystemen (z.B. CAN, LIN, FlexRay) und Diagnoseprotokollen
- Kenntnisse in der Programmierung von Steuergeräten und der Nutzung von Entwicklungs- und Testtools (z.B. Vector, ETAS)
- Erfahrung mit Entwicklungsprozessen und Normen in der Fahrzeugtechnik (z.B. ISO 26262, ASPICE)
- Analytische und lösungsorientierte Denkweise mit hoher Problemlösungskompetenz
- Teamfähigkeit, Kommunikationsstärke und die Fähigkeit zur interdisziplinären Zusammenarbeit
- Gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
### Ihre Vorteile
Wir bieten Ihnen eine Unternehmenskultur, die geprägt ist von der Vielfältigkeit unserer Mitarbeiter sowie von gegenseitiger Wertschätzung - zwischen den Mitarbeitern und auf allen Unternehmensebenen. Dazu gehören neben abwechslungsreichen Stammtischen mit den lokalen Brunel Teams, auch regelmäßige Feedback-Gespräche über Ihre Herausforderungen und Perspektiven mit Ihrem Account Manager. Mit individuellen Fortbildungen und Trainings werden Sie optimal gefördert und auf zukünftige Projekte vorbereitet. Unbefristete Arbeitsverträge, 30 Tage Urlaub, Arbeitskontenregelung sowie betriebliche, arbeitgeberfinanzierte Altersvorsorge sind bei uns selbstverständlich.
### Dafür steht Brunel
Arbeiten bei Brunel bedeutet: Attraktive Arbeitsaufgaben, außergewöhnliche Karriereperspektiven, die Sicherheit eines expandierenden Ingenieurdienstleisters und die ganze Vielfalt des Engineerings und der IT. Allein in der DACH-CZ Region verfügen wir über mehr als 40 Standorte und Entwicklungszentren mit akkreditiertem Prüflabor und weltweit über 120 Standorte mit mehr als 12.000 Mitarbeitern in über 40 Ländern. Mehr als 45 Jahre international erfolgreich und über 25 Jahre in Deutschland. Stillstand bedeutet Rückschritt - mit Brunel können Sie etwas bewegen!

Job Description
 Rolls-Royce Deutschland offers an exciting opportunity for the position of Additive Manufacturing Design Engineer (f/m/d) in Dahlewitz, near Berlin.
The Additive Manufacturing Design Engineer (f/m/d) is part of the Global Mechanical Systems Capability function.
The Additive Manufacturing Design Engineer (f/m/d) shall create engineering solutions that satisfy functional and physical requirements at Product System and Sub-System level. Crucially, the engineered solutions must exhibit robustness for manufacturing capability. Investigation and exploration of innovative design concepts using Design for Additive Manufacturing (DfAM) principles is a key activity in this role. The position will be part of an Additive Manufacturing Design Team to support applications across the whole aeroengine architecture within the global RR organization.
The Additive Manufacturing Design Engineer (f/m/d) is responsible for the on-time delivery and quality of component design definition artefacts i.e. documents, models, definitions that meet system level and sub-system requirements. The Additive Manufacturing Design Engineer will operate in accordance with applicable Rolls-Royce Management System (RRMS) policies and processes.
The Additive Manufacturing Design Engineer (f/m/d) is responsible for sub-system integration of the technical activities for their design solutions and enabling lifecycle profitability through the Supply Chain Design.
The position offers the opportunity to further develop your skills in the field of additive manufacturing design in an innovative environment and closely linked to current and future aeroengine programs within RR.
 Key Accountabilities
 Develop robust design solutions that consider manufacturability, safety, weight, lifecycle costs, maintainability, and reparability.
 Translate system requirements into technical drawings, models, and documentation in accordance with internal guidelines (e.g., Model-Based Definition).
 Re-design conventionally manufactured components into additive manufacturing solutions using advanced design and optimization software.
 Collaborate closely with manufacturing, analysis teams, suppliers, and other key stakeholders – both internally and externally.
 Support sub-system integration of technical solutions throughout the entire product lifecycle.
 Ensure quality by reviewing technical documents in compliance with the Rolls-Royce Management System (RRMS).
 Use analytical methods and tools for dimensioning and validating parts and assemblies.
 Manage product configuration and ensure data integrity.
 Your Profile
 Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Production Technology, or a comparable qualification
 Minimum of 2 years of experience in design or manufacturing engineering, ideally in the field of Additive Manufacturing
 Strong knowledge of mechanical design principles and understanding of related disciplines (e.g., manufacturing engineering, thermodynamics, aerodynamics)
 Experience with DfAM and relevant optimization/CAD software
 Analytical mindset and structured approach to problem solving
 Familiarity with product certification and integrity frameworks is a plus
 Excellent communication and presentation skills in English. Knowledge of German is an asset.

Job Description
 Position/ Role: Validation/ Characterization Engineer 
 The LP-SPS team works on high side switches and controllers. SPS products are responsible in protecting sensitive electronics used in automotive and industrial applications. We develop Functional Safe (ASIL-B or above rated) smart eFuses and HSSC for Zonal architectures in EV and BEV vehicles. We are developing GaN based solutions to support the 48V automotive battery rails. We also develop products which help protect the L2+ ADAS systems. This is a high visibility and high growth product area. We are looking for a highly motivated and agile Silicon Characterization engineer with strong technical skills who can lead validation efforts on across the HSS and HSSC portfolios.
 What will you be doing in this role? (Responsibilities and Opportunities)
 Responsibilities
 As a member of the SPS validation team, you will be responsible for validating any of the 48V/24V/12V automotive or industrial HSS or high side switch controller products including products based on MV GaN. Validation work will involve the following:
 Work with the product definition and design team before device availability to thoroughly understand validation requirements, including device-level and system-level specifications. 
 Define, own, and drive a comprehensive validation test plan and schedule that covers every specification in the VVCM, the datasheet, and required functional tests, ensuring full traceability and on‑time delivery of results. 
 Design and build validation PCBs using Cadence Allegro X that meet high-voltage high-current and power integrity requirements while leveraging and integrating with existing validation hardware infrastructure. 
 Define the Validation Strategy in terms of Hardware, Software and Instrumentation for newer customer process and IP requirements 
 Build reusable, automated test sequences using Python to execute the validation plan, collect characterization data across multiple devices and test conditions, and drive execution of all functional tests. 
 Analyze characterization data collected across multiple devices and test conditions against VVCM specifications to assess device compliance, verify that all functional tests have defined pass/fail criteria, and confirm all tests have passed prior to validation sign-off. 
 Drive cross-functional reviews covering validation hardware, test results, and debug findings with stakeholders across design, systems, applications, and test engineering teams. 
 Perform datasheet plot generation; apply statistical analysis (distributions, Cpk, limit capability) to assess spec margins and drive datasheet limit decisions. 
 Investigate unexpected behavior when observed during validation through structured design of experiments (DoE) to narrow down the root cause — whether an error in stimulus, error in hardware, or a suspect on-device circuit block — and drive resolution with the design team. 
 Maintain clear, thorough documentation of validation test plans, test procedures, and debug findings. 
 Author concise validation summaries that include all test results for cross-functional reviews and program records. 
 Qualifications
 Knowledge and Skills expected:
 Self-driven with a strong sense of ownership — able to independently plan and execute validation work from test plan definition through sign-off with minimal direction. 
 Strong analog, power and mixed-signal fundamentals and ability to translate that into practical circuits useful for test and measurement and debug 
 Proven ability to thrive in a fast‑paced, results‑driven development environment.

Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.
 We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.
 Here’s what this particular role covers.
 🛠️ About our AI Platform Team 
 Our AI Platform teams build the foundations that enable Wayve’s machine learning engineers and researchers to train, evaluate and deploy models at scale. Within the AI Libraries team, you’ll create high-quality platforms, tools and reusable abstractions that support thousands of GPUs and help accelerate the development of our autonomous-driving technology.
   🧠 Your day-to-day 
 You’ll work closely with machine learning teams to understand their workflows and turn complex requirements into stable, scalable and intuitive software. You’ll spend much of your time designing and writing Python, leading projects from discovery through delivery, improving engineering standards and supporting users as they push the scale and performance of their models.
 🧩 What you’ll be working on 
 You’ll build modular libraries for areas such as multimodal data loading, distributed training and inference, checkpointing and observability. You’ll improve the reliability, performance and developer experience of systems used across Wayve, helping teams train models efficiently on large GPU clusters and work with camera, radar, lidar and other data sources.
   🙌 You should apply if 
 You have extensive Python experience and a track record of designing, delivering and maintaining high-quality software systems at scale. You understand software architecture, testing and observability, and have experience with concurrent, parallel or distributed computing. Familiarity with ML frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow and cloud environments—ideally Azure—is highly valuable. This is a software and platform engineering role rather than an ML modelling position.
   🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.
   More about Wayve: 
 🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines.
 Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility.
   How we work 💻- Locations & Flexible Working: 
 Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives.
   🔍 The Interview Process: 
 Our process is clear and respectful of your time:
 Recruiter screen 
 Competency Interviews 
 Deep-dive technical interviews 
 Final interview 
 We’ll always explain the format and work around your availability.
   What’s in it for you (Location dependant): 
 💰 Salaries benchmarked against the market annually
📈 Meaningful equity, sharing in the ownership and long term success of Wayve
✈️ Relocation support and visa sponsorship where applicable
✅ Hybrid working, core hours and the chance to work hands on in vehicle workshops and labs
📚 Learning and development budgets with support for training, conferences and growth
🩺 Comprehensive benefits including health insurance, dental, enhanced maternity and paternity leave, retirement or pension where applicable, access to therapists, wellbeing partnerships, team socials and more
 A quick, honest note before you apply.
 Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one.
 If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend your time on, we’d really like to hear from you.
