# Projekt-/ Bauleitung für Gebäude- und Energietechnik (HLS) im Fachbereich Hochbauservice, Technische Gebäudeausrüstung (m/w/d)
Der drittgrößte Bezirk Steglitz-Zehlendorf liegt im Südwesten Berlins und bietet ein Wohlfühlklima für alle Menschen. Dazu gehören die acht Ortsteile: Dahlem, Lankwitz, Lichterfelde, Nikolassee, Schlachtensee, Steglitz, Wannsee und Zehlendorf. So unterschiedlich unsere Ortsteile auch sein mögen - so unterschiedlich sind auch unsere rund 311.000 Einwohner mit ihren Bedürfnissen. Es sollen sich alle in Steglitz-Zehlendorf wohlfühlen, das ist das Ziel der Bezirksverwaltung.
**Dienststelle:** Die Serviceeinheit Facility Management des Bezirksamtes Steglitz-Zehlendorf von Berlin
**Geplanter Eintritt:** ab sofort
**Besoldungsgruppe:** A 11
**Entgeltgruppe:** EG 11 TV-L 
**Hinweise:** 
**Für Tarifbeschäftigte:** Bei Erfüllung der persönlichen Voraussetzungen wird in begründeten Einzelfällen die Gewährung einer Fachkräftezulage geprüft.
**Für Beamte:** Für neu gewonnene Fachkräfte, die bereits in einem Beamtenverhältnis außerhalb des Landes Berlin stehen, ist in begründeten Einzelfällen die Zahlung einer nicht ruhegehaltsfähigen Personalgewinnungsprämie möglich.
**Arbeitszeit:** Vollzeit - Die Beschäftigung von Teilzeitkräften ist möglich, sofern der Arbeitsplatz ganztägig besetzt ist. 
**Wochenstunden:** 40 bzw. 39,4
**Standort:** Auf dem Grat 2, 14195 Berlin
**Bewerbungsfrist:** 23.12.2026
## Ihre Aufgaben
**Fachbauleitung für die Gewerke Heizung, Lüftung, Sanitär einschließlich MSR und Technischem Brandschutz und Technischen Anlagen in Außenanlagen (KG 410-430, 470-490, 550, 220-230)** 
1. Wahrnehmung der delegierbaren und nicht-delegierbaren Bauherrenaufgaben bei großen und kleinen Neu-, Um- und Erweiterungsbauten sowie bei Erneuerungs- und Bauunterhaltungsmaßnahmen in den Liegenschaften des Bezirks
2. Prüfen und Bewerten von Planungs- und Ausschreibungsunterlagen
3. Mitarbeit bei der Planung nach Lph 1-9 der HOAI, Aufstellung von Bauplanungsunterlagen, Planung von Sanierungsarbeiten
4. Entwicklung von Sanierungskonzepten
5. Kostenermittlung und Kostenkontrolle, Terminüberwachung, Sicherstellung der baufachlichen Qualitäten und Standards bei der Vorbereitung und Ausführung von Baumaßnahmen
6. Betreuung der Wartungs- und Instandhaltungsarbeiten sowie Störfallmanagement
7. Baufachliche Abstimmungen mit Gebäudenutzern, Bedarfsträgern, Prüf- und Sachverständigen, Planern, Gutachtern, Sonderfachleuten und den genehmigenden Stellen und Mitarbeit bei der Aufstellung von Bedarfsplanungen
8. Erstellen der Leistungsbilder und Verträge bzw. Nachträge für einzuschaltende freiberuflich Tätige sowie bauausführender Firmen
9. Mitwirkung durch fachtechnische Vorgaben für den Vertragsabschluss
**Weitere Aufgaben können dem beigefügten Anforderungsprofil über den Button „weitere Informationen“ entnommen werden. Das Anforderungsprofil stellt die verbindliche Grundlage für die Auswahlentscheidung dar.** 
## Ihr Profil
**Beamte:** 
Erfüllung der laufbahnrechtlichen Voraussetzungen für die Laufbahngruppe 2, erstes Einstiegsamt, Fachrichtung bautechnischer Dienst
**Tarifbeschäftigte:**
Mindestens abgeschlossenes Fachhochschulstudium (Bachelor/Dipl.-Ing. (FH)) der Fachrichtung:
 - Gebäude- und Energietechnik oder
 - Gebäudetechnik und Energiemanagement oder
 - Versorgungs- und Energietechnik,
 - bzw. sonstige Beschäftigte mit gleichwertigen Fähigkeiten und Erfahrungen.
**Für beide gilt:** 
Mehrjährige (mindestens 2 Jahre) nachgewiesene Berufserfahrungen im Projektmanagement oder in der Projektsteuerung mit bautechnisch komplexen Baumaßnahmen, großen Bauprojekten und Umbaumaßnahmen im Bestand und laufendem Betrieb.
**Nachweise sind der Bewerbung beizufügen.** 
**Hinweise:**
Es können sich auch Meister bzw. staatliche geprüfter Techniker in den oben aufgeführten Bereichen mit nachgewiesenen entsprechenden beruflichen Kenntnissen und Fähigkeiten bzw. qualifizierten Fort-/ Weiterbildungsnachweisen in diesem Bereich bewerben.
Bei Bewerbungen von Personen, die aufgrund gleichwertiger Fähigkeiten und ihrer Erfahrungen entsprechende Tätigkeiten ausüben, wird geprüft, ob die Voraussetzungen als „Sonstige Beschäftigte“ vorliegen; die tarifliche Eingruppierung erfolgt nach den individuellen nachgewiesenen persönlichen Voraussetzungen.
**Fachliche Kompetenzen:**
 - Kenntnisse der Heizungstechnik einschl. Regelungstechnik und der einschlägigen Regelwerke wie DIN, AMEV, ASR usw.
 - Kenntnisse der Sanitärtechnik einschl. der Regelwerke wie DIN, VDI, TrinkwV usw.
**Außerfachliche Kompetenzen:**
 - Leistungs-, Lern- und Veränderungsfähigkeit
 - Organisationsfähigkeit
 - Ziel- und Ergebnisorientierung
## Benefits
Weiterbildung
Weiterbildung wird bei uns großgeschrieben. Mit vielseitigen Fortbildungen, internen Schulungen und Angeboten zur Entwicklung individueller Kompetenzen gestalten Sie Ihre berufliche Zukunft aktiv mit. 
Homeoffice
Flexibel arbeiten, wo es für Sie passt: Bis zu 40 % der Arbeitszeit mobil – für mehr Eigenverantwortung, weniger Pendelstress und mehr Effizienz im Alltag. 
Ein kollegiales Arbeitsklima 
Starten Sie gut begleitet mit professionellem Onboarding, offenem Miteinander, gelebter Vielfalt. Beim Einstieg oder im Alltag - Wissen teilen wir gern per Mentoring, Wissensmanagement und Teamspirit.
Arbeiten für das Gemeinwohl
Arbeit, die wirklich wirkt – sinnstiftend und bürgernah. Für die Menschen in Berlin, im Bezirk, im Kiez. Wir unterstützen Sie mit Firmenticket und Altersvorsorge – für heute und später. 
Flexible Arbeitszeiten
Vereinbarkeit von Beruf und Privatem leichtgemacht: mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten, Gleitzeit, Teilzeit und
...

Wir besetzen diese Position im Auftrag eines Kunden in Duisburg.
Ihr Job
 - Sie planen Anlagen der Wasser- und Abwassertechnik wie Pumpenanlagen, Rückhaltebecken, Kläranlagen und Systeme zur Wasseraufbereitung
 - Darüber hinaus erstellen Sie Unterlagen für Arbeitsvorbereitung, Fertigung, Montage sowie Kundendokumentationen inklusive As-Built-Zeichnungen
 - Sie legen Komponenten wie Pumpen, Wärmetauscher und Filteranlagen aus und dimensionieren diese entsprechend der Projektanforderungen
 - Zudem erstellen Sie Prozess- und Instrumentierungsfließbilder (P&ID) und entwickeln das Basic Design von Rohrleitungssystemen
 - Die Systemintegration von Zukaufkomponenten wie Sauerstoff-Erzeugungsanlagen, Wasseraufbereitungsanlagen oder Wärmepumpen gehört ebenfalls zu Ihrem Verantwortungsbereich
Ihr Potential
 - Mit Freude und Erfolg absolviertes Studium der Verfahrenstechnik oder eine Technikerweiterbildung
 - Sie bringen erste Erfahrungen im Bereich Anlagenbau, Gebäudetechnik, Wasser- und/oder Abwassertechnik mit, bspw. durch ein Praktikum oder eine Projektarbeit
 - Sie verfügen idealerweise über Kenntnisse in der Schweißtechnik und Werkstofftechnik
 - Neben sehr guten Deutschkenntnissen (C1) bringen Sie gute Englischkenntnisse (B2) mit
 - Sie arbeiten strukturiert und analytisch, verfügen über ausgeprägtes technisches Verständnis, Koordinationsfähigkeit sowie Kommunikationsstärke in interdisziplinären Projektteams
Ihre Chance
 - Unser Kunde ist ein spezialisiertes Planungsbüro für kommunale Wasser- und Abwasseranlagen mit klarer fachlicher Ausrichtung und hoher Projekttiefe
 - Es erwartet Sie eine attraktive, leistungsgerechte Vergütung in einem stabilen Umfeld
 - Profitieren Sie von flexiblen Arbeitszeiten sowie einer Homeoffice-Regelung für eine moderne Arbeitsgestaltung
 - Arbeiten Sie in einem engagierten, interdisziplinären Team mit kurzen Abstimmungswegen und fachlichem Austausch auf Augenhöhe
 - Eine strukturierte und zielgerichtete Einarbeitung sorgt dafür, dass Sie schnell Verantwortung übernehmen können
Wir freuen uns über Ihre Bewerbung mit Angabe der Referenznummer und einem Hinweis, wie Sie auf uns aufmerksam geworden sind.
Seit über 50 Jahren bringen wir Menschen mit dem zusammen, was sie begeistert. In unseren sechs Fachbereichen Maschinen- und Anlagenbau, Fahrzeugtechnik, Energietechnik, Elektrotechnik sowie Bauwesen & TGA bringen unsere Mitarbeiter ihr Know-How genau dort ein, wo es gebraucht wird - in abwechslungsreichen Engineering-Projekten. Werden auch Sie Teil des Teams und verbinden Sie das klassische Ingenieurwesen mit der digitalen Zukunft.

Institution
 Chair of Thermodynamics of Mobile Energy Conversion Systems
 Our Profile
 At the Chair of Thermodynamics of Mobile Energy Conversion Systems (TME) and the Center for Mobile Propulsion (CMP) under the direction of Prof. Dr.-Ing. (USA) Stefan Pischinger, research on all topics concerning the vehicle powertrain is conducted. Core focus is still the research on conventional combustion engine development like the implementation of innovative engine designs, fundamental research on more efficient combustion processes also in combination with alternative fuels or the improvement of the engine mechanics and aftertreatment systems. Additional research areas include virtual engine development, hybrid powertrains, electromobility as well as fuel cells and mechatronics for combustion engines. At any time research is closely associated with the ongoing development of intelligent methods for test procedures and engine calibration. The Chair of Thermodynamics of Mobile Energy Conversion Systems employs more than 260 scientific, technical and administrative employees as well as student assistants.
 Your Profile
 Completed college degree (Master's degree or equivalent) in electrical engineering and physics or chemistry
 Previous experience in the following areas is useful for the successful completion of the doctorate.
 Specialist knowledge in the field of battery cell and system technology, ideally:
 Functionality of various cell chemistries and components
 Electrical, mechanical and thermal behavior of battery cells
 Cell ageing and safety
 Cell testing and chem. Characterization
 Fluent in german and english
 Required soft skills:
 quick comprehension
 independent working style
 work well in a team
 interest in publishing research papers
 Your Duties And Responsibilities
 Fields of activity:
 Electrical testing
 Safety testing
 Chemical analysis
 Customer support
 Working on publicly funded projects
 Job description: In this position, you will work on the development and optimization of lithium-ion cells. Your tasks will include electrical and safety testing of the cells, carrying out chemical analyses and supporting our customers. You will also be involved in publicly funded projects and document their progress.
Research and development: You can expect exciting research and development topics in the field of lithium-ion cells. You will work on the further development of test methods and analysis procedures to improve the performance and safety of our cells. The specific research topic can be defined together in order to make the best possible use of your interests and strengths.
Cooperation and practical relevance: Close cooperation with leading industrial partners ensures a practical and industry-oriented focus for your doctorate. You will work in an interdisciplinary team and benefit from the expertise of experienced scientists and engineers.
 What We Offer
 The successful candidate will be employed under a regular employment contract. The position is to be filled at the earliest possible date and offered for a fixed term of 1 year. Continued employment for up to 3 years is provided, with the possibility of a 4th year extension. The fixed-term employment is possible as it constitutes one of the fixed-term options of the Wissenschaftszeitvertragsgesetz (German Act on Fixed-term Scientific Contracts). This is a full-time position. The successful candidate has the opportunity to pursue a doctoral degree in this position. The salary is based on the German public service salary scale (TV-L). The position corresponds to a pay grade of EG 13 TV-L.
 About Us
 RWTH is proud to be certified as a family-friendly university. We welcome and encourage applications from all qualified candidates and make employment decisions without regard to national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, disability or age. RWTH is especially committed to supporting the advancement of women in academia. When women are underrepresented in a university unit, preferential consideration will be given to female applicants among candidates of equal merit and professional standing, unless compelling reasons favor another individual. In keeping with RWTH's commitment to equality of opportunity, we ask that you do not include a photo with your application. Please refer to https://www.rwth-aachen.de/applicant-privacy-policy for information about how we collect and process applicant data in accordance with Articles 13 and 14 of the European Union's General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).

 🚀 What you'll do 
 Partner solutions & delivery

 We move fast, solve hard problems, and build things that matter. If you want ownership, real impact, and a front-row seat to one of the most consequential infrastructure shifts of the decade — this is the place.
 THE ROLE: DEPLOYMENT ENGINEER 
 GPU capacity only starts serving customers once it's physically built and handed over, and our deployment pipeline now has more cluster builds lined up than our current onsite team can cover at once. We're adding Deployment Engineers to keep each build moving on schedule across our international data centre sites.
 This is a hands-on role for someone who takes pride in a clean rack and an accurate cable map.  WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.
 We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.
 Here’s what this particular role covers.
 🛠️ About our Data Enrichment Platform Team 
 Our Enrichment Orchestration team builds the platform that enables Wayve’s teams to deploy, run, evaluate and continually improve machine-learning models. Processing petabytes of driving data across large GPU fleets, the team creates dependable, self-service capabilities that help model engineers understand model performance, improve quality and reduce operational effort and cost. 
 🧠 Your day-to-day 
 Design, build and operate backend services, APIs and data-processing workflows for the Data Enrichment Platform.
 Develop model-execution workflows, versioned outputs, annotation capabilities and dataset-catalogue features.
 Improve the scalability and reliability of systems for large-scale inference, automated evaluation and model monitoring. 
 Investigate and resolve reliability, performance and cost issues across petabyte-scale data and GPU-backed workloads.
 Contribute to designs covering data locality, scheduling, capacity, backpressure, failure recovery and observability.
 Collaborate with model engineering, AI Platform, infrastructure, compute, storage and data teams to deliver reusable capabilities. 
 Write maintainable, tested and observable software while improving documentation, operational tooling and engineering standards.
 🧩 What you’ll be working on 
 A scalable platform for large-scale inference, automated evaluation, model monitoring, active learning and retraining.
 Backend services and APIs that allow model engineers to deploy and operate repeatable workflows independently.
 Reproducible dataset selection, versioned outputs, annotation workflows and dataset catalogues with clear metadata, provenance and lineage.
 Reliable model-execution workflows operating across petabytes of driving data and large GPU fleets.
 Monitoring and operational tooling that make platform reliability, throughput, cost and workflow status visible.
 The foundations for continuous evaluation, drift detection and automated model-improvement loops across robotics and computer-vision workloads. 
 🙌 You should apply if 
 You have strong production software-engineering experience in Python, including building maintainable, tested and observable backend services, APIs or data-processing systems. 
 You have experience designing, building or operating distributed systems for data-intensive or compute-intensive workloads.
 You have delivered reliable software from design through deployment and production operation.
 You have good system-design fundamentals and can make sound technical trade-offs within a complex platform.
 You are comfortable investigating unfamiliar systems and diagnosing reliability, performance or operational issues.
 You communicate clearly, collaborate effectively across teams and can take meaningful ownership of production components.
 Experience with Flyte, Airflow, Dagster, Argo, Spark, Databricks, Ray, Kubernetes, GPU infrastructure or ML-platform systems would be an advantage.
 You have hands-on experience with robotics, autonomous-vehicle or computer-vision datasets, including sensor data, annotations or model outputs.
 You have a practical understanding of 3D geometry for robotics or computer vision, including coordinate frames, rigid transformations, camera calibration and projection of 3D points into images.
 You have experience validating sensor data or model outputs, including investigating spatial or temporal misalignment and implementing checks for correctness.
 Specific experience with 3D object detection, segmentation, tracking or ego motion would be an advantage. Experience developing or training perception models is not required.
🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.
   More about Wayve: 
 🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines.
 Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility.
   How we work 💻- Locations & Flexible Working: 
 Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives.
   🔍 The Interview Process 
 Our process is clear and respectful of your time
 Initial call / Talent Partner screen (30 mins)
 Competency interviews : Python coding (60 mins), System design (60 mins)
 Deep Dive Interview: Hiring Manager interview (45 mins) 
 Final interview : Mission and values (45 mins)
We’ll always explain the format and work around your availability.
   What’s in it for you (Location dependant): 
 💰 Salaries benchmarked against the market annually
📈 Meaningful equity, sharing in the ownership and long term success of Wayve
✈️ Relocation support and visa sponsorship where applicable
✅ Hybrid working, core hours and the chance to work hands on in vehicle workshops and labs
📚 Learning and development budgets with support for training, conferences and growth
🩺 Comprehensive benefits including health insurance, dental, enhanced maternity and paternity leave, retirement or pension where applicable, access to therapists, wellbeing partnerships, team socials and more
 A quick, honest note before you apply.
 Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one.
 If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend your time on, we’d really like to hear from you.

Die Fraunhofer-Gesellschaft ist eine der weltweit führenden Organisationen für anwendungsorientierte Forschung. 74 Institute entwickeln wegweisende Technologien für unsere Wirtschaft und Gesellschaft – genauer: 30 000 Menschen aus Technik, Wissenschaft, Verwaltung und IT. Die Region Stuttgart zählt zu den innovationsstärksten Metropolregionen Europas. Als Impulsstelle zwischen Wissenschaft und Wirtschaft spielt das Fraunhofer Institutszentrum Stuttgart IZS dabei eine wichtige Rolle. Es umfasst fünf Institute (Fraunhofer IAO, IBP, IGB, IPA und IRB) und ist mit einem Betriebshaushalt von über 117,4 Millionen Euro, mehr als 2 000 Mitarbeitenden und einer Fläche von 100 000 Quadratmetern das zweitgrößte Forschungszentrum der Fraunhofer-Gesellschaft.
Die Fraunhofer IZS-Campusdienste verantworten als interner Dienstleister institutsübergreifende Aufgaben am Forschungscampus Stuttgart. 
Das IZS-Sachgebiet »Gebäudetechnik« hat die Schwerpunkte Betriebssicherheit der Technischen Gebäudeausrüstung (TGA), Bau- und Sanierungsmaßnahmen und Instandhaltung von Gebäuden und Versorgungsanlagen am Campus Stuttgart.

About us
 We love pets - which is why we’re on a mission to make the world a better place for pets and their parents.  We offer pet insurance policies with generous pet health benefits that are designed with their needs in mind. We’ve helped half a million pets stay happy and healthy since 2017 - and many more customers throughout the world are joining us every day.  Our company is respectful, fun-loving and passionate about pets and their wellbeing.  Throughout our business you'll meet people who think differently, aim for impact, and love to try new things.  Want to join our pack?  Join us. Love every moment. Love ManyPets.
 A day in the life 
 As a Platform Engineer, you will initially join our platform squad. We build and maintain the AWS infrastructure, deployment pipelines, tooling and engineering standards that every other squad at ManyPets depends on.
 This role has a strong security focus, and it will become more security focused over time. Much of the work is compliance and assurance: building and running the tooling that checks our cloud estate against our security standards, writing the scripts that turn a manual check into a scheduled one, gathering the evidence we need for ISO 27001 and our other obligations, and supporting the audits that depend on it. Alongside that you will help us tighten access controls across our cloud estate, and take on ownership of the edge and network security tooling that protects our services.
 Over time this role moves across to work directly with our Head of Security as we build out a dedicated security function at ManyPets. You will help shape what that function does and how it works, rather than inheriting something already built.
 Our environment is fast-paced and highly collaborative. You will work closely with your teammates using pair or mob programming, participating in regular workshops and planning sessions, primarily over Zoom, with occasional in-person collaboration.
 We embrace modern development practices: 
 · All our services are cloud-hosted on AWS, using serverless and event-driven architectures for scalability and resilience.
 · We use a fully automated deployment pipeline, allowing you to release to production within minutes, multiple times per day.
 · We define our infrastructure as code, and we emphasise observability, testing and secure-by-design principles from the start.
 As a squad we own our work end-to-end, including development, maintenance and support. You will play a key role in ensuring the reliability and quality of what we provide to the rest of engineering, and contribute to a culture of rapid learning and continuous improvement.
 Your responsibilities 
 ü Build and maintain secure platform foundations 
 o Design, build and maintain the shared cloud infrastructure, tooling and deployment pipelines that other squads rely on.
 o Define infrastructure as code so our environments are consistent, repeatable and reviewable.
 o Make secure configuration the default, so squads get it without having to ask for it.
 o Maintain the edge and network security tooling that protects our services.
 o Share in the day-to-day operational ownership of the platform, responding to requests and issues raised by other squads.
 Make our security posture measurable 
 o Automate the gathering of evidence for ISO 27001 and our other compliance obligations, so that an audit means pulling a report rather than running a manual exercise.
 o Write the scripts and small services that turn a manual security check into a scheduled, repeatable one.
 o Triage findings from our scanning and posture tooling such as Aikido and Ascidian, work out which ones actually matter, and either fix them or get them in front of the team that can.
 o Work with our Head of Security to turn written policy into controls that are enforced by tooling.
 Strengthen access and identity controls 
 o Review and tighten access across our cloud accounts, working towards least privilege.
 o Improve how we manage secrets, credentials and machine identities.
 o Make access changes auditable, and straightforward for engineers to request and for us to review.
 Extend our platform standards beyond AWS 
 o Help us apply the standards, tooling and controls we have built in AWS to our Google Cloud estate.
 o Work with the teams who use Google Cloud to understand their needs and where the gaps are.
 Team collaboration 
 o Work closely with other squad members and stakeholders to align on goals and solutions.
 o Support engineers across other squads who use our platform, and take their feedback seriously.
 o Proactively build shared understanding across the team through pairing, discussions, and reviews.
 o Document your work clearly to support knowledge sharing and future maintenance.
 Self development 
 o Take ownership of your learning journey and technical development plan.
 o Approach challenges with curiosity and a growth mindset.
 o Learn from your peers and actively seek feedback and mentorship.
 Your skills and experience 
 We are looking for someone with: 
 · Commercial experience building and maintaining cloud infrastructure on a major cloud provider (AWS, Google Cloud or Azure).
 · Hands-on experience defining infrastructure as code.
 · Experience building and maintaining continuous integration and deployment pipelines.
 · A good working understanding of cloud security fundamentals.
 · Proficiency in at least one scripting language, ideally Python.
 · Comfort working in a regulated environment. We are FCA regulated and take our ISO 27001 commitments seriously.
 You will also need at least one current associate-level cloud certification: 
 · AWS: Solutions Architect Associate, Developer Associate or SysOps Administrator Associate. We would also be interested in the AWS Certified Security Speciality.
 · Google Cloud: Associate Cloud Engineer.
 · Microsoft Azure: Administrator Associate (AZ-104) or Security Engineer Associate (AZ-500).
 Entry-level certifications such as AWS Cloud Practitioner, Google Cloud Digital Leader and Azure Fundamentals do not meet this on their own. Please include the certification name and your credential ID or badge link with your application.
 We would also like to see at least one of the following. You do not need both, and we will support you to build the other:
 · A security specialism, where you can tell us about security or compliance tooling you have built and what it caught.
 · Experience across more than one cloud provider, ideally both AWS and Google Cloud.
 The interview process 
 This position has a four-stage interview process, which will be held via Zoom.
 · Stage 1 - an initial conversation with a member of our Talent team.
 · Stage 2 - an informal meeting with the hiring manager for about 45 minutes. We will explain more about the role and explore how your experience matches up with what we need.
 · Stage 3 - a longer interview, up to an hour, with the hiring manager and two engineers from the team. We will ask some competency questions and work through a technical scenario together. There is no take-home exercise.
 · Stage 4 - an informal conversation with our Head of Security.
 About the team 
 The EPD ("Engineering, Product and Design") team operates with a squad system and Agile ways of working within quarterly terms - and we really enjoy working collaboratively. We hold regular ‘Hack Weeks’ to look at products and address problems relating to the business, and we get the chance to highlight and work on things we’re interested in and feel passionately about.

Your Mission:

As an Electrical Systems Designer, you will join the Vehicle Systems team and contribute to the development and certification of the VÆRIDION Microliners’ Low-Voltage (LV) electrical and avionics systems. Your primary responsibility will be to mature the physical installation of the aircraft’s LV electrical and avionics systems, including LV EWIS routing and installation for all vehicle systems, guiding the design from concept through detailed design and release. You will translate system, interface and certification requirements into practical design solutions and take ownership of the associated 3D models, installation assemblies, wiring diagrams, and manufacturing drawings.

You will work closely with the Propulsion, Systems, and Structures teams, as well as external development partners, to resolve integration challenges and deliver practical design solutions throughout the aircraft development cycle.

The role will have a strong focus on hands-on CAD design, complemented by engineering analysis and certification activities. You will have the opportunity to define and mature the installation of LV electric systems currently being developed. Every day will bring new challenges, and you will be given a healthy amount of responsibility and autonomy, always supported by the team.

 

Your Day-to-Day:

 - Mature the LV electrical and avionics systems installation from concept through detailed design and release, integrating it into the aircraft digital mock-up (DMU).

 - Design and detail mechanical components for equipment and LV EWIS installation, such as, brackets, supports, interfaces and assemblies in accordance with applicable aerospace design standards and manufacturing methods.

 - Create and maintain complex 3D parts, assemblies, electrical diagrams and installation models using CATIA V6 within the 3DEXPERIENCE platform.

 - Prepare and release electrical schematics, electrical diagrams, detailed single part and assembly drawings, ensuring accuracy and compliance with industry standards.

 - Oversee the documentation process to ensure all drawings are up-to-date and correctly integrated within the PLM system.

 - Develop installation solutions that account for structural integrity, environmental conditions, separation, accessibility, installation sequence, removal envelopes, inspection and maintainability.

 - Perform technical assessments and trade studies to support design decisions and system maturation.

 - Collaborate directly with external development partners and suppliers, providing technical direction, reviewing deliverables and ensuring consistency with aircraft-level requirements.

 - Support the resolution of installation, manufacturing and assembly issues arising during prototype assembly and aircraft integration

 - Ensure adherence to all engineering processes and standards and participate in design reviews to meet development and certification goals.

items.jobDescription:
At our company, it's all about #OneTeam! Join gridscale and help shape the future of the cloud together with OVH.
 As a leading tech company, we've been working for over two decades to reduce our environmental footprint - with innovative solutions and an open cloud designed to be sustainable from the ground up: #SustainableByDesign.
 Within our #OneTeam, you'll shape the automation-first framework that lets every product team ship securely and at speed on top of OPCP, our On-Prem Cloud Platform.
 Our Tech Stack 🚀 
 · Kubernetes · GitOps · FluxCD / ArgoCD · Ansible · Terraform · OpenStack · Linux · CI/CD
 · Python · Bash · Go · Observability (Metrics, Logs, Traces) · LLMs · Agentic Coding Tooling
 Your Role💻 
 As a Site Reliability Engineer, you'll work at the intersection of platform engineering, AI-driven tooling and security by design. Together with your team, you'll build the framework to package and deploy software solutions on top of OPCP - turning vague product ideas into repeatable, observable and self-healing services. You'll work on the conception, automation and operation of the platform, drive continuous improvements and help new teams onboard with the framework and OPCP. Working hand in hand with developers, security specialists and AI researchers, you keep an overview in ambiguous situations, analyze systems and make well-founded decisions based on that analysis.
 AI-assisted engineering is part of our daily toolchain because it materially improves how we build and operate the platform – from spec-driven development with LLM assistance and knowledge-base-driven retrieval for incident response and design to agentic coding workflows and faster runbook authoring and review. We are investing in this direction as a structural part of our engineering practice and are looking for teammates who already work this way – not because it is trendy, but because they have seen it compound their own output.
 Your Tasks 
 Design, build and maintain the Cloud Store packaging framework that standardizes how software is delivered on OPCP.
 Extend and evolve the AI substrate - LLM-driven code assistants, knowledge-base retrieval and agentic coding hooks - that amplifies our engineering output.
 Create and curate agentic coding environments : custom agents and sub-agents, slash commands, hooks and prompt engineering pipelines that become everyday developer tools.
 Own the knowledge-base layer that powers AI-driven incident response, design assistance and runbook generation.
 Drive our Kubernetes stack forward and implement robust GitOps pipelines (FluxCD / ArgoCD) for continuous delivery.
 Write, publish and continuously improve OPCP onboarding runbooks and best-practice guides for internal product teams.
 Analyze opaque system behavior, surface root causes and deliver concrete, data-backed improvement proposals - even when initial requirements are unclear.
 Develop, version and operate the Infrastructure as Code stack (Terraform, Ansible) that underpins the platform, and take part in our on-call rotation .
 What we offer you💼 
 AI-augmented engineering as a first-class workflow - including agentic coding tooling, knowledge bases as the backbone of our AI workflows and room to push our engineering practices further
 Exceptional team spirit across all departments and national borders; we live #OneTeam
 Exciting work in a highly innovative and international environment with cutting-edge technologies
 32 vacation days, increasing with length of service
 Flexible working hours, home office options, and a secure permanent position with market- and performance-based compensation
 Employer-funded pension plan and an attractive insurance package
 OVHcloud covers 50% of public transportation costs
 Up to €400 annual financial contribution from OVHcloud towards sports activities (gym membership, sports classes, etc.)
 Through Corporate Benefits, you receive attractive discounts at numerous shops and companies
 We contribute to the leasing of your cargo bike
 Regular company events and free cold and hot beverages
 4+ years of experience in infrastructure or platform engineering , ideally in a security-focused, highly automated environment
 Proven practice of AI-assisted engineering - you use LLMs for spec-driven development, runbook authoring or agentic coding and have seen it compound your own output
 Deep knowledge of Linux/Unix internals , system administration and performance tuning
 Hands-on experience with OpenStack (or a comparable cloud platform) for infrastructure provisioning and management
 Strong skills in Infrastructure as Code with Terraform and Ansible and the ability to model complex environments as code
 A solid background in Kubernetes and GitOps workflows (FluxCD / ArgoCD) as well as in designing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines 
 Hands-on experience with modern observability stacks - metrics, logs and traces
 Proficiency in scripting and automation with Python, Bash and Go 
 A solid grasp of security fundamentals (IAM, secrets management, hardening, compliance) and distributed systems concepts (CAP theorem, consensus, fault tolerance)
 A clear bias toward automation over manual toil , a passion for continuous improvement and strict documentation discipline 
 You thrive in collaborative product teams , bring a strong ownership mentality , a blameless culture mindset and strong communication skills , and you adapt easily when things change

Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.
 We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.
 Here’s what this particular role covers.
 🛠️ About our Customer Integration Team 
 We’re seeking an exceptional Integration Engineer to join our Germany-based team within the Application Engineering org, focused on localising and advancing Wayve’s autonomous driving technology for the German market. This is a unique opportunity to play a hands-on role in shaping our AV capabilities in Germany from the ground up.
   🧠 Your day-to-day 
 Provide hands-on technical support to customers throughout the development and validation process
 Serve as the bridge between customer vehicle integration teams and Wayve’s internal engineering teams
 Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues related to our technology independently
 Escalate complex or critical issues to the appropriate internal stakeholders
 Develop deep understanding of customer systems and APIs (e.g. drive-by-wire) to effectively guide internal teams
 Maintain a system-level perspective to identify root causes, whether vehicle-based or software-related
     🧩 What you’ll be working on 
 In this role, you will play a critical part in supporting our customers throughout the entire development lifecycle, from the initial integration phase to the final validation of our technology. You will ensure that customers receive responsive, high-quality technical support and work closely with both our clients and internal engineering teams to ensure seamless integration of our technology into their vehicles.
 Located near our customers, you will be in a prime position to perform rapid diagnostics, identify issues in real time, and collaborate directly with customer engineering teams. This proximity allows you to maintain a holistic understanding of the system and effectively distinguish between vehicle-related issues and those specific to the Wayve AI Driver.
     🙌 You should apply if 
 Strong problem-solving skills and analytical thinking
 Proven ability to lead investigations into platform or vehicle issues in collaboration with internal and customer teams
 Extensive hands-on experience with development vehicles
 Proficiency with diagnostic and calibration tools (e.g. CANape or similar)
 Familiarity with terminal usage and a willingness to develop basic programming skills
 Solid understanding of vehicle communication protocols (e.g. CAN, Ethernet) and automotive system architectures
 Practical experience working in an automotive environment, ideally with a track record of bringing products to production
 Excellent communication and interpersonal skills for effective collaboration with both customers and internal teams
 Willingness to travel as required
     🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.
   More about Wayve: 
 🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines.
 Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility.
   How we work 💻- Locations & Flexible Working: 
 Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives.
   🔍 The Interview Process: 
 Our process is clear and respectful of your time:
 Initial Call / Recruiter Screen : general background, current situation, interests and Wayve company information & hiring context.
 Competency Interview : team meet and discussion on background.
 Deep-dive technical interviews : vehicle integration knowledge & automotive domain knowledge.
 Final interview : mission & values alignment.
 We’ll always explain the format and work around your availability.
   What’s in it for you (Location dependant): 
 💰 Salaries benchmarked against the market annually
📈 Meaningful equity, sharing in the ownership and long term success of Wayve
✈️ Relocation support and visa sponsorship where applicable
✅ Hybrid working, core hours and the chance to work hands on in vehicle workshops and labs
📚 Learning and development budgets with support for training, conferences and growth
🩺 Comprehensive benefits including health insurance, dental, enhanced maternity and paternity leave, retirement or pension where applicable, access to therapists, wellbeing partnerships, team socials and more
 A quick, honest note before you apply.
 Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one.
 If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend your time on, we’d really like to hear from you.
At Wayve we're committed to creating a diverse, fair and respectful culture that is inclusive of everyone based on their unique skills and perspectives, and regardless of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding) or any other basis as protected by applicable law.
 For more information visit Careers at Wayve. To learn more about what drives us, visit Values at Wayve 
DISCLAIMER: We will not ask about marriage or pregnancy, care responsibilities or disabilities in any of our job adverts or interviews. However, we do look to capture information about care responsibilities, and disabilities among other diversity information as part of an optional DEI Monitoring form to help us identify areas of improvement in our hiring process and ensure that the process is inclusive and non-discriminatory.

Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.
 We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.
 Here’s what this particular role covers.
 🛠️ About our Engineering Teams 
 Wayve’s AI Enablement team builds the shared platforms that help people across the company use language models and AI agents safely, reliably, and cost-effectively. As an early member of this platform team, you’ll help shape both the technical foundations and the standards for how AI-powered tools are built and operated across Wayve.
 🧠 Your day-to-day 
 You’ll design, build, and operate infrastructure for model access, agent runtimes, and observability. You’ll take projects from initial problem definition through technical design, deployment, and ongoing operation, partnering closely with security, IT, and engineering teams. You’ll also support teams adopting the platform by troubleshooting issues, documenting reusable patterns, and helping people understand what’s possible with the tools available.
 🧩 What you’ll be working on 
 A governed, production-ready access layer for language models, including routing, authentication, cost controls, and auditability.
 Secure infrastructure and reusable tooling for running agentic workflows in production.
 Observability covering platform usage, cost, reliability, and performance.
 Governance and safety controls that make AI use secure, compliant, and auditable.
 Shared primitives, standards, and best practices that enable teams to build and deploy agents without creating one-off infrastructure.
 Reliable, scalable deployments using cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, and infrastructure-as-code.
 🙌 You should apply if 
 You have strong software engineering experience building APIs, services, or developer tooling.
 You’ve built or operated platforms and infrastructure used by other engineering teams.
 You have hands-on experience with cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, and infrastructure-as-code.
 You’re familiar with LLM APIs and the surrounding ecosystem, such as model gateways, agent frameworks, MCP, or RAG.
 You understand production observability, including metrics, tracing, and logging.
 You take a security-conscious approach to authentication, authorization, governance, and auditability.
 You’re comfortable taking ownership in an ambiguous, fast-moving environment and can communicate clearly through documentation and collaboration.
 🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.
   More about Wayve: 
 🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines.
 Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility.
   How we work 💻- Locations & Flexible Working: 
 Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives.
   🔍 The Interview Process: 
 Our process is clear and respectful of your time:
 Recruiter screen 
 Competency Interviews 
 Deep-dive technical interviews 
 Final interview : mission & values alignment 
 We’ll always explain the format and work around your availability.
   What’s in it for you (Location dependant): 
 💰 Salaries benchmarked against the market annually
📈 Meaningful equity, sharing in the ownership and long term success of Wayve
✈️ Relocation support and visa sponsorship where applicable
✅ Hybrid working, core hours and the chance to work hands on in vehicle workshops and labs
📚 Learning and development budgets with support for training, conferences and growth
🩺 Comprehensive benefits including health insurance, dental, enhanced maternity and paternity leave, retirement or pension where applicable, access to therapists, wellbeing partnerships, team socials and more
 A quick, honest note before you apply.
 Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one.
 If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend your time on, we’d really like to hear from you.

We Are:   At Synopsys, we drive the innovations that shape the way we live and connect. Our technology is central to the Era of Pervasive Intelligence, from self-driving cars to learning machines. We lead in chip design, verification, and IP integration, empowering the creation of high-performance silicon chips and software content. Join us to transform the future through continuous technological innovation. 
 You Are:  
 As the ideal candidate for the Applications Engineering Staff Engineer position, you have a solid foundation in electrical, electronics, or computer engineering and at least 5 years of hands-on experience in SoC/IP/Subsystems DFT. You know DFT methodologies, industry standards, and best practices in depth. You are proficient with industry-standard DFT tools, simulators, and waveform debug tools, and you have hands-on experience with DFT circuit insertion, pattern generation, and validation. You are a seasoned DFT expert who can independently drive customer DFT engagements as a technical lead, with a strong track record of delivering technical DFT projects. Experience in managing project schedules and deliverables is a plus. 
 You work well with customers, solution architects, R&D, and cross-functional teams to deliver innovative, customized solutions. You are a strong problem solver who can evaluate customer methodologies and flows, and you develop complex DFT methodologies that improve test coverage and production yield. Excellent verbal and written English, technical leadership, interpersonal, and teamwork skills are essential to your success in this role. 
 What You'll Be Doing: 
 Owning and driving customer DFT projects end-to-end as a technical lead, from planning through successful delivery. 
 Working with customers to evaluate their DFT methodologies and flows, and taking part in design and flow reviews. During design planning, you will advise on Memory/Scan test architecture, DFT IP insertion, pattern generation, and validation flows. 
 Developing and deploying advanced DFT methodologies with Synopsys Test Automation tools to improve test coverage and production yield. 
 Working closely with solution architects, R&D, and cross-functional teams to align DFT strategies with customer requirements and with overall design and verification processes. 
 Mentoring junior engineers and sharing technical knowledge across the team to foster continuous learning. 
 Managing your project timelines and deliverables so that DFT programs finish on time, while keeping up with the latest advances in DFT technology. 
 The Impact You Will Have: 
 Driving the successful execution of complex DFT programs, with high-quality designs and on-time delivery. 
 Raising customer satisfaction and strengthening customer relationships by providing expert insights and tailored DFT solutions. 
 Improving test coverage, production yield, and design efficiency by deploying advanced DFT methodologies and integrating DFT IP smoothly into customer designs. 
 Supporting the successful adoption of Synopsys Test Automation tools across a wide range of customer applications. 
 Contributing to a collaborative, high-performing team and helping grow the technical capabilities of fellow engineers. 
 Strengthening Synopsys' reputation as a leader in DFT technology by giving valuable feedback to the test product business unit and R&D. 
 What You'll Need: 
 Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical , Electronics, or Computer Engineering, or equivalent. 
 At least 5 years of hands-on experience in the SoC/IP/Subsystems DFT domain. 
 Proficiency in DFT, including scan and ATPG, memory BIST, logic BIST, analog test, and post-silicon support. 
 Hands-on experience with industry-standard DFT tools, simulators, and waveform debug tools for DFT insertion, pattern generation, and validation. 
 A strong understanding of the design flow from specification and micro-architecture definition through design and verification (Verilog/ SystemVerilog ), STA, and physical design, with experience applying DFT to complex SoC/IP/Subsystems. 
 Who You Are: 
 You communicate exceptionally well in English, both verbally and in writing, and can influence internal and external stakeholders. 
 You take strong ownership, have excellent interpersonal skills, and focus on customer success. 
 You can work independently at customer sites, drive complex technical issues to resolution, and deliver high-quality results with minimal supervision. 
 You collaborate naturally across teams and are eager to learn new technologies and methodologies. 
 You are an analytical problem solver with a knack for developing innovative solutions. 
 The Team You'll Be A Part Of:  
 You will join a dynamic, innovative team that deploys cutting-edge DFT technology to a wide range of customers. We coach, demonstrate, build, and implement the latest DFT flows and methodologies. We work closely with 
 solution architects, R&D, and other internal stakeholders to make sure Synopsys Test Automation tools meet the highest industry standards and help customers achieve high-quality designs within their time-to-market goals. 
 Rewards and Benefits: We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to meet your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will share details about 
 the salary range and benefits during the hiring process. 
 At Synopsys, we want talented people of every background to feel valued and supported to do their best work. Synopsys considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, military veteran status, or disability.

Du kennst die Elektrotechnik in- und auswendig. Jetzt willst du den nächsten Schritt? 
 Vielleicht hast du über die Jahre gemerkt, wie viel Verantwortung du eigentlich trägst, ohne dass sich das je im Titel niedergeschlagen hätte. Bei uns führst du ein eigenes Team aus Technikern (m/w/d) und Handwerkern (m/w/d) und stellst sicher, dass die technische Infrastruktur unserer Krankenhausgebäude zuverlässig funktioniert.
 Ein Teil unserer Anlagen ist krankenhausspezifisch und stellt Anforderungen, die es außerhalb einer Klinik so kaum gibt. Erfahrung mit medizinisch genutzten Anlagen solltest du deshalb mitbringen. Auf welche konkreten Systeme und Modelle es bei uns ankommt, lernst du über gezielte Fortbildungen.
 Deine Vorteile 
 Eine Führungsposition mit echtem Gestaltungsspielraum
 Kurze Wege bis zur Entscheidung
 Sicherer Arbeitsplatz in einem wachsenden Unternehmen des Gesundheitswesens
 Einen Arbeitgeber im Gesundheitswesen, unabhängig von der Auftragslage
 Fort- und Weiterbildung, fest zur Stelle gehörig
 Eine Vergütung mit Sozialleistungen, die zur Verantwortung passt
 Deine Aufgaben 
 Deine Arbeit teilt sich in "zwei Welten", den laufenden Betrieb und die Projektarbeit:
 Im Betrieb planst du Wartungen, hältst die Anlagen instand und sorgst dafür, dass im Störungsfall schnell jemand zur Stelle ist.
 In der Projektarbeit koordinierst du Umbauten und Modernisierungen, oft mitten im laufenden Klinikbetrieb, mit Rücksicht auf Patienten (m/w/d) und Pflege.
 In beiden Fällen führst du dein Team, steuerst externe Dienstleister und behältst den Überblick über den technischen Zustand der Häuser.
 In einer Klinik hängt an dieser Verantwortung mehr als ein Gebäude, und genau deshalb sorgst du dafür, dass alles sicher und normgerecht funktioniert.
 Fällt einmal eine Anlage aus, zählt jede Minute. Dann bist du derjenige, der ruhig bleibt und die richtige Entscheidung trifft.
 Dein Profil 
 Du bist gelernter Elektroniker (m/w/d), z. B. für Energie- und Gebäudetechnik, und hast dich seitdem stetig weitergebildet, ob über Lehrgänge oder bis zum Meister (m/w/d).
 Du bringst mehrjährige Berufserfahrung und Sicherheit im Bereich Elektrotechnik mit.
 Als Teamleitung behältst du darüber hinaus das gesamte Handwerk im Blick, nicht nur dein eigenes Fach, sondern gewerkeübergreifend.
 Ein Team oder eine Baustelle hast du am besten schon geleitet, als Vorarbeiter (m/w/d), Teamleiter (m/w/d) oder Projektverantwortlicher (m/w/d).
 Erfahrung in der Betreuung eines Krankenhauses ist nicht zwingend erforderlich
 Wir freuen uns auf deine Online-Bewerbung. Bei Fragen zur Stelle kannst du dich gerne an Patrick Schmidt (Telefonnummer 02102 206274) wenden.

Willkommen in der Welt von Brunel, wo Innovation nicht nur ein Schlagwort ist, sondern eine Lebenseinstellung. Bei uns geht es nicht nur um Arbeit; es geht darum, die Welt zu verändern, Technologie neu zu denken und die Grenzen des Machbaren zu erweitern.
Wir suchen nicht einfach nur Mitarbeiter; wir suchen Visionäre, Pioniere und diejenigen, die den Mut haben, Dinge anders zu sehen.
Wenn Sie bereit sind, den Status quo in Frage zu stellen und gemeinsam mit uns die Zukunft zu gestalten, dann bewerben Sie sich noch heute als Systemingenieur (w/m/d).
### Ihre Aufgaben
- Technische Führung interdisziplinärer Projektteams zur Entwicklung neuer Systeme
- Definition von HW- und SW-Anforderungen, sowie operativer Kundenanforderungen in modularen Systemarchitekturen
- Einsatzorientierte Planung, Koordination, Überwachung und Steuerung der Entwicklung, der Integration und zur Inbetriebnahme neuer Systeme
- Unterstützung und Begleitung von Anfragen bzw. technischen Formulierungen der Aufgabenstellung für Unterauftragnehmer/Zulieferer
- Beurteilung und Verantwortung von Mengengerüsten, Terminen und Kosten für Entwicklung, Integration sowie Inbetriebnahme der Systeme
- Berücksichtigung sicherheitstechnischer Forderungen
- Überwachung des Erfüllungsgrads der Arbeitspakete und des Mittelabflusses
### Ihre Qualifikationen
- Abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen mit technischem Schwerpunkt, System Engineering, Automatisierungstechnik, Mechatronik, Informatik oder vergleichbare Studiengänge
- Übergeordnete Kenntnisse zur fachlichen Führung aus mehreren Bereichen der Industrie 4.0, Regelungstechnik, Automatisierungstechnik, Sicherheitstechnik (Cyber-, Netzwerk-, OT-, IT- und Funktionale Sicherheit) und Life-Cycle-Betrachtungen von Vorteil
- Technisches Verständnis bzgl. der Tools und Programmiersprachen TIA-S7, Twin-CAT, logi.CAD, C++, MatLAB und Simulink wünschenswert
- gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
- Zielorientierte und strukturierte Arbeitsweise, sowie Aufgeschlossenheit und ausgeprägte Kommunikationsstärke
### Ihre Vorteile
Wir bieten Ihnen eine Unternehmenskultur, die geprägt ist von der Vielfältigkeit unserer Mitarbeiter sowie von gegenseitiger Wertschätzung - zwischen den Mitarbeitern und auf allen Unternehmensebenen. Dazu gehören neben abwechslungsreichen Stammtischen mit den lokalen Brunel Teams, auch regelmäßige Feedback-Gespräche über Ihre Herausforderungen und Perspektiven mit Ihrem Account Manager. Mit individuellen Fortbildungen und Trainings werden Sie optimal gefördert und auf zukünftige Projekte vorbereitet. Unbefristete Arbeitsverträge, 30 Tage Urlaub, Arbeitskontenregelung sowie betriebliche, arbeitgeberfinanzierte Altersvorsorge sind bei uns selbstverständlich.
### Dafür steht Brunel
Arbeiten bei Brunel bedeutet: Attraktive Arbeitsaufgaben, außergewöhnliche Karriereperspektiven, die Sicherheit eines expandierenden Ingenieurdienstleisters und die ganze Vielfalt des Engineerings und der IT. Allein in der DACH-CZ Region verfügen wir über mehr als 40 Standorte und Entwicklungszentren mit akkreditiertem Prüflabor und weltweit über 120 Standorte mit mehr als 12.000 Mitarbeitern in über 40 Ländern. Mehr als 45 Jahre international erfolgreich und über 25 Jahre in Deutschland. Stillstand bedeutet Rückschritt - mit Brunel können Sie etwas bewegen!
