items.jobTitle: Junior Information Security Analyst / Cyber Security (m/w/d) Hamburg
items.jobDescription:
Mach Cyber Security bei Louis zu deinem Thema!
 Du findest Cyber Security und IT Security spannend, willst aber nicht den ganzen Tag nur Alerts wegklicken? Dann könnte dieser Job ziemlich gut zu dir passen.
Du musst noch nicht jedes Security-Thema beherrschen. Viel wichtiger sind uns technische Neugier, analytisches Denken und der Wille, Dingen wirklich auf den Grund zu gehen.
 Wir bieten
 Duzkultur und offene Bürotüren
 Work-Life-Balance dank Mobile Working, flexiblen Arbeitszeiten innerhalb einer 37 Stunden Woche (Gleitzeit) und individuellen Arbeitszeitmodellen
 Innovative Besprechungsräume, zusätzliches City Office in der Hamburger Innenstadt
 Feste, wöchentliche Lernzeit via E-Learning, regelmäßige Learning Nuggets sowie vielfältige Kollaborationstools
 Individuelles Onboarding inkl. Einblick in andere Abteilungen
 Louis Welcome Kit zum Start
 Bezahlung oder Ausgleich von Überstunden sowie 30 Tage Urlaub
 Urlaubs- und Weihnachtsgeld sowie VL und BAV
 Gesundheitsvorsorge, JobRad, Hansefit, Rabatt für Mitarbeitende, corporate benefits sowie zahlreiche weitere Vorteile bei Partnerunternehmen
 Kantine, ausreichend Parkplätze für 2 und 4 Rad, die öffentlichen Verkehrsmittel direkt vor der Tür sowie Bezuschussung des Deutschland Tickets
 Darauf kannst du dich noch freuen:
 Bei uns bekommst du echte Security-Verantwortung statt reiner Ticket-Abarbeitung.
Du arbeitest eng mit unserem SOC, der IT und dem CISO zusammen und hast gleichzeitig die Möglichkeit, dich fachlich weiterzuentwickeln. Ob Incident Response, Vulnerability Management, Endpoint Security, Network Security, Cloud Security oder SAP Security: Mit der Zeit kannst du deine eigenen Schwerpunkte setzen.
 Du musst noch nicht alles können. Du solltest Lust haben, jeden Tag ein bisschen mehr davon zu verstehen.
 Deine Aufgaben 
 Security Monitoring & Incident Response
 Du analysierst Security Alerts und verdächtige Aktivitäten und bewertest gemeinsam mit unserem SOC, ob es sich um einen echten Security Incident oder einen False Positive handelt.
 Im Incident-Fall analysierst du betroffene Systeme und Accounts, bewertest Risiken und unterstützt mit unseren Incident-Response-Playbooks bei der Eindämmung.
 Deine Erkenntnisse dokumentierst du nachvollziehbar und hilfst uns so, unsere IT Security kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln.
 Vulnerability Management
 Du analysierst und bewertest Schwachstellen in unserer IT-Umgebung und priorisierst sie nach ihrem tatsächlichen Risiko.
 Gemeinsam mit unseren IT-Teams sorgst du dafür, dass Schwachstellen nachhaltig geschlossen werden und überprüfst anschließend die Wirksamkeit der Maßnahmen.
 Außerdem unterstützt du bei Penetrationstests und Security Assessments.
 Security Tools & Automation
 Du arbeitest hands-on mit unserem Security Stack, u.a. mit Microsoft Defender, Rapid7, Netskope, Fortinet und Akamai und bringst eigene Ideen ein, um wiederkehrende Aufgaben mit PowerShell, Python, APIs oder AI zu automatisieren.
 Und wenn du eine Idee hast, wie sich wiederkehrende Aufgaben mit PowerShell, Python, APIs oder AI automatisieren lassen: Probier sie aus. Eigeninitiative ist ausdrücklich erwünscht.
 Du passt gut zu uns, wenn du:
 bereits erste Erfahrung in IT, Cyber Security oder Information Security gesammelt hast.
 Grundlagen in Netzwerken, Windows und Cloud-Technologien mitbringst.
 idealerweise schon mit EDR, SIEM, Vulnerability Scannern oder vergleichbaren Security Tools gearbeitet hast.
 mit Begriffen wie DNS, TCP/IP, TLS, CVE und MFA etwas anfangen kannst.
 Lust hast, dich in neue Security-Technologien und Themen einzuarbeiten.
 Ein Studium in Cyber Security, Informatik oder IT-Security ist eine gute Grundlage. Genauso willkommen bist du mit einer Ausbildung als Fachinformatiker (m/w/d) oder einem anderen technischen Background, wen du entsprechendes Know-How mitbringst.
 Über uns
 Als modernes Cross-Channel-Unternehmen sind wir Europas größte Einkaufswelt für Motorradbekleidung und -technik. Mit knapp 90 Filialen in Deutschland, Österreich, der Schweiz und den Niederlanden sowie bald 18 Online-Ländershops bieten wir unserer Community ein unvergleichliches Einkaufserlebnis. Bei uns findest du mehr als nur einen Job – wir bieten dir sichere Arbeitsplätze, attraktive Konditionen und eine motivierende Arbeitsatmosphäre. Unsere vielseitigen Aufgabenbereiche und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten sorgen dafür, dass du jeden Tag dein Bestes geben kannst. Über 2.400 teamorientierte Mitarbeitende freuen sich auf dich. Werde Teil der Louis Familie und erlebe, was es heißt, in einem dynamischen und zukunftsorientierten Unternehmen zu arbeiten.

Your mission
 As a Robotics Simulation Engineer, you will build and own the simulation infrastructure that underpins development and testing at NODE. You will create high-fidelity digital twins of intralogistics environments, develop and maintain robot models, and build the CI pipelines that run simulation-based regression tests against our navigation and fleet management software. 
What you will do: 
 Design, build, and maintain simulation environments for autonomous mobile robots in intralogistics settings
 Develop and refine robot models (URDF, SDF) including sensor simulation (LiDAR, odometry, cameras)
 Build and own simulation-based CI/CD pipelines on GitLab to automate regression testing
 Collaborate with Robotics Core engineers to close the sim-to-real gap and validate navigation and fleet management behaviors
 Evaluate and integrate new simulation tooling (e.g. NVIDIA Isaac Sim) where it improves fidelity or coverage
 Maintain and extend our custom simulation tooling alongside Gazebo
 What makes this role exciting: Meaningful problems: real sim-to-real challenges on hardware that operates in production warehouses
 Greenfield opportunities: you shape how we build and evolve our simulation infrastructure
 Close to hardware: direct collaboration with the team building the physical robots
 Small, senior team: your work has direct impact on every release
 Your profile
 Must-have: 
 3–5 years of hands-on experience in robotics software development
 Strong proficiency in ROS 2
 Solid C++ and Python skills
 Experience with Gazebo (Ignition/Harmonic) — building environments, robot models, plugins
 Understanding of mobile robot fundamentals: kinematics, sensor models, localization, navigation
 Familiarity with CI/CD — specifically GitLab CI — for automated software testing
 Nice-to-have: Experience with NVIDIA Isaac Sim or other high-fidelity simulators
 Exposure to intralogistics, warehouse automation, or fleet management systems
 Multi-robot simulation experience
 Knowledge of digital twin concepts and tooling
 What we offer
 Flexible Working Hours: There are no such thing as core work times.
 Public Transportation Allowance: We cover the majority of the cost of your commuter pass
 Sports: Get a free Urban Sports Club membership
 Learning Budget: A fixed yearly learning budget can be spent on anything.
 Discounts: We are part of the "Corporate Benefits" program.
 Accessibility: Our modern office space at ARENA2036 is barrier-free.

Our Mission 
 SPAN is enabling electrification for all ⚡
 We are a mission-driven company designing, building, and deploying products that electrify the built environment, reduce carbon emissions, and slow the effects of climate change.
 Decarbonization is the process to reduce or remove greenhouse gas emissions, especially carbon dioxide, from entering our atmosphere. 
 Electrification is the process of replacing fossil fuel appliances that run on gas or oil with all-electric upgrades for a cleaner way to power our lives. 
 At SPAN, we believe in:
 Enabling homes and vehicles powered by clean energy
 Making electrification upgrades possible
 Building more resilient homes with reliable backup
 Designing a flexible and distributed electrical grid
 The Role
 We are hiring for multiple roles at mid, senior, and staff levels.
 Our Mission
 SPAN develops products that accelerate the rapid adoption of renewable energy in the home. The flagship SPAN Smart Panel is the first true evolution for the traditional home electric panel, harnessing enhanced technology for metering, monitoring, and control. An expanded product suite of intelligent, integrated solutions radically lowers the cost and complexity of energy upgrades–including solar, batteries and EVs–empowering homeowners to be active, resilient and informed players in the energy market.
 The Team and Role
 SPAN’s Strategic Firmware team is responsible for the full lifecycle of new strategic products, features, and integrations. We are focused on quickly building minimum viable solutions that will help unlock market segments and increase sales. We look for friendly, motivated engineers who enjoy working with their peers to drive impact and move the business forward. Engineers on this team work directly with the broader cross-functional strategic team including product, mobile software, cloud software, and hardware.
As a Senior Firmware Engineer you will have the opportunity to be the engineering owner for new strategic initiatives that impact any of our hardware components from microcontrollers up through application stack in embedded Linux. This can include everything from bootloaders on systems without an OS up through applications in C and C++ inside an RTOS, to system services and applications written in Rust and Python in embedded Linux. Hardware products are central to SPAN’s business and writing firmware for even our smallest microcontrollers means working on something that directly impacts the user experience.
 Representative Projects
 Integrations with smart networked third party home energy devices: work across teams to define MVP, manage external partners, define architecture, and lead the implementation
 The regulatory frameworks that govern our electrical systems and devices are updated from time to time. In some cases, changes here may create market demand for electrical products. To unlock new markets, we may work with our product and certification teams to design new features or capabilities and lead the implementation. 
 We are always looking for ways to bring additional value to our customers and the strategic team is generally responsible for delivering these products and features. For example, a new SPAN Drive charge mode may help customers save on their electricity bills and get more out of their existing solar panels. 
 About You
 Required Qualifications
 We are seeking a Firmware engineer with:
 3 more years of experience writing software for a hardware device (on a microcontroller, and/or in Linux, etc) in C++, Rust, and/or Python
 Strong fundamentals in modern software design coupled with awareness of concerns like manual memory management
 Experience working with standard electrical communication interfaces like UART, I2C, USB, etc. 
 Exceptional interpersonal communication and collaboration skills. Great at building trust and driving decisions to a resolution
 Track record of taking ownership of projects and willingness to help others with theirs, from design and code review through to mentorship of new employees
 Bonus Qualifications
 We do not expect any engineer to have all skills, but we do want you to be excited to learn and grow. Every Device Software Engineer is free to roam up and down our device software stack, so any combination of the following skills is welcome but not required.
 Experience with the STM32 microcontroller family
 Experience with functional safety and processes and standards like UL 60730, ISO 26262, IEC 61508, and UL 1998
 Experience writing higher level system or application software such as diagnostic command line tools or the application side of a communication interface
 Wireless technologies like WiFi, Bluetooth and Zigbee
 Hands-on experience with electronics lab equipment
 Experience with clean energy hardware in a multidisciplinary environment
 Life at SPAN
 Our Bengaluru team plays a pivotal role in SPAN’s continued growth and expansion. Together, we’re driving engineering , product development , and operational excellence to shape the future of home energy solutions.
As part of our team in India, you’ll have the opportunity to collaborate closely with our teams in the US and across the globe. items.jobDescription:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.
 We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.
 Here’s what this particular role covers.
 🛠️ About our Engineering Teams
 Wayve’s engineering teams are building the AI, robotics, simulation, data, and systems foundations needed to deploy a generalisable AI Driver safely and at scale.
 About AI Validation
 The AI Validation team develops the strategies, evidence, metrics, and test systems that build confidence in the Wayve AI Driver. Both locations translate ambiguous product and safety questions into validation plans, scenarios, metrics, coverage, acceptance criteria, and evidence for release decisions—but the product scope and candidate profile differ by location.
 This role focuses primarily on ADAS and L2 autonomy functions. It works closely with automotive and OEM expectations, including product, customer, safety, and regulatory requirements. The role can be hired as a TC4 individual contributor or an M4 manager with responsibility for technical direction and team delivery.
 🧠 Your day-to-day
 Translate product, systems, and safety requirements into validation strategies, test scenarios, metrics, coverage requirements, and acceptance criteria.
 Work hands-on with Python, evaluation pipelines, test implementation, simulation, and data analysis.
 Analyse results and communicate findings, risks, and evidence to Product, Safety, Release, and Autonomy Engineering stakeholders.
 Coordinate data, simulation, and evaluation dependencies so validation can run reliably and at scale.
 Develop comprehensive verification strategies for ADAS and L2 autonomy functions.
 Translate customer, OEM, safety, and regulatory expectations into practical validation evidence.
 Build test suites spanning simulation and physical testing environments.
 At M4, provide people leadership and coordinate validation delivery across the team; at TC4, provide senior technical ownership as an individual contributor.
 🧩 What you’ll be working on
 ADAS functions such as lane keeping and other assisted-driving capabilities.
 Validation strategies aligned with automotive OEM development, customer expectations, SOTIF, and emerging AV-industry standards.
 Simulated and physical test environments, comprehensive coverage, and evidence-based release decisions.
 Python-based evaluation tooling, SQL and scalable data analysis, behavioural metrics, test coverage, and automated validation execution.
 🙌 You should apply if
 You understand how automotive companies and OEMs develop and validate ADAS or L2 autonomy products.
 You can translate customer, safety, regulatory, and product expectations into structured validation strategies.
 You have hands-on experience building scenarios, metrics, test suites, evaluation pipelines, or data-analysis workflows.
 You can use Python professionally and are comfortable with SQL or similar large-scale analysis tools.
 You have validated complex systems in simulation, the real world, or both.
 You communicate clearly, document decisions well, and can own ambiguous problems from concept through evidence and recommendation.
 ML, computer vision, motion planning, SOTIF, safety validation, or modern AI-tooling experience is advantageous.
 For the M4 scope, you have experience leading people or coordinating a validation function; for TC4, you bring strong senior individual-contributor ownership.
🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.
 More about Wayve
 🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end-to-end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real-world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale.
 Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware-agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2+ through to L4.
 How we work 💻 — Locations & Flexible Working
 This role is based in London. We operate a hybrid model combining in-person collaboration in our offices and workshops with focused time working remotely.
 🔍 The Interview Process
 Initial call / recruiter screen (25 min)
 Hiring Manager Screen (60 min)
 Deep-dive technical interviews covering systems and domain expertise (4 hours)
 Final interview focused on mission and values alignment (60 min)
 We’ll always explain the format and work around your availability.
 What’s in it for you (location dependent)
 💰 Salaries benchmarked against the market annually
 📈 Meaningful equity
 ✈️ Relocation support and visa sponsorship where applicable

items.jobDescription:
Akkodis ist ein globales Beratungsunternehmen für Digital Engineering, das Technologie und Talente zusammenbringt, um Transformation zu beschleunigen, Innovation voranzutreiben und eine intelligentere Zukunft zu gestalten. Mit mehr als 40.000 Expert:innen in über 30 Ländern verbinden wir Branchen und Technologien miteinander - von AI und Data Analytics bis zu Cloud, Edge, Automatisierung und Cybersecurity.
Kundendetails
Sie möchten mit Ihrer Expertise an technologisch anspruchsvollen Projekten in der Luft- und Raumfahrt- oder Defence-Branche mitwirken? Für verschiedene Projekte und Standorte suchen wir regelmäßig qualifizierte Fachkräfte aus Engineering, IT sowie kaufmännisch-technischen Bereichen.
Ob Embedded Software, Elektronik, Systems Engineering, KI, SAP oder Projektmanagement: Wir bringen Ihre Erfahrung und fachlichen Schwerpunkte mit passenden Projekten zusammen und schauen gemeinsam, welche Position zu Ihren Kenntnissen und Vorstellungen passt.
Stellenbeschreibung
Ihre möglichen Tätigkeitsbereiche:
 * Software & Embedded: Entwicklung von Embedded Software und Firmware, Arbeiten mit Embedded Linux und C/C++ oder Kenntnisse in VHDL und FPGA
 * Elektrotechnik & Testing: Entwicklung und Absicherung elektronischer Systeme, beispielsweise in der Mess- und Prüftechnik, Sensorik, Optronik, Bildverarbeitung, im Electrical Design oder im EWIS-Umfeld
 * Systems Engineering: Die Entwicklung, Integration und Absicherung komplexer Systeme in Bereichen wie Guidance & Control, Kommunikationssysteme, Netzwerktechnik oder Systemarchitektur
 * IT & Data: Expertise in KI und Large Language Models, Python und Automatisierung oder im SAP-Umfeld, beispielsweise S/4HANA, MM/QM oder FI/CO
 * Projekt- & Prozessmanagement: Übernahme von Verantwortung im Configuration und Change Management, im technischen Einkauf, technischen Projektmanagement oder Projektcontrolling
Profil
* Sie verfügen über ein abgeschlossenes Studium oder eine technische Ausbildung, beispielsweise in Elektrotechnik, Informatik, Informationstechnik, Mechatronik, Luft- und Raumfahrttechnik oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung
 * Idealerweise konnten Sie bereits Berufserfahrung in einem der genannten Tätigkeitsfelder sammeln
 * Je nach Schwerpunkt bringen Sie Kenntnisse in relevanten Technologien und Tools mit, beispielsweise C/C++, Linux, Python, MATLAB/Simulink, LabVIEW, VHDL/FPGA, CATIA V5, DOORS oder SAP
 * Erste Erfahrungen in der Luft- und Raumfahrt, Defence oder einem anderen sicherheitskritischen Umfeld sind von Vorteil
 * Für die Zusammenarbeit in internationalen Projektteams bringen Sie verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse mit
Das Angebot
* Hybrides Arbeiten: Flexible Arbeitszeiten mit hybrider Arbeitsoption von zu Hause aus und einem Gleitzeitkonto gehören zu unserem Standard. 
 * Vielseitige Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten: Bei Akkodis werden Ihnen zahlreiche Weiterentwicklungsmöglichkeiten, im fachlichen als auch persönlichen Bereich, angeboten. 
 * Wellhub: Unser Well-Being-Partner bietet Ihnen vergünstigte Mitgliedschaften von Sporteinrichtungen über Online-Gruppen-Kurse bis hin zu virtuellem Personal-Training. 
 * Corporate Benefits: Entdecken Sie unsere Corporate Benefits und profitieren von exklusiven, europaweiten Angeboten sowie Vergünstigungen von A-Z. 
 * Sozialleistungen: Profitieren Sie von Sozialleistungen wie der betrieblichen Altersvorsorge und vermögenswirksame Leistungen. 
 * Mitarbeiterempfehlungsprogramm: Empfehlen Sie Talente (m/w/d) aus Ihrem persönlichen/beruflichen Netzwerk und sichern Sie sich eine monetäre Prämie von bis zu 2.026€. 
Die Benefits können je nach Position und Standort variieren. Eine Übersicht über unsere Benefits befindet sich auf unserer Webseite unterhalb Karriere und Benefits.

items.companyName: PAPEVE GmbH Der Spezialist für Ingenieure Techniker und Fachpersonal
items.jobDescription:
## 🚀 **Sie bringen komplexe Raumfahrttechnik zum Fliegen – und behalten dabei Termine, Qualität und Kosten im Griff?**
Dann übernehmen Sie eine Schlüsselrolle bei der Planung und Steuerung anspruchsvoller Integrations- und Testprozesse für innovative Raumfahrtprodukte. Als Technischer Projektleiter AIT koordinieren Sie die Montage, Integration und Erprobung von Subsystemen und Nutzlasten und sorgen dafür, dass aus hochkomplexen technischen Komponenten funktionierende Gesamtsysteme werden.
Für ein namhaftes Technologieunternehmen im Raum Backnang suchen wir einen engagierten Technischen Projektleiter AIT (m/w/d), der technisches Know-how mit organisatorischem Geschick und einem ausgeprägten Verantwortungsbewusstsein verbindet.
### **Ihre Aufgaben**
- Sie planen und koordinieren die Montage, Integration und Prüfung von Subsystemen und Nutzlasten (Payloads).
- Sie erstellen und pflegen Zeitpläne, Testspezifikationen, Testprozeduren, Testpläne und aussagekräftige Testberichte.
- Sie planen, organisieren und koordinieren verschiedene AIT-Testkampagnen.
- Sie steuern und bearbeiten technische Schnittstellenthemen zwischen den Bereichen AIT, Projektmanagement und Entwicklung.
- Sie entwickeln Integrations- und Testkonzepte, stimmen diese mit den beteiligten Fachbereichen ab und begleiten deren Umsetzung.
- Sie bereiten Nutzlast- und Subsystemtests vor und übernehmen die technische Leitung der Testdurchführungen.
- Sie kommunizieren mit Kunden und stimmen technische sowie organisatorische Fragestellungen eigenständig ab.
- Sie koordinieren das mechanische Integrationspersonal und sorgen für reibungslose Abläufe.
- Sie unterstützen die Angebotserstellung und erarbeiten die dafür erforderlichen technischen Grundlagen.
- Sie arbeiten bei Bedarf direkt im Reinraum und begleiten die Integrations- und Testprozesse vor Ort.
### **Ihr Profil**
- Sie verfügen über ein abgeschlossenes Studium der Luft- und Raumfahrttechnik, Elektrotechnik, Nachrichtentechnik, Physik oder einer vergleichbaren technischen Fachrichtung.
- Idealerweise bringen Sie bereits Erfahrung in der technischen Projektleitung, Systemintegration, Assembly, Integration & Test (AIT) oder im Testmanagement mit.
- Sie besitzen ein gutes Verständnis für komplexe technische Systeme und deren Integrations- und Prüfprozesse.
- Sie arbeiten selbstständig, strukturiert und zielorientiert und behalten auch bei anspruchsvollen Projekten den Überblick.
- Sie überzeugen durch Teamfähigkeit sowie ein ausgeprägtes Termin-, Qualitäts- und Kostenbewusstsein.
- Sie kommunizieren sicher mit unterschiedlichen Fachbereichen und Kunden.
- Sie bringen die Bereitschaft zu Dienstreisen und zur Teilnahme an mehrtägigen Test- und Integrationskampagnen mit.
- Sie verfügen über verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse und gute Englischkenntnisse.
**Auch folgende Studienrichtungen und Qualifikationswege können fachlich passen:**
Neben den ausdrücklich genannten Fachrichtungen kommen insbesondere Studiengänge wie Technische Physik, Mechatronik, Systems Engineering, Maschinenbau mit Schwerpunkt Luft- und Raumfahrt oder Automatisierungstechnik infrage. Entscheidend sind ein fundiertes technisches Verständnis und die Fähigkeit, komplexe Integrations- und Testprozesse zu koordinieren.
### **Das erwartet Sie**
- Eine verantwortungsvolle Position in einem technologisch anspruchsvollen Umfeld der Luft- und Raumfahrt.
- Die Möglichkeit, komplexe Integrations- und Testprojekte eigenständig zu koordinieren und maßgeblich mitzugestalten.
- Eine abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeit an der Schnittstelle zwischen Entwicklung, Projektmanagement, Fertigung und Kunden.
- Ein Arbeitsumfeld, in dem technisches Know-how, Eigeninitiative und Verantwortungsbewusstsein gefragt sind.
- Langfristige berufliche Perspektiven bei einem namhaften Technologieunternehmen.
### **Jetzt den nächsten Karriereschritt gehen!**
Sie möchten anspruchsvolle Raumfahrtprojekte nicht nur begleiten, sondern aktiv steuern und zum Erfolg führen? Dann freuen wir uns darauf, Sie kennenzulernen!
Bewerben Sie sich jetzt als Technischer Projektleiter AIT / Integration & Test (m/w/d) am Standort Backnang.
PAPEVE GmbH – Wir bringen Persönlichkeiten und Unternehmen zusammen.

items.jobTitle: Software Designer – High -Tech Semiconductor Equipment (PLC / C++ / C#)(m/f/w)
items.jobDescription:
As a Software Designer – High-Tech Semiconductor Equipment (PLC / C++ / C#), you have experience to design and define PLC, machine control software and higher-level system software for next-generation semiconductor equipment
In this role, you contribute to the development of advanced high-tech semiconductor machines, such as next-generation sintering equipment. You operate across the full stack of machine and system control: from PLC-based machine control (TwinCAT / Siemens) to higher-level software components in C++ or C#.
You work in either an environment where software is developed from scratch or with large legacy source code, which is tightly integrated with hardware and electronics, requiring a balanced skillset across machine control and modern software engineering.
What excites you as a Software Designer – High -Tech Semiconductor Equipment (PLC / C++ / C#)(m/f/w)?
As a Software Designer, you work on technically challenging semiconductor equipment where machine control and higher-level software come together. You translate requirements into robust designs, take ownership of modules or subsystems, and ensure a consistent design from the PLC layer up to system software.
From our office in Erlangen, at customer locations, and remotely when appropriate, you enjoy working on:
 Designing and implementing machine control software using PLC technologies (TwinCAT 3 / Siemens) and or SECS/GEM.
 Developing higher-level equipment control software components in C++ and C#.
 Translating system requirements into integrated hardware–software solutions and challenging requirements to drive optimal designs.
 Bridging the gap between control engineering and software engineering disciplines.
 Contributing to the development and evolution of both greenfield and legacy architectures for high-tech machines.
 Integrating, testing, and commissioning complex semiconductor equipment.
 Collaborating within Scrum teams and multidisciplinary engineering groups across software, electronics, and mechanics to deliver high-quality solutions.
 Sounds good so far? We'd love to tell you more…
Your future workplace
This is what you bring to the table
 Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, or a related field, combined with 5–10+ years of experience in high-tech machine building and software development.
 Strong expertise in PLC-based machine control (Beckhoff TwinCAT 3 and/or Siemens) and experience with SECS/GEM combined with solid software development experience in C++ or C#.
 Proven experience designing and implementing control software for complex machines and industrial automation systems.
 Good understanding of Object-Oriented Design, software architecture principles, and requirements engineering, with the ability to translate requirements into effective technical designs.
 Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments and with modern development tools such as Git and Azure DevOps.
 Strong analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to bridge machine control and software domains, challenge unclear requirements, and take ownership of solutions.
 Collaborative and flexible mindset, with willingness to travel within the Netherlands and occasionally across Europe, and to work in a hybrid on-site/remote environment.
 Nice to have: Python, Java, TwinCAT Safety, or industrial robotics experience (e.g., KUKA).
 This is what you can expect in return from Sioux
 Flexible 40 hour working week, with room to work from home
 A healthy work-life balance is very important for us. We have 30 vacation days per calendar year.
 You will work with passionate colleagues who share your drive for technology and business success.
 By combining our expertise in software, electronics, mechanics, mechatronics, mathematics and assembly, we make the impossible possible for our customers and get to work on challenging high-tech projects.
 You get a lot of freedom and responsibility; after all, you know exactly what you are doing.
 Personal coaching and training, so that you can continue to develop yourself.
 We also believe it is important to have fun together. We organize events for our employees, from summer parties for the whole family and lively Christmas celebrations to inspiring knowledge events for the high-tech community.
 Our office in Sioux is ideally located in the heart of the “Medical Valley” in the university town of Erlangen.
 You can share your knowledge with colleagues over lunch, and there are always like-minded people around for a round of darts or table soccer to lighten the mood. Sports are also a big deal at Sioux Technologies Gemany - join our running group or our beach volleyball team.
 High Tech & High Fun
We can tell you all about the typical Sioux culture and the high-tech challenging projects. About how you can develop yourself, like nowhere else. But we’d rather have you hear it from our own employees.
Go to testimonials >
If you want to know more about our challenging projects, please click here.
Important note:
This position requires access to controlled technology, as defined in the US Export Administration Regulations (15 C.F.R.
 730, et seq.). Qualified candidates must be legally authorized to access such controlled technology prior to beginning work. Business demands may require Sioux to proceed with candidates who are immediately eligible to access controlled technology.

 Mind. 1 Jahr Erfahrung im Recruiting/HR/People & Culture in einem wettbewerbsintensiven, schnelllebigen Umfeld
 Erste Erfahrung mit LinkedIn Recruiter
 Fließendes Deutsch (unsere Unternehmenssprache), gutes Englisch von Vorteil
 Warum Du Dich jetzt bewerben solltest.
 Bei uns zählen Eigenverantwortung, Exzellenz und Energie. Wir denken in Ergebnissen und fordern uns gegenseitig heraus, um Deutschlands führende Kraft in der Umsetzung von energetischen Sanierungen zu werden. Wenn dich das abholt, melde dich.
 Das Timing ist perfekt. Werde jetzt Teil von einem der schnellst wachsenden Energie-Startups Deutschlands - finanziert von Europas bekanntesten Venture Capitals
 Arbeite gemeinsam mit ambitionierten Kollegen in einem Umfeld mit spürbarem Momentum
 Unbegrenzte Lernmöglichkeiten und vielseitige Aufstiegschancen
 Spreeblick statt Hinterhof: unser Büro liegt direkt am Wasser, mitten in Kreuzberg
 Individuelles Benefit: Learning-Budget, Urban Sports Clubs, Jobticket- oder Kita-Zuschuss
 Betriebliche Altersvorsorge für deine sichere Zukunft
 Team-Events, die nicht langweilig werden
 Unser Bewerbungsprozess.
 Ich, Daniel (People Lead), bin Dein Ansprechpartner für diese Rolle.
So geht's weiter:
 45 Minuten Erstgespräch mit mir, Daniel (virtuell) – innerhalb einer Woche nach Deiner Bewerbung
 60 Minuten mit mir und Max (CEO) vor Ort bei uns im Büro in Kreuzberg
 Über uns
 Enter ist die Antwort auf eine Frage, die sich Millionen von Hausbesitzern stellen: Nicht, ob ihr Haus elektrifiziert wird - sondern wie, und mit wem.
Wir wissen, was unseren Kunden wirklich wehtut: die Energierechnung. Deshalb zielen wir auf eine Sanierung, die daran spürbar etwas ändert. Ganz nebenbei treiben wir damit die Energiewende voran.
Egal ob Wärmepumpe, PV-Anlage, Energie-Monitoring oder andere energetische Sanierungen, wir finden die passende Lösung für jedes Haus. Als führender Energieberater stellen wir sicher, dass unsere Kunden genau das bekommen, was sie wirklich brauchen. Mit über 40 Millionen Euro Funding und über 90 Mitarbeitern sind wir erfahrene Pioniere in einem Markt, der gerade erst so richtig losgeht.
Wir wissen, dass der größte Hebel zur Senkung von Deutschlands Energiekosten darin liegt, bestehende Technologie für Millionen Eigenheimbesitzer nutzbar zu machen. Daran arbeiten wir. Haus für Haus.
Enter. Jetzt ist der Moment.

Job Description:
 To support the team, Airbus Defence and Space is looking for a Aerospace Cyber Security System Architect (d/m/w).
 About Us & Role Description
 The Cyber Division of Airbus Defence and Space is a European specialist in cyber security for defence and aerospace assets and systems. More than 450 cyber experts in our offices in France, Germany, the UK and Spain leverage our Airbus DNA by developing products and solutions for customers based on state-of-the-art, trusted technologies. Our mission is to design, develop, integrate and deliver tailored cyber security products and solutions for defence, government and institutional customers and provide operational support throughout the system life cycle.
This role can also be performed with reduced weekly working hours and an adapted scope of responsibilities.
 Your Location
 Our Ottobrunn/Taufkirchen location is just a stone's throw away from Munich, the beautiful state capital of Bavaria. Do you like sports and other outdoor activities? The Alps and Lake Starnberg are just an hour away and offer a wide range of leisure activities.
You can also work at our locations in Immenstaad/Friedrichshafen on the beautiful Lake Constance or in Bremen near the North Sea coast!
 Our Benefits for You
 Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive salary and individual benefits, e.g., employer-funded pension plans, mobility offers (e.g., bike/car leasing), or employee discounts at cooperating companies according to our applicable guidelines.
 Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days paid vacation according to collective agreement (35h/week); compatibility of family & career (flexitime, mobile working, part-time, job sharing, sabbatical).
 Moving Ahead Made Easy: Excellent upskilling opportunities and great international, group-wide development prospects.
 Well-being at Work: On-site medical officer for check-ups and health services, comprehensive health programs, canteen and cafeteria, and a kindergarten close to the site.
 Diversity Connects: Working in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, support, and diversity are actively lived and every voice is heard.
 Your Tasks And Responsibilities
 Provide end to end support to projects with regards to cyber security. 
 Lead the definition of Security requirement , security concept for specific projects. 
 Lead the Design of Secure architecture for Aerospace Solutions
 Lead the Security Risk Assessment and Threat Modeling Processes
 Act as Security Officer for certain Aerospace Projects and be the point of contact for all related security topics
 Verification and Validation of Cyber-security System/Network design 
 Evaluate, develop and adapt Baseline for secure system and network configuration and hardening aligned with security requirement
 Support the Bid Team with the technical solution (security scope) and effort estimation 
 Coordinate with the different stakeholders and team members to ensure the delivery of the technical solution on-quality, on-time and on-cost (oQoToC)
 Desired Skills And Qualifications
 You are educated to a degree in aerospace engineering, electrical engineering, communications, computer science or similar, or comparable experience
 You have several years of experience in system security engineering and the definition of security concept and processes for complex solution for Space and Aviation systems
 You have good knowledge of the different Cyber Security standards and frameworks ( e.g. ISO 27000 Family, NIST 2 , CMMC, ...) and you are well-versed in Security Products and Secure Communications Protocols 
 You possess strong expertise with Secure Architecture Principles and Concepts ( e.g Zero Trust , Defense in Depth, Least Privilege...)
 You are knowledgeable of the Risk Assessment framework (e.g. EBIOS , NIST SP800-37..)
 You have a solid understanding to define verification and validation procedures for secure architecture
 Your excellent communication and writing skills in English set you apart; German would be a plus
 Not a 100 percent match? No problem! Airbus supports your personal growth with customized development solutions.

items.jobTitle: Product Expert - HPGR Applied Aftermarket Engineering
items.jobDescription:
Do you want to make a difference in the world and contribute to a sustainable future?
We believe we can develop technology and gain the know-how to make that difference. It is a big responsibility, and we are committed to making an impactful difference. We need your skills, curiosity, and drive for change to fulfil our goal.
Together, we enable our customers to produce the materials and technology needed for a better future. Come see the FLSmidth difference.
The Product Expert - HPGR Applied Aftermarket Engineering is a senior technical role responsible for strengthening the global HPGR Services organization through applied engineering, failure understanding and development of aftermarket standards and solutions.
The role transforms field experience, operating data and inspection findings into clear engineering conclusions, practical service standards and reliability improvements. As a recognized HPGR product expert, the position provides technical leadership for complex aftermarket cases and supports the validation of new service solutions.
The role operates within the aftermarket scope and works closely with the Service Centers, regional teams, Technical Manager, GSLM Technical Innovation and PBL Engineering. Formal OEM design authority remains with PBL Engineering and the Chief Engineer.
 Key Responsibilities
 Lead technical evaluations of HPGR condition, performance and operating behaviour based on field observations, inspection findings and operating data.
 Analyze and document failure mechanisms, wear patterns, mechanical degradation, load distribution and machine response under actual plant conditions.
 Develop clear engineering conclusions and recommendations that improve HPGR reliability, serviceability and aftermarket decision-making.
 Develop and maintain global aftermarket standards for inspections, measurement methods, condition limits, refurbishment criteria and workshop quality checkpoints.
 Provide applied engineering input for improvements to HPGR lubrication, hydraulics, monitoring, tooling, measurement and serviceability.
 Assess the technical feasibility, risks, serviceability and expected performance of new aftermarket solutions, upgrades and retrofit concepts.
 Define validation criteria and support controlled trials, field evaluations and technical release recommendations.
 Contribute field-driven opportunities and technical work packages to the HPGR aftermarket R&D and innovation roadmap.
 Provide expert-level support for complex technical cases, strategic customer discussions and engineering workshops.
 Build and maintain guidelines, failure libraries, technical references, case studies and training material.
 Coach Product Specialists, regional technical resources and Service Center teams in applied aftermarket engineering methods.
 Provide structured field evidence to PBL Engineering and the Chief Engineer when OEM design decisions or product-rule changes are required.
 Collaborate across HPGR Services, Engineering, Product Line, Quality and Supply Chain to ensure consistent technical execution globally.
 Qualifications & Experience
 Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Mining Engineering, Mechatronics or a related engineering discipline; an advanced degree is preferred.
 Extensive experience in heavy machinery, mineral-processing equipment, rotating equipment or a comparable industrial aftermarket environment.
 Strong engineering knowledge in failure analysis, applied mechanics, condition assessment and reliability improvement.
 Experience interpreting machine behaviour and technical evidence from field operating conditions.
 Experience developing technical standards, inspection methods, engineering guidelines or service documentation.
 HPGR experience is strongly preferred, particularly in roll units, wear systems, bearings, shafts, hydraulics, lubrication, drives, monitoring or refurbishment.
 Ability to translate complex technical information into practical recommendations and clearly defined decision criteria.
 Strong analytical, problem-solving and technical documentation skills.
 Effective communication and stakeholder-management skills across global and cross-functional teams.
 Confidence in customer-facing technical discussions and engineering workshops.
 Professional proficiency in English; additional languages are advantageous.
 Willingness to travel internationally as required.
 Total salary target range incl. variable pay: 119.000 - 161.000 Euro
 The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

Please apply by clicking “apply” on this page. Kindly note that we will be reviewing applications and conducting interviews on an ongoing basis, so please apply as soon as possible. Candidates will be contacted by email. No recruiters and unsolicited agency referrals, please.

Nous couvrons la maîtrise de toute votre chaîne électrique : le génie électrique, le solaire en toiture, sur ombrière ou au sol ; le stockage, le pilotage et les bornes de recharge ainsi que l’exploitation de l’ensemble.

 Expérience managériale avérée d'au moins 5 ans dans le pilotage d'équipes commerciales terrain, avec un focus sur l'accompagnement et la transmission du savoir-faire

Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecraft for humanity.
We want you as a Cross-Functional Mechanical Engineer to bring hands-on structural design experience and sound engineering judgement to the mechanical development and verification of Nyx. With a strong system-level mindset, you will support subsystem teams in developing robust designs, resolving mechanical challenges, and substantiating the integrity of critical hardware throughout the development lifecycle.
 A key focus of your role will be to develop and consolidate the mechanical justifications supporting NASA requirements compliance and Safety Review Panel (SRP) activities. Working with subsystem owners and the safety and certification teams, you will establish the technical basis for allowable damage and failure criteria across critical vehicle components. You will combine direct technical contributions with practical guidance to engineers and suppliers, connecting component-level assessments with vehicle-level requirements and safety considerations.
 You will be part of the Nyx Design Office Team, within the Cross-Functional Mechanical team, and will report to the Integrated Mechanical Sizing & Assurance Team Leader.
Key Responsibilities:
 Technical Leadership & Integration
 Provide hands-on structural design expertise and technical guidance across subsystems, supporting mechanical integrity and consistency at vehicle level.
 Assess load paths, interfaces, stiffness, and boundary conditions to understand how mechanical, pressure, and thermo-mechanical loads are transferred through components, attachments, and the vehicle structure.
 Perform and review mechanical assessments using engineering calculations, finite element analysis (FEA), and test evidence, challenging assumptions and identifying the failure modes that drive design decisions.
 Support subsystem owners in translating high-level mechanical requirements into subsystem and component specifications, maintaining traceability and accounting for vehicle-level interactions.
 Compliance & Verification
 Develop and document mechanical justifications for allowable damage and failure criteria for critical Nyx hardware, in collaboration with the relevant subsystem and discipline specialists.
 Establish the supporting rationale through analysis and test evidence, addressing relevant strength, stability, fatigue, fracture, damage tolerance, and residual performance considerations as applicable to each component.
 Support NASA SRP activities by preparing mechanical justification, contributing to compliance matrices and verification evidence, and addressing technical questions and review actions with the safety and certification teams.
 Review qualification strategies, test plans, and reports for consistency with applicable NASA requirements, agreed standards, and the assumptions used in mechanical analyses.
 Participate in design reviews, identify gaps in mechanical justification, and recommend design changes or additional verification activities to resolve them.
 Supplier Interactions and Team Collaboration
 Review supplier designs, structural analyses, and verification documentation to assess technical maturity and consistency with subsystem and vehicle requirements at key milestones.
 Provide practical technical guidance to suppliers and subsystem owners, resolving mechanical issues and following technical actions through to closure.
 Facilitate technical alignment between subsystem teams, structural analysis, materials and processes, testing, safety and certification, and suppliers, ensuring that assumptions, interfaces, and responsibilities are clearly understood.
 What We Would Love to See from You
 Qualifications:
 Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent relevant practical experience.
 Minimum 5 years of relevant professional experience in mechanical or structural engineering within the aerospace or aeronautics industry.
 Demonstrated hands-on experience designing and justifying structural or mechanical hardware through development and qualification, in aerospace or aeronautics.
 Experience assessing relevant failure mechanisms and developing defensible mechanical justifications, including damage acceptance or failure criteria for safety-critical hardware.
 Ability to perform and critically review engineering calculations and FEA, interpret CAD models and engineering drawings, and relate analysis assumptions to the physical design and test configuration.
 Understanding of mechanical requirements flow-down, qualification and verification processes, and traceable compliance evidence, together with familiarity with applicable space standards and NASA requirements.
 Demonstrated ability to guide engineers and suppliers through complex mechanical problems while considering subsystem interfaces and vehicle-level consequences.
 Additional experience we would value: 
 Direct involvement in NASA safety reviews or SRP submissions, particularly the preparation and defence of mechanical qualification and the closure of review actions.
 Experience with pressurized structures, fluid piping, radiators, or propulsion hardware, and with fracture control, damage tolerance, or structural test campaigns.
 Skills and Behaviors:
 System-Level Thinking: Ability to connect component-level design and failure mechanisms with subsystem interfaces, vehicle performance, and safety objectives.
 Engineering Judgement: Ability to identify governing load paths and failure modes, challenge modelling assumptions, and distinguish between a numerical result and a sound mechanical justification.
 Influence & Decision-Making: Ability to guide technical decisions across teams and suppliers through clear reasoning and evidence, while working within agreed technical responsibilities.
 Mentorship: Ability to share practical design experience and help engineers strengthen their structural understanding and verification practices.
 Stakeholder Management: Ability to work constructively with internal teams, suppliers, and external reviewers, including NASA, in coordination with the safety and certification teams.
 Problem-Solving: Proactive in identifying mechanical risks, prioritizing substantiation gaps, and developing proportionate solutions that protect technical integrity and program objectives.
 Communication: Clear and structured communicator, able to explain assumptions, load paths, failure criteria, and supporting evidence to different technical audiences.
 Demonstrates behaviors consistent with The Exploration Company’s core values of Vision, Competence, Integrity and Passion.
 Fluent in English. Knowledge of German, French and Italian is an asset.
 Why you should join us! 
 What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is:  
 We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind

 We have a lot of Fun - we refuel our energy knowing we are democratising space. It’s a wonderful and rare opportunity, are YOU up for the challenge?

items.jobDescription:
In unserem Fachbereich Wasser, Umwelt, Bau und Sicherheit (WUBS) ist zum nächstmöglichen Startzeitpunkt folgende Stelle zu besetzen:
## **Wissenschaftlicher Mitarbeiter (m/w/d) im Projekt "Sichere Logistik Erneuerbarer Energien" (SLEE) im WIR!-Bündnis "Feuerwehr der Zukunft" (m/w/d)**
**Eingruppierung:**
bis zur E13 TV-L
**Arbeitszeit:**
30 Std./Woche
**Standort:**
Magdeburg
**Befristung:**
31.07.2027
## Werden Sie Teil unseres Teams!
Mit dem Ausbau von Wasserstoff, Ammoniak, Methanol und weiteren erneuerbaren Energieträgern entstehen neue und teilweise schwer einschätzbare Schadenslagen für Feuerwehren und andere Akteure der Gefahrenabwehr – sowohl an Land als auch auf dem Wasser. Vor diesem Hintergrund soll im Rahmen einer gemeinsamen Machbarkeitsstudie der drei WIR!-Bündnisse „CAPTN Energy“, „UAM InnoRegion SH“ und „Feuerwehr der Zukunft“ untersucht werden, wie gut Betreiber und Akteure der Gefahrenabwehr auf mögliche Gefahrenlagen vorbereitet sind und wie ihre Zusammenarbeit und Vernetzung ausgestaltet ist.
Ziel der Machbarkeitsstudie ist es, den aktuellen Stand der Vorbereitung und Zusammenarbeit von Betreibern, Feuerwehren, Fachämtern und weiteren relevanten Akteuren zu erfassen und zu bewerten. Dabei werden die Schnittstellen zwischen Energielogistik, Technologieeinsatz und Einsatzpraxis analysiert, bestehende Einsatzkonzepte und Strategien der Gefahrenabwehr untersucht sowie technologische und regulatorische Rahmenbedingungen berücksichtigt. Auf dieser Grundlage sollen bestehende Lücken und konkrete Forschungs- und Entwicklungsbedarfe identifiziert werden, um daraus einen Projektantrag für ein anschlussfähiges Folgeprojekt abzuleiten.
Die Hochschule Magdeburg-Stendal bringt dabei insbesondere die Perspektive der Gefahrenabwehr ein und stellt sicher, dass die Ergebnisse der Machbarkeitsstudie an den Anforderungen und Bedürfnissen der Einsatzpraxis ausgerichtet sind.
## Ihre neue Herausforderung
- Erhebung und Bewertung des Ist-Stands der Gefahrenvorbereitung sowie Analyse der Zusammenarbeit und Vernetzung von Betreibern, Feuerwehren, Fachämtern und weiteren Akteuren der Gefahrenabwehr
- Analyse und Validierung von Einsatzszenarien entlang von Energielogistikketten (insbesondere Wasserstoff und Ammoniak) an Land und auf dem Wasser sowie Bewertung bestehender Einsatzkonzepte, technologischer und regulatorischer Rahmenbedingungen und Identifikation von Transferlücken
- Ermittlung der Anforderungen von Einsatzkräften mittels Experteninterviews, Befragungen, Prozessanalysen und Workshops sowie Ableitung und Priorisierung praxisrelevanter Handlungs- und Forschungsbedarfe
- Abstimmung mit den Verbundpartnern CAU Kiel und HAW Kiel, Mitwirkung an Projektmeilensteinen sowie wissenschaftliche Aufbereitung der Ergebnisse und Ausarbeitung eines Projektantrags für ein anschlussfähiges Folgeprojekt
## Sie bringen mit
- erfolgreich abgeschlossenes wissenschaftliches Hochschulstudium (Master oder Universitätsdiplom), fachrichtungsunabhängig
- Erfahrung mit wissenschaftlichen Analysemethoden sowie Fähigkeit, komplexe interdisziplinäre Sachverhalte strukturiert zu analysieren, zu bewerten und zu priorisieren
- Erfahrung in der Konzeption und Moderation von Workshops sowie in der wissenschaftlichen Dokumentation, Berichterstattung und möglichst in der Entwicklung von Forschungsprojekten und der Erstellung von Projektanträgen
- Von Vorteil: Kenntnisse im Brand- und Katastrophenschutz, im Umgang mit Gefahrstoffen und neuen Energieträgern (z. B. Wasserstoff) sowie zu Drohnen, Sensorik und Lagebildsystemen. Ebenfalls von Vorteil ist Einsatzerfahrung als aktives Mitglied der Feuerwehr oder einer Hilfsorganisation
Wir freuen uns über Ihre aussagekräftige Bewerbung mit Zeugnissen, Referenzen und Nachweisen Ihrer beruflichen Expertise **bis zum 10.12.2026**.
 [Bitte nutzen Sie für Ihre Bewerbung unser Online-Bewerberportal.](https://karriere.h2.de/de/jobposting/db5ce32e20b43944cc3792e252737e264ab7c4f10/apply)

WOFÜR WIR SIE SUCHEN
Als System- / Projektingenieur (m/w/d) übernehmen Sie die Verantwortung für die Entwicklung von Systemen für taktische und logistische Fahrzeuge mit dem Schwerpunkt Ergonomie / Human Factors. Dabei arbeiten Sie in interdisziplinären Projektteams gemeinsam mit Experten aus diversen Bereichen über alle Projekt- und Produktentwicklungsphasen hinweg an der Entwicklung des Systems - von der Konzeption über die Umsetzung zur Verifikation.
Ihre Aufgaben:
 * Mitarbeit in interdisziplinären Projektteams (IPT) im Rahmen des Entwicklungsprozesses für den Bereich Ergonomie / Human Factors
 * Zentrale Ansprechfunktion im Projekt für fachbereichsübergreifende Systemfragen in Bezug auf Ergonomie / Human Factors Themen
 * Verantwortung für Qualität, Kosten und Termine die Anteile Ergonomie / Human Factors
 * Durchführung der Human Factors Aktivitäten im Entwicklungsprozess von der Anforderungsanalyse, der Digitalen Mensch-Modellierung, Nutzerstudien,…, bis zur Verifikation im Gesamtsystem
 * Requirement Engineering: Generierung, Dokumentation und Verifikation von Anforderungen aus Normen, Gesetzen, Lastenheften sowie internen Prozessen für die Anteile Ergonomie / Human Factors
 * Erstellung und regelmäßige Überprüfung sämtlicher Arbeitsprodukte gemäß Systems-Engineering-, Projekt- und internen Standards
 * Führung von Entwicklungs- und Dienstleistungen bei externen Partnern im Rahmen von Arbeitspaketen und Teilprojekten
 * Zusammenarbeit mit angrenzenden Fachbereichen während Beschaffung, Fertigung, Inbetriebnahme sowie Verifikations- und Validierungsphasen
 * Weiterentwicklung der Fachstrategie Ergonomie, Human Factors in internen Arbeitsgruppen
* Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes (Fach-)Hochschulstudium der Bereiche Elektrotechnik, Maschinenbau, Fahrzeugbau, Luft- & Raumfahrt, Human Factors Engineering oder vergleichbar
 * Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung als Systemingenieur / technischer Projektleiter (m/w/d) in der Entwicklung technischer Systeme mit Fokus auf Ergonomie und Human Factors
 * Erfahrungen im Projektmanagement und Systems Engineering (Qualifikation Projektmanagement IPMA Level D, System Engineering Level C und / oder IREB Foundation Level wünschenswert)
 * Sicherer Umgang mit Prozessen, Methoden und Tools des Human Factors Engineering (u.a. Digitale Mensch-Modellierung in RAMSIS oder vergleichbar)
 * Erfahrung im Umgang mit interdisziplinären Entwicklungsteams sowie in der Steuerung und Führung von Fremdfirmen
 * Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
 * Vertrautheit mit strukturierten Entwicklungsprozessen in einem Konzernumfeld
 * Fähigkeit, auch unter Zeitdruck präzise und fehlerfrei zu arbeiten
 * Bereitschaft zu gelegentlichen Dienstreisen
An unserem Standort in Kassel bieten wir Ihnen:
 * Arbeiten an Gesamtsystemen
 * Betriebliche Altersvorsorge
 * Mitarbeiteraktienkaufprogramm
 * Ergebnisbeteiligung
 * Flexible Arbeitszeitmodelle, Gleitzeitmodell sowie VIVA-Familien-Service
 * Subventioniertes Mittagessen und Kiosk am Standort

 * Vergünstigtes Jobticket
 * Individuelle und vielfältige externe sowie interne Weiterentwicklungsmöglichkeiten, u.a. in der Rheinmetall Academy
 * Professioneller Einarbeitungsprozess begleitet durch ein digitales Onboarding-Tool

The role and the team
 As a Junior Technical Service Engineer (all genders), you’ll help new customers get up and running on Lucanet, owning technical onboarding from ERP integration and ETL processes through to SQL database setup. You’ll guide customers on video calls, troubleshoot technical issues hands-on, and support their move from on-premise to the cloud, growing your technical skills with every implementation.
You’ll join our Technical Customer Operations team, a collaborative group supporting a growing international customer base through their transition to Lucanet. You’ll work closely with experienced colleagues who are invested in your growth, and with the technical stakeholders on the customer side. We look for people who keep growing, take real ownership, and lift the people around them.
What you'll do
 Execute technical onboarding for new customers, covering ERP integration, ETL processes, data transformations, and ongoing technical support.
 Install, configure, and manage Lucanet software components, interfaces, and SQL databases through to handover and customer acceptance.
 Act as a technical point of contact, running customer video calls to troubleshoot issues and guide setup.
 Analyze logs, research solutions with internal resources and AI tools, and resolve issues with colleagues and customers.
 Improve onboarding and integration processes, creating documentation and best practices for your teammates.
 Support customers migrating from on-premise installations to the Lucanet cloud platform.
 What you bring to the table
 You have
 Experience in technical support, implementation support, or a comparable technical role.
 Basic SQL skills: you read queries, navigate database tables, and write simple queries of your own.
 Knowledge of ERP systems, Windows Server environments, and networking basics such as ports and database connections.
 Confidence working directly with customers and their technical stakeholders, communicating clearly and professionally in German and English.
 A resourceful approach to problem-solving, using documentation, internal resources, and AI tools to find answers independently.
 A degree in Computer Science, IT, Networks, or a related field.

 Professional development budget – Get dedicated time, resources and budget to build the skills for your career path.

 Paid volunteer days – Take the time to volunteer, alone or with your team, for causes you care about.
 Health and wellbeing support – Access company wellbeing programs, sport subsidies and mental health support through external partners.
 Paid vacation days – Take 30 days a year to rest, travel and recharge.
 Pension support – Build your retirement savings with employer pension contributions.
 Corporate discounts platform – Get exclusive discounts across travel, retail, technology, and more.
 About Lucanet
 Lucanet is the CFO solution platform for modern finance and tax teams, automating processes from consolidation and financial planning to tax compliance, ESG reporting, and cash management. More than 6,000 companies worldwide rely on our easy-to-use, out-of-the-box SaaS platform. We're PE-backed and growing across global markets. 
Behind the platform is a global team of 900+ people who care about doing the work well. We challenge each other to move fast without cutting corners and build solutions that change how finance and tax leaders operate. If you want your work to have real reach, and your growth is important to you, Lucanet is the right place for you.
Discover more about Lucanet as an employer.
 Powered by uniqueness
 Everybody is different here and we like it that way. We welcome people of every gender identity, sexual orientation, ethnicity, national origin, religion, age, and disability, exactly as they are. What you bring is what matters. If you need an adjustment to take part in our hiring process, let us know. See yourself in this role? We want to hear from you.

 For Airbus Defence & Space in Taufkirchen we are looking for a
 Ground Segment Systems Engineer - RF & Satellite
 Communications Expert (d/f/m) 
 to join the System Delivery Germany team. The department is responsible for the design, development, and procurement of ground segment for military and civil satellite communication systems, with a strong focus on RF systems and ground station engineering.
This job combines knowledge of several disciplines with the ability to think outside the box.
Your location
Our site is just a stone's throw away from Munich, the beautiful capital of Bavaria. You are into sports and other outdoor activities? The Alps and Lake Starnberg are within an hour’s reach, offering a multitude of recreational options.
Your benefits
 Attractive salary and special payments

 Excellent upskilling opportunities and great international, group wide development prospects

 Master's degree in Microwave Engineering, Telecommunications, RF Systems, or related field.

 Experience in design, development, integration, verification, and operations of RF ground systems and associated processes.

items.jobDescription:
About Alta Ares
Alta Ares is an air defense Neoprime. We build AI-guided interceptors to counter drones and cruise missiles, along with the software platform that powers them.
 Our customers are NATO-aligned militaries and defense institutions, and our systems are regularly deployed during live exercises and operational demonstrations across Europe, the Middle East, and Asia.
 Founded in 2024, we have grown to 160 people, raised over $60M, and increased revenue 40× this year. We are now entering a new phase of international expansion, industrial scaling, fundraising, and product development.
 Role Overview
 We are looking for a hands-on Verification & Validation Engineer to define and execute verification and validation activities across our products and systems.
 Working closely with Hardware, Software, Systems Engineering and Manufacturing teams, you will ensure that our systems meet their technical requirements, perform as intended and are ready for production and operational deployment.
Key Responsibilities
 Verification & Validation 
 Develop and execute system-level Verification & Validation (V&V) plans.
 Translate system and subsystem requirements into test procedures and acceptance criteria.
 Define and conduct functional, performance and integration testing.
 Verify hardware and software interfaces and system-level performance.
 Ensure full traceability between requirements, test cases, results and identified deviations.
 Testing & Qualification 
 Plan and execute testing campaigns across prototypes, subsystems and integrated systems.
 Coordinate environmental, mechanical, electrical and functional testing.
 Define and execute qualification and acceptance tests, including FAT and SAT.
 Analyse test results, identify failures and coordinate root cause investigations.
 Ensure corrective actions are implemented and successfully verified.
 System Integration & Industrialisation 
 Work closely with engineering teams to validate system integration and overall product performance.
 Support prototype testing, design verification and production readiness.
 Coordinate testing activities with external suppliers and testing laboratories.
 Contribute to the definition and improvement of V&V methodologies and processes.
 Documentation & Reporting 
 Prepare and maintain test plans, procedures and validation reports.
 Track verification status, test coverage and outstanding technical issues.
 Ensure proper documentation and traceability throughout the development lifecycle.
Candidate Profile 
 Master's degree in Systems, Aerospace, Mechanical, Electrical or Software Engineering.
 2–5 years of experience in Verification & Validation, system testing or qualification engineering.
 Experience in aerospace, defence, automotive, robotics or complex electromechanical systems.
 Strong understanding of requirements management, verification methods and test methodologies.
 Experience with hardware/software integration and system-level testing.
 Familiarity with environmental testing and qualification processes.
 Experience with requirements and test management tools

Flink Robotics is a fast-paced startup backed by world-class VCs, originating from the Computational Robotics Lab at ETH Zurich. We’re building the next generation of plug-and-play robots, powered by a novel approach to make robots autonomous. Our robots are designed to revolutionize material handling, from stacking boxes to sorting parcels and unloading goods.
 We’re looking for a hands-on Deployment Engineer who loves debugging, stress-testing and is ready to install robots that move the world’s parcels. In this role, you’ll be the face of Flink at customer sites and industry events, making sure every system is rigorously tested, commissioned and continuously improved.
 Who you are 
 Eager to join a VC-backed startup in its early phase and take ownership of field projects.
 Passionate about robotics: from mechanics and electronics to computer vision and control.
 Proactive problem-solver wanting to learn new things
 Clear communicator, fluent in English, German, French, and other languages is a strong plus.
 Excited about frequent travel to production sites (up to 60 %).
 Enjoys collaborating with multidisciplinary teams and customers on the shop floor.
 What you bring 
 Mechanical engineering background with experience designing, prototyping, and building mechanical assemblies
 Ability to diagnose and resolve hardware and software issues, with an understanding of mechatronics, sensors, networking and basic control principles
 Demonstrated track record in commissioning complex electromechanical or robotic systems in the field
 Excited about travel and deploying robots in production environments
 Prior robot deployments, proficiency in German or other languages, driver's license and familiarity with Linux are a plus
 What you'll do 
 Assemble, configure and test our robots in the lab and at customer sites to iterate and improve the system
 Plan, coordinate and execute on-site installations, acting as the technical lead and ensuring a smooth handover to the customer
 Design, prototype, and produce mechanical and electrical elements for new product run deployments
 Train operators and provide hands-on support during ramp-up, collecting insights that feed straight back into our product roadmap
 Diagnose and resolve complex hardware/software issues, both remotely and on-site
 Why join 
 A great team dedicated to building a product with almost unlimited potential
 Work on challenging problems at the cutting edge of robotics
 Competitive salary, equity, and top-tier gear
 Work in a central office in Zurich and around the world, wherever our partners are
 Apply now if you’re ready to push boundaries and help shape the future of robotics!

Über assemblean
 Wir bei assemblean revolutionieren die Art und Weise, wie komplexe Bauteile und Baugruppen entstehen. Als modernes On-Demand-Fertigungsnetzwerk vereinen wir Entwicklung, Produktion, Montage und digitale Qualitätssicherung unter einem Dach. Von Fräsmaschinen über CNC-Dreh- und Frästeile bis hin zu hochentwickelten mechatronischen Systemen bringen wir innovative Produkte für unsere Kunden zum Leben. Wenn du Lust auf ein dynamisches Technologieumfeld, modernste Industrie-4.0-Prozesse und ein motiviertes Team hast, bist du bei uns genau richtig!
 Deine Aufgaben
 Projekte eigenverantwortlich umsetzen: Du bekommst deine Aufträge und Anforderungen zugeteilt und ziehst die Konstruktion von der ersten Idee bis zur fertigen Zeichnung selbstständig durch.
 Konstruktion mit Onshape: Du konstruierst Bauteile, Vorrichtungen und komplexe Baugruppen direkt im Cloud-CAD-System Onshape.
 Fertigungsgerechte Auslegung: Du erstellst die 3D-Modelle, Ableitungen und Stücklisten so, dass sie in der Werkstatt oder im Fertigungsnetzwerk direkt und problemlos gebaut werden können.
 Dein Profil
 Ausbildung/Studium (Erforderlich): Eine erfolgreich abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung im technischen Bereich, z. B. als Technischer Produktdesigner (m/w/d), Technische Zeichner (m/w/d) oder eine vergleichbare handwerklich-technische Grundausbildung mit starkem CAD-Bezug oder ein abgeschlossenes Maschinenbaustudium.
 Zusatzqualifikationen (Optional): Eine Weiterbildung zum Techniker ist herzlich willkommen, aber kein Kriterium – für uns zählt deine praktische Fähigkeit in der Konstruktion.
 CAD-Kenntnisse: Du bist Profi in einem gängigen 3D-CAD-System wie SolidWorks und hast Lust auf einen schnellen Umstieg zu Onshape.
 Selbstständigkeit: Du brauchst kein langes Händchenhalten. Du erfasst die Anforderungen, denkst dich in das Problem hinein und legst eigenverantwortlich los.

About Rocket Factory Augsburg
 At Rocket Factory Augsburg (RFA) , we have one clear goal: to create low-cost, flexible, and reliable access to space. We specialize in building small launch vehicles designed to deploy satellites into Low Earth Orbit (LEO) and beyond. Together with you, we aim to revolutionize space services and help improve life on Earth. Sounds interesting? Then join our journey and become part of the team driving the New Space movement in Europe. 
 About the Team
 Join our international and fast-moving Launch & Ground Systems team and help shape the future of European space transportation. As a Ground Systems Engineer (m/f/d) , you will play a key role in designing, developing, and commissioning the critical infrastructure that enables rocket testing and launch operations.
 This position offers the opportunity to work across the entire engineering lifecycle, from concept development and system architecture to commissioning and operational support. You will collaborate with experts from propulsion, launch operations, avionics, manufacturing, and safety to deliver robust and reliable ground systems for launch and test sites.
 If you are passionate about solving complex engineering challenges, enjoy working hands-on with hardware, and want to contribute directly to making space more accessible, we would love to hear from you.
 Your Tasks
 Support the design, development, and implementation of ground support systems for launch and test facilities, including fluid, mechanical, and process systems.
 Contribute to engineering activities throughout the system lifecycle, from requirements definition and conceptual design to commissioning and operational support.
 Perform engineering calculations, analyses, and technical assessments for pressure, fluid handling, and mechanical systems.
 Create and maintain technical documentation, including P&IDs, system specifications, engineering drawings, procedures, and test reports.
 Support commissioning campaigns, troubleshooting activities, and performance improvements of installed systems.
 Participate in safety reviews, risk assessments, HAZOP studies, and design validation activities.
 Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams, suppliers, and contractors to support successful project execution.
 Your Qualifications
 Must-Have Skills 
 Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Process Engineering, Physics, or a related technical discipline.
 Experience designing, developing, operating, or maintaining industrial, test-site, process, or ground support systems.
 Good understanding of pressure systems, fluid mechanics, piping systems, or process engineering principles.
 Experience creating and interpreting technical documentation such as P&IDs, engineering drawings, system layouts, and technical reports.
 Familiarity with industrial instrumentation, sensors, valves, control systems, and automation interfaces.
 Experience working with engineering design tools such as Siemens NX or comparable 3D CAD software.
 Ability to analyze technical challenges, develop practical solutions, and work effectively within multidisciplinary teams.
 Strong communication skills and professional proficiency in English. 
 Nice-to-Have Skills 
 Hands-on experience supporting commissioning, testing, operations, or maintenance activities in industrial facilities, test sites, or launch environments.
 Knowledge of cryogenic systems, high-pressure gas systems, vacuum systems, or propellant infrastructure.
 Familiarity with launch operations, aerospace ground support equipment (GSE), or space systems.
 Experience contributing to safety and risk assessments such as HAZOP, FMEA, or similar methodologies.
 Experience working with suppliers, contractors, or external engineering partners.
 German language skills.
 Willingness to travel to test and launch sites as required.
 We Offer
 Atmosphere: Experience life in an international & dynamic New Space start-up  
 Flexibility: Fit your working schedule to your needs with flexible working hours  
 Home Office: Full-time employees benefit from one day per week home office  
 Health: Sweat, stretch or squat it out with EGYM Wellpass  
 Paid Time Off: 30 days annual leave and speacial leave days   
 Team Culture: Join regular company and team events  
 Parking: Free parking for your car or bike 
 Insights
 Ready to take the next step? 
 Join RFA and help build one of Europe’s most efficient launch systems. Work alongside 300+ colleagues from over 40 countries and take ownership from day one. 
 If you’re looking to grow, take responsibility, and contribute to making space more accessible, we’d love to hear from you. 
 🚀 Apply now!   We look forward to receiving your application in English.
