About Mistral 
 Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.
 We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.
 The Role 
 The Inference Foundation team owns the core of Mistral's inference stack: the inference engine and its orchestration, from the feature set and configuration that serve our models in production to the release machinery that keeps the stack current and production-grade.
 This is a hybrid position spanning production LLM serving, engine and platform development, and capacity engineering. You will work on three intertwined problems:
 Optimize the inference stack at scale — feature development and fixes in the engine and orchestrator, squeezing more throughput and lower latency out of every GPU under strict quality-of-service targets.
 Make capacity elastic — scaling up and down should be cheap and fast, not a performance cliff.
 Power the training of our frontier models — high-performance serving that keeps RL and post-training loops running at full speed.
   What You Will Do 
 Inference engine & orchestration
 Develop and fix the core of the inference stack — engine and orchestrator — including feature selection, configuration, and tuning for maximum performance at scale
 Own the release process for the serving stack: validated, regression-free releases through automated performance gates and progressive rollout
 Drive improvements and fixes upstream when the open-source engine is the right place for them
 Performance & capacity at scale
 Optimize serving efficiency across the fleet — driving down pod startup time, tackling cold-cache regressions on scale-up, smarter caching and offloading
 Optimize and maintain the optimal serving topology — overlap communication and transfers with computation, ensure optimal placement, connectivity, and routing
 Serving for frontier training
 Build the serving infrastructure that powers RL and post-training for our frontier models
 Optimize inference performance across the full spectrum of our workloads
   What We're Looking For 
 Experience building and running ML/LLM services at scale, with clear latency and availability targets
 Hands-on experience with inference engines such as vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, or others
 A solid grasp of inference internals: prefill vs. decode, KV-cache behavior, batching, scheduling, speculative decoding, parallelism strategies
 Familiarity with distributed and disaggregated serving architectures
 Comfortable debugging across the full stack — CUDA/NCCL, kernels, containers, networking, storage
 Python for systems tooling and backend services; PyTorch
 Kubernetes for running infrastructure at scale
 GPU and networking fundamentals: CUDA runtime, NCCL, InfiniBand/RDMA
 It Would Be Great If You Have 
 Demonstrated vLLM/sglang know-how — upstream contributions, or a track record of running in demanding production environments
 Hardware-aware optimization for various model architectures
 Experience serving MoE models at scale (expert parallelism, expert placement/load balancing)
 CUDA/Triton kernel development; Nsight Systems/Compute profiling
 Rust and/or C++ in production systems
 What We Offer 
 We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.
 For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page .
 Privacy Policy

About us 
 Artefact is a data and AI services company with around 2,500 people across 36 offices. We are part of Anthropic's Claude Partner Network and have rolled out Claude across our own organization, so our advice to clients comes from running it ourselves first.
 DeployCo is Artefact's team dedicated to deploying Claude at scale inside enterprises. It works through three levers. Deployment and adoption gets organizations from a few early adopters to company-wide use. Process reimagination redesigns core workflows around agentic AI. Agent production ships working agents into client systems. Forward Deployed Engineers are the builders behind the third lever and the technical backbone of the other two.
 The role 
 As an FDE you join a client's own AI or engineering team as a builder, not an advisor. You design, code, and ship production-grade Claude solutions directly inside their stack, following their conventions, repositories, and CI. You also leave the capability behind, so that when the engagement ends the client's engineers can extend and maintain what was built without us.
The work ranges from short, intense engagements, like standing up a governed Claude Code deployment in a few weeks, to longer embeds where you become the technical anchor of a multi-agent portfolio and a larger Artefact pod grows around you. This is a senior role, and we expect you to own technical direction on an engagement from the first week.
 What you'll do 
 Build production agents. Design and deploy Claude-based agents and workflows that run in production, with the engineering standards that implies. That means tests, error handling, monitoring, and cost control.
 Connect Claude to enterprise systems. Build custom MCP servers and connectors to business applications and data sources, enforcing the client's own access rules. This includes permissions, traceability, and segregation of rights.
 Engineer the context layer. Contribute to Artefact's context platform approach, including deterministic authentication before data reaches the model, user-level context injection, and observability for token spend and security.
 Deploy and govern Claude Code. Set up SSO and role-based access, managed settings, approved MCP servers and plugin marketplaces, permission modes, sandboxing, and OpenTelemetry-based usage monitoring. Help clients choose between deployment options (Team, Enterprise, cloud providers, gateways) based on security, data residency, and cost.
 Build reusable skills. Turn client workflows into Claude Skills and shared skills libraries that teams can find, reuse, and build on.
 Enable client engineers. Pair program, review code, document patterns, and deliver hands-on Claude Code training and labs, sometimes to cohorts of dozens of developers and sometimes to CTOs and engineering leaders.
 Feed the product loop. Capture deployment pitfalls and product feedback from the field and share it with Anthropic through our partnership.
 What you bring 
 Senior-level experience in software engineering or data science, with production systems you have shipped and operated
 Recent, hands-on work with the GenAI stack, going beyond prototypes. This includes tool use, agent design, retrieval, evaluation, and prompt and context engineering.
 Demonstrated depth with Claude in particular, such as Claude Code, the Claude API, Skills, or MCP, and a point of view on how the stack is evolving
 Strong Python or TypeScript, and solid grounding in enterprise integration, including APIs, identity and access management (SSO, OAuth, SCIM), and cloud platforms
 Confidence in client-facing settings, explaining technical trade-offs to engineers and to non-technical stakeholders, and running a workshop when needed
 Fluent in German and English 
 Nice to have 
 Anthropic certification (Claude Certified Developer or Architect) is welcome but not expected, since it is usually only available through a partner company. We support you in earning it once you join.
 Experience building and securing MCP servers
 Background in security, observability (OpenTelemetry), or FinOps for AI workloads
 Experience in regulated industries such as banking, asset management, or pharma
 A track record of teaching or technical training
 What we offer 
 Direct work with Anthropic's partner and applied AI teams, including co-delivered labs
 Varied, high-impact engagements across EMEA in finance, retail, industry, and consumer goods
 A clear path from FDE to technical anchor of a full AI delivery pod
 Certification support and dedicated learning time
 Don't worry if you don't meet all the criteria! At Artefact, we value motivation, pragmatic problem-solving, and potential above all else.If you are excited about shaping the future of AI and ready to make a real impact, we'd love to hear from you. 
 Diversity & Inclusion at Artefact > We believe that unique perspectives fuel innovation. At Artefact, we are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive. We welcome and consider all applications purely based on merit, skills, and potential - regardless of gender identity, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, religion, age, background, or disability. Come as you are! 
 Ready to take the next step? Please submit your CV showcasing your experience and passion for this role as a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) - Anthropic (m/f/d). We look forward to receiving your application! 
 If you have any questions, feel free to send us a message at ----- Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

In a single environment, teams design and operate analytics, machine learning, and AI agents with the transparency, collaboration, and control enterprises require. Sitting above data platforms, cloud infrastructure, and AI services, Dataiku connects the full enterprise AI stack - empowering organizations to run AI across multi-vendor environments with centralized governance.
The world’s leading companies rely on Dataiku to operationalize AI and run it as a true business performance engine delivering measurable value. For more, visit the Dataiku blog , LinkedIn , X , and YouTube .
 Dataiku is looking for a Sr. Data Platform Engineer to join our Enterprise Data and Analytics (EDA) team. As a member of the EDA Team, you will play a central role in delivering data & GenAI solutions to fuel analytics and data-driven insights to various stakeholders and teams within the company. You will be a key technical member contributing to the Data Platform that fuels centralized analytics, embedded analytics teams, and self-service users across the organization.
 At this level of seniority, non-technical skills, learning & teaching, and business acumen are critical, along with the expectation of technical excellence, as you will help drive technical decision-making and solutioning of key technical challenges both within the team and across the Analytics Community. The technical day-to-day will primarily be within the Data Platform built using Snowflake, Dataiku & GitHub. The primary development will focus on GenAI Platform Capabilities, Python & SQL (among other languages), DataOps processes built within GitHub Actions & Dataiku, and data platform processes built within Snowflake & Dataiku. Strong software development lifecycle knowledge and DataOps skills are a must! The ideal candidate is naturally curious, has excellent verbal and written communication skills, has a sharp analytical mind, a positive attitude towards work and thrives when collaborating towards a shared goal. This is an internal and non-client facing role.

 Be an expert-level engineer across Dataiku (Platform Automation, GenAI Capabilities, Plugin Development, maintenance & troubleshooting) and Snowflake (data engineering, security/governance), including building & maintaining GenAI Platform solutions with a security/governance focus
 Build & maintain Python & SQL-based platform automation and DataOps processes for SDLC delivery
 Build & maintain data quality, observability, monitoring, alerting, access management, and platform transparency systems
 Assist Data Engineering with Python & SQL data replication & pipelines on large, complex datasets
 Design data models (short- and long-term) to support data warehouse scalability
 Collaborate with GenAI Engineering & Analytics Engineering to build scalable Data Platform solutions
 Perform root cause analysis on complex errors to ensure pipeline availability

items.jobTitle: Promotion - Industrial Sabbatical on Embodiment-Aware Transfer of Human Skills to Robots
items.jobDescription:
Bei Bosch Research entwickeln wir robuste Physical-AI-Lösungen, die auch unter realen industriellen Rahmenbedingungen zuverlässig funktionieren. Unsere Robotikforschung verbindet modernste Methoden des maschinellen Lernens mit der industriellen Automatisierung in der Praxis.
Die Skalierung von Steuerungsstrategien für robotische Manipulationsaufgaben erfordert in der Regel große Mengen an Teleoperationsdaten, deren Erhebung zeitaufwendig sowie arbeitsintensiv ist. Demonstrationen aus der Ich-Perspektive des Menschen bieten zwar eine skalierbare Alternative, die Übertragung menschlicher Bewegungen auf Industrieroboter bringt jedoch erhebliche Unterschiede hinsichtlich Kinematik, Kontaktbedingungen und physischer Ausführung mit sich.
 Im Rahmen dieses PhD-Forschungspraktikums untersuchen Sie die Übertragung menschlicher Fähigkeiten auf mobile, zweiarmige Roboterplattformen und leisten damit einen Beitrag zur Entwicklung robuster Lernverfahren für reale industrielle Anwendungen im gesamten Bosch-Fertigungsnetzwerk.
 Sie entwickeln und evaluieren Algorithmen für das Feasibility-Aware Retargeting, um menschliche Demonstrationen an die Kinematik sowie die Einschränkungen mobiler, zweiarmiger Roboter anzupassen. Dabei identifizieren und beheben Sie kinematische Abweichungen bereits vor dem Training der Steuerungsstrategien und treiben deren Übertragbarkeit voran.
 Mit Fokus auf den Embodiment Transfer bewerten Sie die Leistungsfähigkeit, Generalisierbarkeit sowie Übertragbarkeit von Steuerungsstrategien auf unterschiedliche Roboterplattformen.
 Im Bereich der Dateneffizienz untersuchen Sie optimale Mischungsverhältnisse und Datenanforderungen für die Kombination menschlicher Videodemonstrationen mit Roboterdaten.
 Durch experimentelle Validierung vergleichen und bewerten Sie erlernte Steuerungsstrategien anhand realer sowie simulierter industrieller Manipulationsaufgaben mit zweiarmigen Robotern.
 Sie veröffentlichen wissenschaftliche Forschungsergebnisse auf führenden Robotikkonferenzen (z. B. RSS, CoRL, ICRA, IROS) und arbeiten eng mit Bosch-Forschungsteams zusammen, um die Lücke zwischen Forschungsprototypen und industriellen Anwendungen zu schließen.
 Nicht zuletzt erweitern Sie Ihr berufliches Netzwerk durch den aktiven Austausch innerhalb der globalen Bosch-Forschungsgemeinschaft.
Ausbildung:  hervorragend abgeschlossenes Masterstudium in Informatik, Mathematik, Physik, Elektrotechnik, Robotik oder eines verwandten Fachgebiets
 Erfahrungen und Know-how: Forschungserfahrung in Machine Learning, Vision-Language-Action-Modellen (VLAs), Vision-Language-Modellen (VLMs), Reinforcement Learning, Robotik, autonomen Systemen oder autonomem Fahren
 nachgewiesene exzellente Forschungsleistungen durch Publikationen, Forschungsprojekte, Open-Source-Beiträge oder eine herausragende Masterarbeit
 fundierte Softwareentwicklungskenntnisse in Python und PyTorch; zusätzliche Erfahrung mit JAX, C++, CUDA oder Frameworks für das Training großer ML-Modelle von Vorteil
 Erfahrung mit Simulationsumgebungen, Robotersystemen oder Plattformen für autonomes Fahren wünschenswert
 Publikationen auf führenden Konferenzen (z. B. NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, CoRL, RSS, ICRA, IROS, CVPR, ICCV, ECCV) besonders willkommen
 zusätzliche Expertise in Reinforcement Learning, Imitation Learning, World Models, generativer KI oder Foundation Models von Vorteil
 praktische Erfahrung mit der Durchführung umfangreicher Experimente auf GPU-Clustern oder Cloud-/HPC-Infrastrukturen wünschenswert
 Erfahrung im Bereich Embodied AI, autonomes Fahren oder Robotik als zusätzliche Qualifikation willkommen
 Persönlichkeit und Arbeitsweise:  Sie überzeugen durch herausragende akademische Leistungen, eine ausgeprägte Forschungsorientierung sowie exzellente Programmierkenntnisse; dank Ihres analytischen Denkvermögens und Ihrer Problemlösungskompetenz meistern Sie auch komplexe Herausforderungen souverän; dabei arbeiten Sie selbstständig, bringen sich aktiv in kollaborative Forschungsumgebungen ein und leisten einen wertvollen Beitrag zur interdisziplinären Teamarbeit; idealerweise verfügen Sie zudem über ein überzeugendes Empfehlungsschreiben einer früheren wissenschaftlichen Betreuungsperson
 Sprachen:  verhandlungssicheres Englisch in Wort und Schrift, Deutschkenntnisse sind von Vorteil

items.jobDescription:

Du begeisterst dich für Software, IT und Technik und liebst es, anderen bei technischen Herausforderungen zu helfen? Idealerweise hat du bereits Erfahrung mit digitalen Kommunikationssystemen. Dann werde Teil des STARFACE-Teams und gestalte mit uns die Kommunikation der Zukunft!

 Unternehmensweite Transparenz und abteilungsübergreifende Kommunikation – wir verstehen uns als ein großes STARFACE Team
 Flexible Arbeitszeiten, soweit keine Servicezeiten abzudecken sind
 Flache Hierarchien, die im täglichen Miteinander nicht zu spüren sind. Wir führen Kommunikation auf Augenhöhe

Wir zeichnen uns durch eine dynamische Unternehmenskultur aus. Bei STARFACE wachsen wir schnell und gerne auch mal über uns hinaus. Wir gestalten erstklassige Lösungen und ein attraktives Arbeitsumfeld. “Wir” – das sind bei der STARFACE -Group GmbH ca. 250 Mitarbeitende – und es werden stetig mehr!
Wir sind auf der Suche nach motivierten Mitarbeitenden, die etwas bewegen wollen. Menschen mit Mut zu neuen Ideen, die gerne Verantwortung übernehmen und aktiv mitgestalten möchten.
Bei uns steht das Miteinander im Mittelpunkt! Wir legen Wert auf einen respektvollen Umgang auf Augenhöhe. Hierarchiedenken ist bei uns fehl am Platz. Als STARFACE Team sind wir nur dann innovativ und erfolgreich, wenn alle Mitarbeitenden den nötigen Freiraum bekommen, ihre Stärken zu entfalten.
Erfahre mehr über die STARFACE GmbH in unserem Podcast: #comforttalking. Hast Du Lust, Teil der STARFACE Erfolgsgeschichte zu werden? Wir freuen uns, Dich kennenzulernen!

Was wir Dir bieten
 Eine abwechslungsreiche und spannende Tätigkeit in einer dynamischen Arbeitsatmosphäre, in der Du Dein Potenzial auch langfristig einbringen kannst,
 großzügige und moderne Büroräume mit zahlreichen Pausenzonen, ausgestattet mit gemütlichen Loungeecken und Spiele-Konsole – auch Hunde sind bei uns willkommen,
 außergewöhnliche Teamevents wie Grillabende auf unserer Dachterrasse und beste Erholungsmöglichkeiten, inklusive bezuschusster Massagen sowie vielfältigen Fitness- & Sportangeboten in Kooperation mit Hansefit,
 flache Hierarchien, eine offene Kommunikation, flexible Arbeitszeiten und die Möglichkeit, mobil zu arbeiten sowie 30 Tage Urlaub im Jahr,
 individuelle Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten, betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Zuschuss zu Kitakosten, Fahrrad-Leasing, Mitarbeiterrabatte und einiges mehr.
 Woran Du mit uns arbeitest
 Systeme zum Laufen bringen: Du installierst, konfigurierst und migrierst mithilfe von Fernwartungssoftware unsere ECM-Softwarelösung enaio® in den IT-Umgebungen unserer Kunden aus der öffentlichen Verwaltung.
 Lösungen umsetzen: Du richtest unsere Software basierend auf technischen Konzepten ein, passt sie an bestehende IT-Umgebungen an & sorgst für eine reibungslose Integration.

Who are we?
 We're a smart hydration company rebuilding an industry that still runs on sugar water and single-use packaging.
Filtered water, functional flavors, zero bottles. Still, sparkling, cold, and hot. All poured from one tap. We create hydration people want to reach for, starting with the workplace where we help teams thrive.
As an AI-native company, we build at speed. In 2025, Aquablu ranked 2nd in the Deloitte Technology Fast 50 (Netherlands) and 30th in the Sifted 250 (Europe), both rankings of the fastest-growing companies by revenue growth. In 2026 we were named a winner of Maya's Culture 100 Europe Awards as one of the best workplaces to thrive in.
Growing that fast and thriving comes down to our people. Our team is our biggest asset and one that we’re proud of. We’re committed to maintaining our vibrant culture as we continue to grow.
 About the role
 Aquablu's products run Android in more places than your pocket. Our dispensing systems ship with Android-powered on-device software that hundreds of thousands of people touch every day, and our mobile apps put hydration in users' hands. As our Android Engineer, you work across that whole surface.
 Your main arena is on-device: the software running on the hardware itself, where Android meets the physical world. Screens people tap on a machine, software that talks to firmware, updates that roll out to hundreds of deployed systems in the field. Alongside that, you contribute to our mobile development where the products need it. Few Android roles give you this range.
 This is a hands-on engineering role in a small, fast team. You own features end to end and deliver them reliably, reaching out to your manager when support is needed to unblock you. You build with AI agents as your default collaborator, you work cross-functionally with hardware, firmware, and product, proactively identifying and reaching out to key players that can help filling any gaps. 
 This role reports into our Head of Digital Product, and is part of Aquablu’s Software & Intelligence Engineering team.
 What You'll Build & Own
 On-device Android software: Features on the user-facing software running on our dispensing systems — UI, device behaviour, and the integration layer where software meets hardware. You own your features end to end.
 Fleet-ready releases: Contribute to releases that update reliably across hundreds of deployed devices in the field, where a broken release means a technician visit. The riskiest releases get a second pair of senior eyes — and you learn what makes them safe.
 Hardware & firmware integration: Work with embedded and firmware engineers to define and implement serial APIs (UART), that expose device state and trigger mechanical actions.
 Mobile contribution: Support Android development on our consumer app where the roadmap needs it.
 AI-native development: Build with AI agents every day and keep pushing what that lets you ship.
 What You Bring
 Solid Android engineering experience: A minimum of 3-5 years building and shipping Android apps in Kotlin, with a solid grasp of the platform (lifecycle, concurrency). You should be able to judge which Android patterns fit a non-standard system, and to design features that contribute to a scalable, reliable system. 
 Curiosity for Android beyond the traditional mobile world: kiosk, embedded, or AOSP work is a strong plus. Pragmatic problem solver who’s comfortable working outside of familiar mobile patterns.
 Work independently on well-scoped tasks. When scope is unclear, flag it, reach out to the right people, and get the answers and support you need to unblock yourself. Plan the work, communicate progress early, and deliver end to end.
 AI-native coding is how you work. You build with AI agents daily, you have a sharp setup, and your output shows it. If your last six months of work doesn't look meaningfully different because of AI, this isn't your role.
 ✨ Why join us? 
 💰 A salary between 66-89k yearly (incl. 8% holiday allowance) 
 📈 Equity through our Aquablu for All plan: it's not just about shares, it's about shared success. 
 🏋️ Urban Sports Club Membership 
 🌱 Healthy (heavily discounted) lunches 
 🎯 Purpose with Impact: shape how the world hydrates while wiping out single-use plastics. 
 📋 Scale-up pace means fresh challenges (and new skills) every quarter. 
 🤝 Join an ambitious, bold, and fun crew that's always got your back. 
 🌱 Company-sponsored gym membership keeps mind and body in sync. 
 💰 Pension plan with Zwitserleven (50/50 split) so you grow while your savings do, too. 
 🎵 What kind of vibe can you expect at our office? Check out our very own Spotify playlist " Akwablues " 
 🎬 Curious about our story & culture? Check our documentaries on Youtube !

Software Engineer (Motorsport) 
 DO YOU WANT TO WORK FOR THE WORLD LEADER IN ELITE SPORTS PERFORMANCE ANALYTICS? 
 Catapult is a world leader in sports performance technology, serving over 5,000 teams across 40 sports. We improve many of your favorite athletes' performances with our wearable tracking technology, video and data analysis systems, and athlete management products. Our technology offers objective solutions to sport-based challenges and can be found throughout the NFL, NHL, NBA, AFL, NRL, Premier League, Bundesliga, La Liga and many more.
 In Motorsport, Catapult's SBG race management and team strategy systems are the technology of choice for elite-level organisers and competitors around the world, including in Formula 1, Formula E, IndyCar, NASCAR, WEC/Le Mans and other worldwide endurance racing. Customers include the FIA, nine Formula 1 teams - including the 8-time World Champion Mercedes AMG Petronas F1 Team - the majority of Formula E teams, the winners of multiple Le Mans 24-hour races over the last 10 years - Audi, Porsche, and Toyota - and teams and organisers in both IndyCar and NASCAR. 
 We have major offices in the UK (London and Leeds), USA (Boston) and Australia (Melbourne) as well as multiple smaller offices around the world.
 WE WANT PEOPLE WHO ARE PASSIONATE ABOUT SPORTS AND WANT TO WIN 
 We are looking for a talented and enthusiastic Software Engineer (Motorsport)  to grow our Motorsport development team as we expand our RaceWatch products into new series and tackle new challenges.
Based in the London office (3 days a week), you will be a key player in developing new capabilities in RaceWatch, focussing on one or two racing series, and also contributing to the entire RaceWatch suite.
We believe that our customers deserve the best platform, and we are on a mission to maximise and enhance their performance through delivering the highest quality experience. As a Software Engineer, you will help us drive our products and processes forward. You will be able to excel in a fast-paced environment with short project timelines from conception to deployment.
 WHAT YOU'LL DO 
 Lead the development of our RaceWatch software for one or more motorsport series.
 Work with product managers and customers to design features and prioritise tasks.
 Identify ways to add innovative new features to the software.
 Design, build, and maintain efficient, reusable, and reliable code.
 Contribute to code quality, organization, and best practices throughout the development process.
 Maintain and enhance software reliability.
 WHAT YOU'LL NEED 
 Degree in computer science, or another scientific or technical subject.
 A passion for sport.
 2+ years working in a fast-paced, technical environment, delivering software to customers.
 A proven track record of building applications in C/C++, or another object-oriented language.
 Experience developing products, scaling them, and supporting them throughout the entire lifecycle.
 An aptitude for working with complex data.
 Strong interpersonal skills and an ability to communicate effectively with technical and non-technical staff, both internally and when speaking to customers.
 A willingness to go above and beyond for the customer.
 Ability to help cover live motorsport events at weekends on a rotational basis with the rest of the team.
 An ability to multi-task and thrive in a dynamic work environment with changing priorities.
 NICE TO HAVE 
 Experience developing Windows applications in Visual Studio.
 Experience developing applications that process video.
 Experience with ticketing and project management platforms, such as JIRA or Monday.
 Prior experience working in motorsport is an advantage.
 WHY CATAPULT?  
 We have amazing people. We can promise you will work with some of the most ambitious and intelligent people in an exciting industry, and you will do some of the best work of your life.
 We encourage our people to have constructive, open and honest communication; to make Catapult extraordinary; innovate and create smart solutions; establish a collaborative, yet challenging, environment to develop our performance and the performance of our customers.
 Our workforce spans more than 20 countries so you'll have the opportunity to work across multiple nationalities and cultures.
 We value improvement and development. We are challenging ourselves to continuously grow and become a high-performance company. That means we maintain a growth mindset in everything we do, and our people are always looking for ways to do things better. There is unlimited opportunity to grow, do more, and do better.
 We care about you. We offer outstanding paid maternity and paternity leave.
 Whether you are interested in sports or not, you'll have the satisfaction of knowing your work is supporting some of the most successful teams, organisations and competitors on the planet! While we have access to many exciting opportunities, we also realize that we are here to do a very important job for our customers. As a result, we aim to work with purpose and intention. We look for people that fit into our team culture, those who actively contribute and individuals who are excited about what they do. 
 In order to build the future of sports performance, we need the brightest talent. If you think you can contribute to the empowering, enjoyable and exciting Catapult environment, then we invite you to apply.
 All offers of employment are subject to Catapult's positive prehire check. To find out more, please contact the Talent Partner for this role.

About MUBI
 MUBI is a global streaming service, production company and film distributor dedicated to elevating great cinema. To make this possible, we create, curate, acquire and champion visionary films, bringing them to audiences all over the world. We have a team of brilliant, dedicated and passionate people to help bring our mission to life. From London to New York, Istanbul to Paris, and Berlin to Mexico - we work together to realize MUBI’s vision.
 That’s where you come in! Join our global team and help us make great cinema accessible to everyone, everywhere.
 About the Role
 MUBI is looking for an Assistant Controller to lead our group accounting and financial reporting function from London. Reporting to the Global Controller, you will own the US GAAP close and consolidation, lead group financial reporting and the day-to-day delivery of our Big Four group audit, and oversee statutory accounting across our international entities.
 You will directly manage our senior statutory accounting leads. This is a hands-on leadership role: you will stay close enough to the detail to resolve issues and set a high bar for accuracy, while also developing the team, strengthening controls and improving how we close, report and operate.
 Your initial mandate is focused on group and statutory accounting. Cash and treasury operations and payroll will initially remain outside your remit. Once the core accounting mandate is firmly established, we expect the role to broaden over time to include greater oversight of cash and treasury. We are therefore looking for someone who already brings meaningful experience in these areas.
 You will work closely with the Global Controller on complex accounting matters, systems and automation, controls and the continued development of the function. MUBI's accounting environment spans subscription streaming, film distribution and production across multiple entities, countries and currencies. We are looking for someone who learned the fundamentals in Big Four audit and has since applied them in-house, with the judgement and experience to operate effectively across this complexity as the business continues to grow.
 We work hybrid-remote where we require 3 office days in London. Our core days are Tuesday, Wednesday & Thursday, with the flexibility to use our offices on the remaining two days if you wish.
 Where you’ll have impact:
 Own the close and consolidation. Lead the month-, quarter- and year-end close and consolidation process across all entities, including review of journal entries, accruals, reconciliations, eliminations and other key close outputs.
 Lead financial reporting. Prepare and review consolidated US GAAP financial statements, management reporting packs and supporting schedules, ensuring group reporting is accurate, timely and well supported.
 Own key accounting areas. Oversee accounting for content assets, subscription and distribution revenue, deferred revenue, partner and app-store settlements, intercompany balances and foreign currency. Work with FP&A, content and other teams where accounting depends on operational data or business context.
 Oversee global statutory accounting. Directly manage our senior statutory accounting leads and coordinate statutory reporting across the group, working with local teams and external advisers to ensure statutory accounts and filings are complete, accurate and delivered on time.
 Lead the audit. Manage the day-to-day delivery of the Big Four group audit and coordinate statutory audits across our entities. Build an effective relationship with our auditors and advisers and ensure requests and deliverables are well supported and resolved promptly.
 Strengthen controls and processes. Document and improve accounting processes and SOPs, strengthen key close and reporting controls, and help develop the control environment toward public-company and SOX standards.
 Partner on technical accounting. Work with the Global Controller and external advisers on new or complex accounting matters, helping translate technical conclusions into clear accounting policies and treatment.
 Improve systems and automation. Lead improvements to our accounting systems, close and reporting workflows. Use automation and AI where they can materially improve accuracy, speed and efficiency.
 What you’ll bring:
 Active US CPA licence. You hold an active US CPA licence and bring strong practical knowledge of US GAAP.
 Big Four and in-house experience. You have at least eight years of accounting experience, including meaningful Big Four audit experience and at least two years in an in-house accounting role, ideally within a complex, multi-entity international business.
 Close and consolidation expertise. You have owned or played a senior role in month-, quarter- and year-end close and group consolidation, including the preparation or review of financial statements, with a strong understanding of the GL and end-to-end financial reporting process.
 Strong people leadership. You have at least three years of experience managing and developing accounting professionals and are comfortable leading experienced team members across different countries and areas of responsibility.
 Audit and controls experience. You have acted as a senior company-side contact for external auditors and have experience documenting, operating and improving internal financial controls.
 International statutory experience. You have overseen statutory accounting and reporting across multiple jurisdictions and know how to work effectively with local finance teams, advisers and auditors without needing to be the technical expert in every market.
 Meaningful cash and treasury experience. You have practical experience with the core disciplines of cash and treasury in a multi-entity business, including cash reporting or forecasting, banking operations, payment controls and bank reconciliations.
 Strong systems and process capability. You have experience with NetSuite, Ramp and other finance and accounting systems, plus advanced Excel skills.
 Clear judgement and communication. You have strong attention to detail, can move comfortably between accounting detail and the wider business context, communicate clearly with senior stakeholders, and manage competing priorities under tight deadlines.
 You have the right to work in the UK and are able to work in person from our London office.

items.jobDescription:
class="jobdescription"> Wir wollen noch besser werden. Hilfst Du uns? 
Wir sind nicht perfekt und wir denken auch nicht, dass es perfekte Menschen gibt. Aber wir versuchen, jeden Tag noch ein wenig besser zu werden. Und wenn Du das für Dich selbst auch so hältst – dann möchten wir Dich kennenlernen! Unser Ziel? Jeden Tag besser für die Menschen zu werden, für die wir arbeiten: Unsere Kunden – extern wie intern.
Wir bieten Dir auf dem Weg zum Ziel ein tolles Team, das jeden Tag miteinander daran arbeitet, dem Ziel ein Stück näher zu kommen. Und wir haben eine spannende Aufgabe in unserem Team Application Management für Dich!
Du hast Lust, Teil eines Teams zu werden, in dem Du neue Themen eigenverantwortlich und aktiv gestalten kannst, und in der Wertschätzung, Leistungsbereitschaft, Qualität, Innovation und Zuverlässigkeit nicht nur leere Floskeln sind? Dann ist die wichtigste Voraussetzung bereits gegeben! 
Gemeinsam mit Dir und den Kolleginnen und Kollegen möchten wir den Bereich IT & Operational Services für die HANSAINVEST weiter voranbringen. Dabei kannst Du Dich auf maximalen Gestaltungsspielraum verlassen und Deine Ideen und Erfahrungen einbringen. Wir sind offen für Neues!
 Das erwartet Dich: 
 Du verantwortest das gesamte Life-Cycle-Management von Applikationen.
 Du analysierst, spezifizierst neue Ideen und Anforderungen zur Weiterentwicklung der Applikationen in Deinem Zuständigkeitsbereich.
 Du entwickelst Lösungsmöglichkeiten, stimmst diese mit den Stakeholdern ab, planst und steuerst eigenverantwortlich die Umsetzung.
 Du treibst kontinuierliche Verbesserungsmaßnahmen u.a. zur Erhöhung der Performance, Produktionsstabilität, Benutzerfreundlichkeit in den Applikationen proaktiv voran.
 Du koordinierst Testaktivitäten und Fehlerbehebungen in der Applikation und stellst eine Kommunikation an die Anwender sicher.
 Du sorgst für eine hohe Datenqualität und gewährleistest eine aktuelle Dokumentationslage in den Applikationen.
 Du verantwortest den kaufmännischen und regulatorischen Rahmen in Deinem Zuständigkeitsbereich.
 Du arbeitest eng mit verschiedenen Fachabteilungen, IT-Experten, Softwareherstellern und IT-Dienstleistern zusammen.
 Du bist gesuchte Anlaufstelle bei Anwenderfragen, führst Wissenstransfer und ggfs. Benutzerschulungen durch.
 Du setzt Applikationsparametrisierungen selbstständig um und arbeitest in Projekten mit.
 Du begleitest regulatorische Anfragen für Deinen Zuständigkeitsbereich.
 Das bist Du: 
 Du hast ein Studium der Informatik erfolgreich abgeschlossen oder verfügst über eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.
 Du hast idealerweise bereits Berufserfahrung als Business Application Analyst* / IT Business Analyst* oder in ähnlichen Positionen gesammelt und dabei bereits „Querschnittsysteme“, wie ein CRM, Archivsystem oder ein Stammdatensystem betreut.
 Es fällt Dir leicht, fachliche Anforderungen zu strukturieren und für die Softwareentwicklung vorzubereiten.
 Du kannst bestenfalls auf Erfahrungen in der Finanzdienstleistungsbranche zurückgreifen.
 Du bist ein empathischer Teamplayer*, der sein Netzwerk aktiv ausbaut und sehr gut adressatengerecht kommunizieren kann.  
 Du arbeitest Dich schnell in neue und komplexe Sachverhalte ein und stehst für Verbindlichkeit und Ergebnisorientierung.
 Du agierst selbstständig und engagiert, bringst eine hohe technische Expertise mit und kannst gleichzeitig ein hohes Verständnis für die fachlichen Prozesse und Bedürfnisse entwickeln.
 Du verfügst über ein sehr ausgeprägtes analytisches Denk- und Abstraktionsvermögen.
 Du besitzt fließende Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.
 Das haben wir für Dich: 
 Arbeitsumfeld mit flachen Hierarchien und teamübergreifender Zusammenarbeit
 Attraktive Vergütung und 30 Tage Urlaub
 Flexible Gestaltung der Arbeitszeit

 Moderne Büroräumlichkeiten zum Wohlfühlen mit Loungebereich, Game Area und kostenfreien Getränken 
 Vielfältige Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten, sowohl fachlich als auch persönlich
 Stabilität des SIGNAL IDUNA-Mutterkonzerns gepaart mit dem Spirit eines modernen und erfolgreich wachsendem mittelständischen Unternehmens
 Vermögenswirksame Leistungen, Zuschuss zu ÖPNV und Essen im Betriebsrestaurant

Michael Haupt, Teamleiter Application Management (michael.haupt@hansainvest.de), freut sich auf Deine Kontaktaufnahme.

CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at  www.coreweave.com . 
 We're proud to be a Living Wage accredited Employer. 
 What You'll Do: 
 CoreWeave runs one of the largest GPU clouds in the world, and the network underneath it has to be fast, reliable, and almost entirely self-operating. Our Network Development team builds the software that makes that possible. We design, build, and run the platforms and services that provision, configure, automate, monitor, and heal the network, so that the people relying on it rarely have to think about it.
 About the role: 
 We are looking for a Staff Software Engineer to take ownership of these systems. This is a software engineering role at its core. You will spend most of your time designing and writing production software, setting technical direction, and raising the quality bar for the team. A solid understanding of networking fundamentals is required, but deep network engineering expertise is not. This role is about building the software that operates the network.
 Own the design, development, and long-term health of the platforms and services that automate the network, including config generation, device provisioning, workflow automation, observability tooling, and internal CLIs and APIs.
 Plan and map out complex projects months in advance, sequencing the work, anticipating dependencies, and keeping several efforts moving in parallel.
 Lead technical direction through RFCs, design reviews, and architecture decisions, and break ambiguous problems down into shippable work.
 Write well-tested, well-documented software in Python and Go, and set the standard for quality across the team through strong test cases, clear error handling, and solid CI/CD practices.
 Improve the reliability and operability of what we run by defining service-level indicators and objectives and relentlessly reducing manual toil through automation.
 Partner closely with Network Engineering, Observability, Fleet Engineering, and HPC teams so our automation fits cleanly into the wider system.
 Join the on-call rotation once you are ramped, and help drive calm, blameless follow-up when things break.
 Mentor other engineers, review code and designs, and help grow the technical skills of the team.
 Contribute to a positive, collaborative team and organizational culture.
 Who You Are: 
 8 or more years of professional software engineering experience, ideally building and operating production infrastructure, platform, or backend systems at scale.
 Strong proficiency in Python and Go.
 Solid understanding and experience in CI/CD (testing, code review, maintaining continuous builds and deployments).
 Strong understanding of managing runtime health for services and applications at an enterprise level.
 A love of process automation and toil elimination, with hands-on experience building workflow automation or orchestration systems and automated device provisioning at scale such as Zero Touch Provisioning.
 Strong planning skills, including the ability to lay out and drive projects across a multi-month horizon while keeping several concurrent efforts moving as part of a team.
 Strong, well-reasoned technical opinions, paired with genuine openness to better ideas and other people's input.
 A solid understanding of core networking fundamentals, including IP addressing and subnetting, routing/switching, NTP, and DNS.
 Comfort with Linux and Kubernetes, and experience with infrastructure automation tooling such as Ansible and Jinja, a source-of-truth or IPAM and DCIM system such as NetBox, and observability tooling such as Prometheus and Grafana.
 Excellent written communication, a habit of writing documentation other people can actually use, and experience mentoring engineers and collaborating across teams.
 Preferred: 
 A degree in Computer Science or a related field is a plus.
 Wondering if you're a good fit? 
 We believe in investing in our people, and value candidates who can bring their own diversified experiences to our teams – even if you aren't a 100% skill or experience match. Here are a few qualities we've found compatible with our team. If some of this describes you, we'd love to talk.
 You explain the reasoning behind your technical choices, stay open to being convinced otherwise, and pick the right tool for the job rather than defending a favorite.
 You see a problem and solve it without waiting to be asked, and you always look for ways to make things easier, faster, and more secure.
 You treat problems as shared problems, keep incident culture blameless, and give credit generously.
 Why CoreWeave? 
 At CoreWeave, we work hard, have fun, and move fast! We're in an exciting stage of hyper-growth that you will not want to miss out on. We're not afraid of a little chaos, and we're constantly learning. Our team cares deeply about how we build our product and how we work together, which is represented through our core values:
 Be Curious at Your Core
 Act Like an Owner
 Empower Employees
 Deliver Best-in-Class Client Experiences
 Achieve More Together
 We support and encourage an entrepreneurial outlook and independent thinking. We foster an environment that encourages collaboration and enables the development of innovative solutions to complex problems. As we get set for takeoff, the organization's growth opportunities are constantly expanding. You will be surrounded by some of the best talent in the industry, who will want to learn from you, too. Come join us!
 Compensation & Benefits 
 The projected base salary range for this role is £116,000 to £155,000 for London-based candidates, and €135,000 to €180,000 for Dublin-based candidates. The starting salary will be determined by job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and the market location. We strive for both market alignment and internal equity when determining compensation. In addition to base salary, our total rewards package includes a discretionary bonus, equity awards, and a comprehensive benefits program (all based on eligibility).
 To fulfill our obligation to protect client data, successful applicants offered employment with CoreWeave will be required to complete a basic criminal record check, conducted in compliance with GDPR. Employment offers are conditional upon receiving satisfactory check results. 
 What We Offer 
 In addition to a competitive salary, we offer a variety of benefits to support your needs, including:
 Family-level Medical Insurance
 Family-level Dental Insurance 
 Generous Pension Contribution 
 Life Assurance at 4x Salary 
 Critical Illness Cover 
 Employee Assistance Programme 
 Tuition Reimbursement
 Work culture focused on innovative disruption
 Benefits may vary by location.

 CoreWeave is an equal opportunity employer, committed to fostering an inclusive and supportive workplace. All qualified applicants and candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or genetic information. 
 Recruitment Agencies 
 CoreWeave does not accept speculative CVs. Any unsolicited CVs received will be treated as the property of CoreWeave and your Terms & Conditions associated with the use of CVs will be considered null and void. 
 Any unsolicited CVs sent by your company to us – that is to say, in any situation where we have not directly engaged your company in writing to supply candidates for a specific vacancy – will be considered by us to be a “free gift”, leaving us liable for no fees whatsoever should we choose to contact the candidate directly and engage the candidate’s services, and will in no way establish any prior claim by your company to representation of that candidate should the candidate’s details also be submitted by any other party. 
 Export Control Compliance 
 This position requires access to technology and/or source code subject to U.S. export control laws. Any such access will be provided only in compliance with applicable U.S. export control requirements. As part of the recruitment process, CoreWeave may request limited information reasonably necessary to assess applicable export-control requirements.

Tangany mit Sitz in München ist ein innovatives Technologieunternehmen mit einer marktführenden B2B-Lösung für die Verwahrung digitaler Vermögenswerte (z. B. Kryptowährungen, Stablecoins und anderen tokenisierten Vermögenswerten) in Blockchain-Netzwerken. Unsere Lösung wird bereits von mehr als 50 institutionellen Kunden eingesetzt. Als lizenziertes Finanzinstitut wird die Tangany GmbH von der BaFin reguliert.
 Für unser anhaltendes Wachstum suchen wir einen Financial Controller (w/m/d) zur Verstärkung unseres Teams.
 Deine Rolle
 Du verantwortest das Controlling und die Finanzsteuerung und berichtest an das Management Board.
 Das Team ist klein. Deine Expertise und dein Beitrag wirken sich unmittelbar aus: Du arbeitest mit unserer Accountant und unserer Steuerkanzlei z.B. an Themen wie Finanzbuchhaltung, Lohn und Umsatzsteuer-Voranmeldung; die formale Verantwortung für das Rechnungswesen liegt bei der Geschäftsleitung, Zahlungen geben wir im Vier-Augen-Prinzip frei. In diesem Rahmen bist du die Person, die weiß, wo die Zahlen stehen, warum sie dort stehen und wie sich Ergebnis, Kosten, Liquidität und Eigenmittel entwickeln werden.
 Der Kern der Rolle hat zwei Seiten: die regulatorische Pflicht und eine Steuerung, mit der wir jede Finanzfrage jederzeit in wenigen Minuten beantworten können. Business Cases und Investor Reporting kommen dazu und wachsen mit dir.
 Heute arbeiten wir vor allem mit DATEV Unternehmen Online und Tableau. Die Steuerung darauf baust du zu großen Teilen neu auf, gern AI-gestützt: Unser AI-Dev-Team setzt mit dir Live-Reporting, Abstimmungen und ein Finanz-Cockpit um.
 Aufgaben
 Den Jahresabschluss nach HGB und RechKredV erstellen, ergänzt um die RechZahlV-Posten für unser Zahlungsgeschäft, und die Prüfung gemeinsam mit unserer Steuerkanzlei und Abschlussprüfer durchführen.
 Das aufsichtsrechtliche Meldewesen führen und Finanzinformationen nach gesetzlichen Vorgaben unter Begleitung des Compliance-Teams bereitstellen.
 Regulatorische Planzahlen, etwa die Eigenmittelanforderung, aus der Bilanzplanung ableiten und in Abstimmung mit der Geschäftsleitung laufend überwachen.
 Cashflow- und Runway-Planung führen und Finanzierungsbedarf früh sichtbar machen.
 Liquiditäts- und Kontrahentenrisiken in das unternehmensweite Risikocontrolling einbringen und laufend überwachen.
 Business Cases und Rentabilitätsrechnungen erstellen und Investor-Updates vorbereiten.
 Eine Kostenstellenstruktur aufbauen, Budgets je Kostenstelle mit den Verantwortlichen festlegen, Kosten, Budgets und KPIs laufend überwachen sowie Live-Reporting und Ad-hoc-Auswertungen für Geschäftsleitung und Budgetverantwortliche bereitstellen und Plan-Ist-Abweichungen analysieren.
 Aus der Praxiserfahrung heraus Input liefern, um Finanzprozesse, Tools und das interne Kontrollsystem gemeinsam mit unserem AI-Dev-Team auszubauen.
 Wen wir suchen 
 Du bist Controller:in (idealerweise aus einem regulierten Institut) und hast Jahresabschluss und Meldewesen selbst verantwortet.
 Abweichungen erkennst du früh: Wenn sich Eigenmittel, Liquidität oder Kosten in die falsche Richtung bewegen, liegt deine Analyse mit Optionen auf dem Tisch, solange noch Zeit zum Handeln ist.
 Deine Forecasts halten auch Monate später, und wo sie abweichen, kannst du erklären, warum.
 Meldefristen und Prüfungsanforderungen baust du so in die Abläufe ein, dass vor dem Stichtag keine Ad-hoc Aktion nötig ist.
 Prüfer und Risikocontrolling nehmen deine Zahlen als Ausgangspunkt.
 Stellt die Geschäftsleitung eine Finanzfrage, kannst du schnell und problemlos Antworten geben, weil deine Daten und Auswertungen genau dafür gebaut sind.
 Du entscheidest auch mit unvollständigen Informationen, sagst klar, wenn etwas nicht geht, und stellst einen Prozess um, sobald er nicht mehr passt.
 Qualifikation
 Must-Haves
 Abgeschlossenes Studium oder Ausbildung in Finanzen, Controlling oder einem verwandten Feld.
 Mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung im Controlling oder Rechnungswesen, idealerweise in einem regulierten Institut (nach KWG, ZAG oder MiCAR) oder in der Prüfung entsprechender Institute.
 Eigenständig erstellte Jahresabschlüsse nach HGB, sowie Erfahrung mit Liquiditäts- und Kontrahentenrisiken sowie Risikotragfähigkeit.
 Aufbau von Kostenstellenrechnung und Management-Reporting, sicherer Umgang mit DATEV, Excel und Google Sheets inklusive Finanzmodellen und deren Visualisierung, idealerweise mit einem BI-Tool wie Tableau.
 Offenheit: Reporting mit AI-Werkzeugen neu aufsetzen.
 Fließend Deutsch und Englisch (C1 oder höher).
 Nice-to-Haves
 Erfahrung mit MiCAR, etwa der Eigenmittelberechnung.
 FP&A, Business Cases oder Investor-Reporting in einem wachsenden Unternehmen.
 Erfahrung im aufsichtsrechtlichen Meldewesen nach KWG oder ZAG.
 Interesse an Krypto und Tokenisierung.
 Benefits
 Flexibilität & Work-Life-Balance: 
 30 Tage Urlaub, dazu jeweils ein halber Tag frei an Heiligabend und Silvester, und bei Bedarf zusätzlicher unbezahlter Urlaub, um die Akkus wieder aufzuladen.
 Zusätzlicher bezahlter Urlaub für frischgebackene Eltern.
 Die Freiheit, von zu Hause oder in unserem schönen Büro mitten in München zu arbeiten.
 Möglichkeit einer Workation, um auch auf Reisen zu arbeiten.
 Flexible Arbeitszeiten: Du arbeitest, wenn du am produktivsten bist.
 Deine Entwicklung: 
 Es startet mit dem ersten Tag: Mit unserem auf deine Bedürfnisse zugeschnittenen Onboarding erhältst du einen strukturierten Einarbeitungsplan und Feedbackgespräche während der Probezeit (und natürlich auch danach).
 Wir wachsen und möchten, dass du mit uns wächst! Werde zum Blockchain-Experten, tausche dich mit unserem hochmotivierten Team aus und bilde dich in individuellen Trainings weiter.
 Regelmäßige Feedback-Gespräche: Zweimal im Jahr evaluieren wir gemeinsam mit deinen Karriereweg und leiten die nächsten Schritte in die richtige Richtung ein.
 Entlohnung und Zusatzleistungen 
 Ein attraktives, marktkonformes Jahresgehalt.
 Spaß bei der Arbeit: eine Runde mit Kolleg:innen an unserer Tischtennisplatte, ein Feierabendgetränk auf unserer großartigen Dachterrasse und unsere Team-Events.
 Motivierte Mitarbeitende sind der Schlüssel zum Erfolg. Deshalb bieten wir dir über Hrmony flexible, digitale Benefits, die dich im Alltag unterstützen. Du erhältst ein monatliches Budget, das du nach deinen Bedürfnissen aufteilst:
 Essenszuschuss: für Lebensmittel, Restaurants oder Lieferdienste
 Mobilitätsbudget: z. B. für das Deutschlandticket
 Sachbezüge: flexibel nutzbar für Streaming, Fitness, Shopping und mehr
 Werde Teil unseres Teams und revolutioniere gemeinsam mit uns den traditionellen Finanzmarkt. Nutze die Chance und gestalte die Zukunft der Branche aktiv mit. Bewirb dich jetzt und sei Teil unserer innovativen Reise, um Blockchain-Technologie für jeden zugänglich zu machen.

 Develop web-based engineering configuration tooling for managing structured mission, vehicle, payload, subsystem, component and calibration data. You will build the user-facing application, backend services and delivery infrastructure that turn engineering data into traceable, reusable and portable configuration artefacts for simulation, testing and software workflows. Working with domain engineers, embedded software developers, systems engineers, IT and cybersecurity stakeholders, you will help deliver a dependable platform for engineering teams.   
 Your role in our space mission... 
 Design, implement and maintain end-to-end features across the engineering configuration platform’s frontend, backend API, database and deployment stack.   
 Build clear and efficient React/TypeScript user interfaces for creating, editing, reviewing and navigating hierarchical engineering configurations.   
 Develop robust Python services and REST APIs for configuration data, validation, traceability, approvals, export and integration with other engineering tools.   
 Model structured, reusable configuration data in PostgreSQL, including parameter metadata, ownership, history and relationships between missions, vehicles and subsystems.   
 Develop reliable import and export workflows for YAML and other portable formats used by simulation pipelines, test rigs and flight-software tooling.   
 Integrate authentication and authorisation with enterprise identity providers and single sign-on, with appropriate security boundaries and role-based access control.   
 Own software quality through automated unit, integration and end-to-end testing, code review, observability, documentation and disciplined release practices.

 Qualifications

 Experience with relational data modelling and PostgreSQL, including migrations, validation and transactional behaviour .

 Ability to translate complex engineering workflows and domain concepts into intuitive, dependable software.

items.jobTitle: Fast-Forward Engineer - Geospatial AI & Intelligent Products
items.jobDescription:
Job description
 Team & Reporting Line: Intelligence | Data & Analytics
 Our Mission   
 At constellr, we use thermal intelligence from space to understand what is happening on Earth - where, when and at scale. Our satellite constellation delivers high-resolution land surface temperature data, giving governments, defence organisations, commercial operators and global institutions the intelligence they need to monitor change, assess risk and make better-informed decisions.
 From national security and critical infrastructure to agriculture and climate resilience, constellr turns temperature into actionable intelligence for a changing world.
 Your Role 
 We are building the next generation of thermal satellites. This is not a concept on a slide: our first two SkyBee satellites have been in orbit since 2025, each flying a cryocooled thermal infrared instrument on a microsatellite, and, backed by a €37M Series A, our next satellites are already in the pipeline. But the value of that data comes from what we can build with it. That’s where you come in.
 In Data & Analytics, we are building the team that will turn this data into AI-powered intelligence products. You will help shape our first solutions across all customer segments: for defence and security customers in National Security and Maritime Awareness; for public-sector customers in Urban Dynamics and Food & Water Security; and for commercial customers in Industrial Monitoring, delivered directly and through partner platforms. Beyond that, you will help lay the groundwork for multi-domain intelligence integration, for example as part of a European sovereign space intelligence consortium.
 Join constellr as a Fast-Forward Engineer for Geospatial AI & Intelligent Products and help turn ideas from Product, Intelligence, customers and domain teams into working systems. You will be a hands-on builder, rapidly creating MVPs that combine constellr’s thermal Earth observation data, external information sources and modern AI capabilities.
 Working closely with Product, Intelligence, Data Platforms, customer-facing teams and early users, you will translate requirements and ideas into prototypes, APIs and workbenches that can be tested and validated. One week you might build a facility research workbench combining satellite observations, OpenStreetMap, external datasets and web-derived context; another, you might expose a new thermal indicator through an API, AI agent or lightweight analytical application.
 Success is measured by how quickly we learn what works, what creates customer value and what deserves to move toward production, not by how much prototype code survives.
 Key responsibilities 
 Rapidly turn requirements, ideas and problems from Product, Insights, customers and other domain teams into working MVPs, APIs and workbenches, helping validate technical feasibility, test ideas with users and accelerate the path toward production.
 Build AI-powered workflows using LLMs, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), tool/function calling, structured outputs and agents where they add value, choosing the simplest architecture that can answer the product question.
 Build end-to-end prototypes across data ingestion, data processing, backend APIs and lightweight user interfaces, using AI-assisted engineering to shorten the path from idea to working service.
 Create data-fusion and geospatial intelligence workflows that combine constellr observations with external geospatial, commercial, open-source and web-derived information.
 Develop geospatial search, facility research, monitoring and analytical capabilities using Python, PostgreSQL/PostGIS and modern geospatial libraries and services.
 Deploy and operate experiments independently in sandbox/cloud environments using Docker and lightweight infrastructure, with working knowledge of Linux and container orchestration sufficient to make prototypes available in days or weeks rather than months.
 Work closely with domain experts and early users, gather feedback, and evaluate prototypes against technical feasibility, user value, data availability, accuracy, operating cost and scalability; translate the evidence into clear recommendations for Product and Technology.
 Define a clean graduation path for successful experiments: document assumptions and architecture, identify reusable components and collaborate with production engineering teams when a concept is ready to become a supported product.
 Actively discard or simplify experiments that do not demonstrate value, keeping the innovation environment fast, pragmatic and free from unnecessary production complexity.
 Job requirements
 About you   
 Required:  
 Strong hands-on software engineering skills in Python (4+ years), with experience building and deploying real software systems and the ability to independently take a service from data ingestion to API or user interface.
 Hands-on experience applying modern AI/LLM capabilities to software products, including RAG, tool/function calling, structured outputs, prompt design or agentic workflows.
 Experience with data-intensive systems, plus confidence building data pipelines and integrating multiple APIs and heterogeneous data sources.
 Ability to build lightweight services, for example with FastAPI, and enough frontend capability to create usable analytical tools, workbenches or dashboards.
 A builder and product mindset: comfortable with ambiguity, able to work directly with users and domain experts, make pragmatic technical choices, iterate from feedback and distinguish prototype quality from production quality.
 Experience working effectively with agentic coding tools such as Claude Code, Codex or equivalent, including working from specifications, reviewing and validating agent-generated changes, and integrating them safely into a shared codebase.
 Eligibility and willingness to obtain and maintain a national security clearance (e.g. German Ü2/Ü3 or equivalent), as the role involves work for defence and security customers.
 Nice to Have :   
 Experience with Earth observation data, STAC, COGs, thermal imagery, remote-sensing analytics, GIS or satellite data platforms.
 Practical geospatial engineering experience with tools such as GeoPandas, rasterio/GDAL, xarray, spatial databases, GIS or geospatial web services.
 Experience with React/TypeScript or another language/framework that helps you rapidly build interactive analytical tools.
 Experience with DuckDB and analytical data workflows; semantic search, embeddings, vector databases, knowledge graphs, SPARQL or entity-resolution workflows are also valuable.
 Experience with agent frameworks or protocols such as LangGraph, pydantic-ai, LangChain or MCP, multi-source data fusion, or taking a prototype through product validation and handing it over to a production engineering team.
 Why join constellr? 
 High-Impact National Security Mission:  Be part of an ambitious mission to launch the world’s first commercial thermal infrared constellation, delivering sovereign-grade "behavioural" intelligence from space to close critical blind spots for defence, intelligence, and maritime surveillance agencies.
 Fast-Paced "New Space" Innovation:  Work at the leading edge of a rapidly evolving defence sector. By leveraging modern, agile New Space methodologies, you will help design, build, and deploy dual-use thermal payloads into operational orbit at a speed and scale that traditional aerospace models simply cannot match.
 Broad Interdisciplinary Exposure:  Accelerate your professional growth by collaborating daily with a diverse, international cohort of astrophysicists, software developers, and defence-system engineers.
 Inclusive & Scientific Culture:  Join a high-trust team deeply committed to diversity, inclusion, and scientific excellence, where academic curiosity is paired with high autonomy and a flat hierarchy.
 Financial Upside & Well-being:  Benefit from a Virtual Share Option Plan (VSOP) for permanent employees, giving you a true stake in the company's growth, alongside highly flexible hybrid working models.

At Stark, we forge the future of European and national security through cutting-edge, AI-driven technology and unmatched engineering precision. As a premier defence technology company, our mission is clear: to equip NATO Allies and their partners  with next-generation autonomous defence platforms and advanced AI-driven software built to perform in the world’s most demanding environments. 
 We believe that true security stems from relentless innovation. By combining elite engineering talent with agile technology and an AI-native operational culture, Stark turns complex defence challenges into field-tested, multi-domain solutions. 
 WHY JOIN US 
 The software and systems you work on directly protect personnel and defend European and national sovereignty. 
 You will work alongside industry-leading minds on autonomous systems, advanced propulsion, and secure cyber platforms. 
 We foster a fast-paced, collaborative environment where bold ideas are supported by serious R&D backing. 
 ABOUT THE TEAM 
 Our Quality Control team ensures that all incoming materials, parts, and sub-assemblies meet the highest standards before reaching production. As an Quality Control Specialist, you will join a hands-on, detail-oriented team directly responsible for maintaining product integrity across our defense manufacturing lines. We work closely with Supplier Quality Engineering, Logistics, and Production to intercept non-conformances early and prevent assembly line disruptions.  
 YOUR MISSION 
 As the Quality Control Specialist you are the first line of defense in ensuring the quality of our products. You are responsible for inspecting a wide variety of incoming materials from external manufacturers, including mechanical parts, electronic components, batteries, wire harnesses, and general printed circuit boards (PCBs). With a keen eye for detail, you will verify that all incoming materials comply with strict quality standards and technical specifications before they are released to production. 
 WHAT YOU WILL DO AT STARK 
 Perform detailed visual, dimensional, and functional inspections on incoming mechanical parts, electronics, batteries, wires, and PCBs using standard measurement and visual inspection tools. 
 Execute standardized test protocols on electronics and batteries using appropriate bench-test equipment (e.g., oscilloscopes, Digital Multimeters and custom fixtures). 
 Identify physical, mechanical, or electrical defects and immediately block/quarantine non-conforming materials to prevent them from reaching the production line. 
 Record inspection results, create and maintain test protocols, and document all non-conformances within our quality management/complaint systems. 
 Support root-cause analyses and collaborate closely with Production, Engineering, and Supplier Quality teams to initiate corrective actions for quality deviations 
 Ensure all processes adhere to internal quality requirements and standard guidelines like ISO 9001 (and perspective EN9100). 
 Review and interpret technical assembly drawings, schematics, Bill of Materials (BOMs), and inspection criteria to ensure strict compliance. 
 Operate within a 2-shift system (morning and evening shift alternating every two weeks) to support incoming goods processing and production deadlines. 
 WHAT YOU BRING TO THE MISSION 
 Completed vocational training or technical education in mechanics, electronics, quality inspection, or a related field. 
 2+ years of professional experience in incoming goods inspection, quality control, or technical quality assurance within manufacturing.
